itaśca pratyayārthaḥ saṃbandhaḥ|
'śabdavṛttinimitte hi bhāvapratyaya ipyate|

' yathaiva śāleyasya gotvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, yathā ca viśeṣaṇabhūtā jātiḥ|
bhāvapratyayena niṣkṛṣṭā abhidhīyate iti gopasya saiva vācyatvena iṣṭā, tathā devadattasya gomattvaṃ ityukte gavi pratipatya- bhāvāt saṃbandhaniṣpattipratīteḥ sa eva bhāvapratyayārtho- 'dhyavasīyate|
yaśca bhāvapratyayārthaḥ, sa prātipadikasya viśeṣye vartamānasya nimittam|
yacca nimittaṃ, tat viśe- ṣaṇatvāt mukhyamabhidheyaṃ, lākṣaṇikaṃ viśeṣyam|
yadi ca matupā saṃbandho'bhihitaḥ, tataḥ 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthe saha brūtaḥ' iti gomatprātipadikāt utpadyo bhāva- pratyayaḥ|
saṃbandhamabhidhātumarhati anyathā|
tasmādapi saṃbandho'rthaḥ|
etena sarve yaugikāḥ|
kṛttaddhitasamāseṣu vyākhyātāḥ|

ekahāyanādiśabdeḥ saṃbandho'bhidhīyate|

' ekaṃ hāyanaṃ asyāḥ iti pratyayantena anyapadārthaḥ pradaśyate|
pañcaya- thasya ca pratyayārthatvāt iha prādhānyam|

kevalayā vibhaktyapratyayogāt sarva- nāmāthapratītibhāvācca|

ato'pi saṃbandhābhidhānaṃ bahuvrīhiṇā|
'na cāpyanyapadārthatvaṃ jāteradhyavasīyate|
nahi piñjākṣisaṃbandhastasyā nāpyekavarṣatā |
' vyaktidharmā dhye, piñje akṣiṇī asyāḥ; ekaṃ hāyanaṃ asyāḥ; citrā gāvaḥ ityeva- mādayaḥ|
tāsāṃ ca vyaktīnāṃ anantatvena saṃbandhānupa- labdheḥ vyabhicārācca avācakaḥ śabda ityuktam|
nahi ajajātāyāṃ piñjākṣyāṃ prathamaḥ prayogo bhavet|
ataḥ avaśyaṃ sāmānyaṃ kiṃ cit vācyaṃ ādhāyitavyam|
na ca tadiha saṃbandhādanyat upapadyate|
kiṃca 'vayo'vasthā- ''vidheyata yadi yadyapi tvekahāyanī|
tathāpi guṇa evāsau na dravyamiti gamyate |
' (iti yaugika- śabdadravyavacanatādādarthya pūrvapakṣaḥ|
) (anenaiva hetunā adhikaraṇakṣepaḥ -) tasmāt na dravyaśabdaḥ kaścit atra vidyate iti anudāharaṇatvam|

aruṇyānyā:
yo nimittabhāvāt bhāva ityucyeta |
na ca puruṣa ' tasya bhāvaḥ ' ityevaṃ vyapadeśabhedaṃ labhate |
tena bhāvapratyayaḥ ' ānarthakyāt tadaṅgeṣu ' (3|1|9|18) iti arthāptaṃ saṃbandhamavalambate |
nimittatvamapi ca tasya vastulakṣaṇamasti, iti abhidheyanimittāsaṃbhave tadapi tāvat gṛhyatāṃ ityevamāśrīyate |
tasmāt akārametat yaugikānāṃ saṃbandhābhidhānaśaktikalpanāyām |
' ataśca daṇḍiśabdena saṃbandhyevocyate yathā |
tathaiva yaugikaiḥ śabdaiḥ : piṅgākṣyādipadairapi ||
saṃbandhasya ca bhāvatvaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ teṣu pūrvavat |
bahuvrīheratau dravyamabhidheyaṃ na tadguṇaḥ ||
yadapi ekaṃ hāyanamasya ityapyapadārtha ṣaṣṭhyarthaprādhā- nyāt saṃbandhe bahuvrīhiriti, tatrābhidhīyate |
' abhi- dheyo bahuvrīherarthasyeti kathyate |
tathāpi pratha- māntena tulyo'sau saṃpratīyate ||
' yadi tu anya- padārthaḥ padyantaḥ eva saṃbandhī syāt, tato yathaiva ' rāja- puruṣaḥ ' ityatra ṣaṣṭhyantatvāt rājā puruṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, prathamāntatvācca puruṣaḥ pradhānatvena samāsādyau bhavati, evameva citragavādiśabdaiḥ : devadattādiviśiṣṭā gāva eva pratīyeran, na citragoviśiṣṭo devadattādiḥ |
tasmāt citrāṇāṃ gavāmayaṃ iti iṣṭe'rthe bahuvrīhirvartate |
yadyapi anyathā vigrahaḥ, tathāpi uttarakālaṃ īdṛgarthadarśanāt evameva vigraho'pi kartavyaḥ |
tataśca saṃbandhaviśiṣṭābhi- dheyaiḥ : devadattādiviśiṣṭaḥ iti samāsārtho vijñāyate |
yathaiva ca ' rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ' ityatra ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prayujyamānāyāṃ saṃbandhaḥ pradhānabhūto'bhidhīyate, kute ca samāse, nivṛ- ttāyāṃ vibhaktau, pūrvottarapadayoḥ pratyekaprayogārhatāpari- tyāgāt saṃbandhavācyasya ca sāmīpyāgataviśiṣṭārtha- pratyayādeva siddheḥ na saṃbandhaparaḥ samāso bhavati, evameva padyaprayogadeva bahuvrīhāvapi na saṃbandhaprādhānyam |
tacca pūrvottarapadārthayoḥ :, nāpi anyatarasya, iti anyapadārtha- bhūtadravyaprādhānyādhyavasānam |
( bahuvrīhissamāsārtha- vicāraḥ ---) sa ca anyapadārthaḥ saṃbandhau yogyatāvalena jātidravyaguṇakriyāṇāmanyatamaḥ parigṛhyate |
tadyathā, ' citragavyaktiriyaṃ jātidravyaṃ nānāguṇaṃ tvidam |
guṇo'nekāśrayaḥ kaścidayaṃ tvekāśrayā kriyā ||
' sarvatra ca yogyatvāt samānādhikaraṇapadābhiropaṇītaḥ : anyapadārtha- viśeṣo gamyate |
tadiha ekaṃ hāyanamasyāḥ iti jāteranā- ditvāt na viśeṣaṇaṃ saṃbandhati iti vyaktirāśrayate |
nanu vyaktīnāṃ ānantyavyabhicārābhyāṃ anabhidhānamuktam |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
' ānantye'pi hi bhāvānāmekaṃ kṛtvo- palakṣaṇam |
śabdaḥ : sukarasaṃbandho na ca vyabhicāri- pyati ||
' yatra tāvat jātyaiva anyapadārtha upalakṣyate tatra tathaiva ekyā sakṛd gṛhītayā upalakṣitā vyaktyo deśādibhiścāpi abhidhāsyante iti sujñānaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
na ca tadupalakṣitamavya : anyatra prayogaḥ; iti ayyabhi- cāraḥ |
yatra tu vyaktibhireva vyaktyantarāṇi viśeṣyante, tatrāpi mūlopalakṣaṇaṃ jātireva abhyupagamyate |
sarvathā dūra- mapi viśeṣaṇamalyāṃ anuvartamānayāṃ prathamolakṣaṇasya abhedāt saṃbandhadarśanaṃ upapadyate |
sarvaprathamasaṃbandhasyaiva śabdādartham |
āntarikāṇāṃ tu lakṣaṇasiddhasaṃbandhatvāt anabhidheyatvam |
ataśca piṅgākṣatvābhyāṃ svavyaktyo guṇavayavatvikā lakṣyante, tāmiravayavi dravyaṃ upalakṣyate, tacca samāsādyau bhavati ( iti bahuvrīhissamāsārtha- vicāraḥ :) |
sa punaḥ kiṃ abhidheyaḥ, lākṣaṇikaḥ : iti |
prādhānyena pratīyate : samānādhikaraṇya ' anekaṃmanyapadārthe ' (pā0 2|2|24) iti ca smaraṇāt devatātaddhitatva- rthīyādibhiriva abhidhīyate iti cit |
apare tvāhuḥ; yuktaṃ devatātaddhitau ananyaprayojanatvāt śabdā- dhikyācca anyapadārthābhidhānam |
na ca tatra prātipadi- kārthena so'rthaḥ śakyo lakṣayituṃ vyabhicārāt, kevalaca prātipadikādapratīteḥ |
bahuvrīhau tu pūrvottarayoḥ : padayo- rvidyamānatvāt anyasya ca abhyaviksya śabdā- vayavasya abhāvāt piṅgākṣatvābhyāmeva ca dravyapratyaya- siddheḥ na śakyamabhidheyaṃ kalpayituṃ iti |
na tu etat vyāpitvena śakyamāyitum |
karmadhāraye hi etat vyāpitvena syāt, sarvathā lakṣaṇā nimittopapatteḥ |
iha tu citraguḥ ityevamādiṣu citragośabdayoḥ : atyantavyatiriktā- rthīmabhilātvāt devadattādibhiśca na śrutyā lakṣaṇā
aruṇyānyā:
vā sāmānādhikaraṇyamavakalpate |
prāgapi ca devadattādi- śabdāt anyapadārthapratīteḥ na vākyārthatvakalpanā |
na ca kevalaṃ samāsavelāyāṃ yo padārthau avadhāritau, tau devatā- rthasaṃbandhinau, yato vākyārtho devadattaḥ syāt |
tasmāda- vaśyaṃ pratīteḥ, anyapadārtho'sya vācyaḥ : iti abhyupaganta- vyam |
evaṃ ca prādhānyamaviruddhaṃ bhaviṣyati |
ataśca evamādiṣu bahuvrīheranyapadārthābhidhānaśakterdraṣṭā, iti yatrāpi kathaṃ cit lakṣaṇā saṃbhavati, tatrāpi pūrvakṛtalakṣaṇanapāyāt abhidheyatvameva adhyavasīyate ( iti bahuvrīhyarthābhidheyatvalākṣaṇikatvavicāraḥ |
tasmādupapannaṃ piṅgākṣyādīnāṃ dravyavacanatvam |
yattu ekahāyanī iti vayovacana iti, tadanupapannam |
vayaso lakṣaṇā''vagateḥ : ukṣādiśabdānāṃ hi vayovacana- tvam |
ekahāyanīdiśabdāḥ : punaḥ kālaviśeṣayukta- dravyavacanāḥ : santo vayo lakṣyantaḥ : pravartante |
nahi ekaṃ hāyanaṃ asyāḥ : ityevaṃ vayo nirdiśyate, kiṃ tarhi dravyam |
tasya hi hāyanaṃ jātasya, na vayasaḥ |
( iti yaugika- śabdadravyavacanatāvādādhaḥ : |
(itaḥ paraṃ bhāṣyavicaraṇam) tasmādupapannaṃ etābhyāṃ ā'maikadeśopāttaguṇaviśiṣṭadravyaprayatnāt upapanno'yaṃ saṃśayaḥ : kiṃ aruṇā krujanaprakaraṇagatakrayādyarthaśeṣa- tvena niviśate, athavā samānavākyasthatvātpadapratyā- yitatvameva ekahāyanyāṃ iti |

' atha tu kathaṃ cana upapadyate, tato vākyabheda- mapyapagamya prakaraṇadharmatvena adhyavasyāmaḥ ' ( mūle tu ' atha tu apramādyadbhiḥ : anivyamāṇo ' iti vākyārambhaḥ : ' na kathaṃ cana ' ityādi tu samānam ) |

etaduktaṃ bhavati, yāvat śrutivākye vyāpriyate, tāvat prakaraṇadharmatvaṃ nāsti |
yadā tu vastuvisaṃvādāt vihitaśaktīnāṃ te nirvyāpāre bhaviṣyataḥ : , tadā prakaraṇaviniyoga iti |

kathaṃ punaḥ : guṇasya akriyātmakaḥ : sata : prakaraṇena grahaṇam ? ucyate |
naivātra prakaraṇaṃ grāhakatvena ( viniyojakatvena ) iṣṭam |
kathaṃ tarhi ? aruṇā ityatra pade yā tṛtīyā tayā kara- ṇāni prakaraṇalakṣaṇajyotiṣṭomāpūrvasādhanāni somaprabhṛtīni anudya aruṇāprātipadikārtho vidhīyate |
' ataśca pada- mevaitad vākyenaiva vibhajyate |
yā vyaktiḥ : karaṇa- tvena coditā'pūrvasādhanam ||

triyamaruṇatvaviśiṣṭā |

'yat punaryahmānādi vihitaṃ kāraṇāttaram |
na tasyāyaṃ guṇaḥ śeṣaḥ sarvorthopyavadhāritaḥ ||
' (aruṇaśabdo guṇavacano dravyavacano veti vicāraḥ) |

tasmāt dravyavacanaḥ aruṇā- śabdaḥ iti |
tadetadapeśalam |
tadeva hi dravyaṃ aru- ṇimnā paricchidyamānaṃ aruṇāśabdābhidhānatāṃ labhate |
tadeva anyaguṇaṃ nāṇunāśabdaḥ śaknoti abhivadi- tum |
aruṇāmānaṃ eṣa śabdo na vyabhicarati, vyabhi- carati punadravyam |
avyabhicāri ca kāraṇaṃ kāraṇatā- midham |
ato'sya
svābhāvikī|
nityaṃ hi rūpādiṣu svābhāvyena abhidhīya- māneṣu dravyaṃ viśeṣaṇatvena ucyate, śuklādiṣu viśeṣya- tvena|
ata eva ca anādikālaprasiddhatvāt asyā lakṣaṇāyāḥ matvalopabhāvena anugamaḥ|
yā tu ādimatī nānyantaprasiddhā, nāśo śāstreṇa anugamyate|
vinā'pi ca anumāt saṃbandhavattaratvena sā kadā cit upa- labhyate|
tadyathā 'madhuro rasaḥ snigdhaḥ śīto guruḥ' iti snigdhaśītatvādīnāṃ guṇāntaraviśeṣatvāt na rasena saṃbandho'sti iti rasalakṣitena dravyeṇa saṃbadhyate|
tasmāt śaktiparyantayogābhāvāt matvalopabhāvāvau|
etena bhāvapratyayasadasadbhāva-sāmānādhikaraṇyavaiyadhikaraṇyavyavasthā vyākhyātā|
śuklatvādinā'sya bhāvapratyayaniṣkṛṣṭa- viśeṣyabhūtaguṇavattvāt gandhavadeva nityaṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyena saṃbadhyate|
'etāvāṃstu viśeṣo'tra yadatrāpi viśeṣa- ṇam|
viśeṣya eva śukletve, śuklo dravyaviśeṣa- paṇam||
dravyopasarjanabhūtaḥ svāprātipadike sthitaḥ|
tādṛśca niṣkṛṣyate dravyāt paścācca tvatalā- dibhiḥ||
tenaitasya dvirūpatvaṃ gandhāderakarūpatā|
tathā ca śukla ityasya punaranyathā dvirūpatā||
kadā cid guṇamevāha guṇine lakṣyate ka cit|
paṣṭhyantatadvibhaktyantavācyadravyopasarjanaḥ|
paṭasya śukla ityatra niṣkṛṣṭo guṇa āśritaḥ|
paṭaḥ śukla iti tvatra dravyalīno'bhidhīyate||
'liṅgasaṃkhyādi- vacanaśabdaśca dravyaprādhānye vartate vaiyākaraṇānāṃ guṇamuktvā guṇine vartamānatvāt|
na hi vaiyākaraṇānāṃ vaiśeṣika- vat guṇāḥ parisaṃkhyāyante|
ki tarhi? aṅgāṅgibhāvā- pekṣayā guṇaguṇivyavahāraḥ|
śuklādiśabdāśca upasarjana- bhūtameva vadanti, na rūpādiṣaddhāḥ|
iti liṅgasaṃkhyā- saṃvyāsaṃkaraḥ|
(iti abhidhālakṣaṇāvādāryaḥ)|
bhāṣyakāreṇa tu etameva parihāraṃ manasi kṛtvā uktaṃ 'bhavati hi guṇavacanasyāpi klībatā yathā karuṇābuddhi- śabdayoḥ' (mūle tu 'yathā karuṇā buddhiḥ' iti iti paṭhi- tam) gandhādiśabdatulyāpi caitau pradarśanamātraviśeṣaṇāt udāhṛtau|
etaduktaṃ bhavati, ye'pi tāvat svapradhānaguṇa- vacanāḥ, te'pi kathaṃ cit liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yujyante, kiṃ punaryeṣu dravyaprādhānyam|
evaṃ anayā yuktyā aruṇā iti guṇavacanaḥ|
bhā-- (pṛ. 685) atha yadi krīṇātinā na saṃbadhyate tasminneva vākye ekahāyanīśabdena saṃbhastye, na bhaviṣyati vākyabheda iti|
tanna|
kevalaṃ hi guṇaṃ aruṇāśabdaḥ abhidhāti, na dravyaguṇau|
kevalaṃ ca dravyaṃ ekahāyanīśabdaḥ, na guṇasahitaṃ, iti tayoḥ saṃbandhasya vācikāṃ paṣṭhīmantareṇa kathaṃ saṃbandho gamyate|
āha, antareṇāpi paṣṭhīṃ ekavibhaktinirdeśāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ agamyam|
yathā 'nīlamutpala' iti|
tadupapannam|
rūpāt (sāmarthyāt) aruṇāśabdasya guṇavacanatā, kalpanīyaṃ tu ekavibhaktisaṃyogāt ekahāyanīśabdasannidhā- nācca tadekavākyatvābhyupagamya ekahāyanīśabdāsāmānādhi- karaṇyam|
na ca liṅgāt vākyaṃ balīyaḥ|
tasmādasada- tat|
tatrocyate|
yadā kevalaguṇavacanatāyāṃ śabdaḥ pravartamānaḥ nānyena saṃbandhaṃ labhate, tadā anupadaśaktvāt ānanyakaṃ mā bhūt iti dravyaparatāmāpadyate|
tasyāṃ yasyāṃ ekavibhaktyikena ekahāyanīśabdena saṃnihitena ekavākyatāprāptyāpadyamānaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati|
tathā ca kṛtvā nīlamutpalaṃ ityupapadyate|
sa cāyaṃ aruṇāśabdaḥ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ vartate|
na hi asya svārthamabhidhataḥ|
ito vicchinnasya prakaraṇe'pi arthavattā|
kutaḥ? yenaiva hetunā krīṇātinā na saṃbadhyate 'nāmṛto'rthaḥ kriyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ bhavatīti, na ca kriyāsādhanairanyaiḥ, nahi kevalaṃ guṇavacanaḥ saṃśrito dravyamabhidhātu' iti, sa eva hetuḥ prakaraṇasaṃbandhāve'pi|
tatrāpi saṃbandhamānaḥ kriyābhir saṃbadhyate, tatsādhanairvā dravyaiḥ|
tattanmayyamapi anupa- pannam|
ataḥ anarthakatvaparijihīrṣayā saṃnihitena eka- hāyanīśabdena aruṇāśabdaḥ saṃbadhyate, nāsti vākya- bhedaḥ|
naitadevam|
nahi ayaṃ aruṇāśabdaḥ eka- hāyanīviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavitumarhati|
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? karaṇa- vibhaktyā tṛtīyayā samuccārito'yam|
tena etena tṛtīyāśrutisamarthyāt kriyāviśeṣaṇena bhavitavyam|
kārakāṇāṃ hi kriyā saṃbandho na dravyeṇeti|
sa eṣa
śrutisāmarthyāt kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, vākyāt ekahāyanī- viśeṣaṇam|
śrutiśca vākyāt balīyasī|
tasmān nāsya ekahāyanīsaṃbandha iti|
vā-- (pṛ. 685) guṇavacanaśca krīṇātinā na saṃbadhyate ityucyate paraḥ punarāha- 'atha yadi krīṇā- tinā na saṃbadhyate' tataḥ|
ekahāyanyā saṃbadhyate iti|
śakyate hi guṇavacanasya dravyasaṃbandhaḥ kartum|
siddhānta- vādī tu śrutvā kriyāsaṃbandhavāgāt dravyasaṃbandho vākya- lakṣaṇo durbalatvāt bādhyate ityetat pratipādayitu- māha- 'tanna kevalaṃ hi guṇaṃ' iti|
dimakāro hi nāma śabdānāṃ saṃbandhaḥ, sāmānādhikaraṇyena vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā|
tatra yadā ubhābhyāṃ ubhayārthopādānaṃ tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati|
paṣṭhyantadravyapadoccāraṇe tu vaiyadhikaraṇyena saṃbandhaḥ|
tadiha kevalaguṇavacanatvāt aruṇākathāyanīśabdayoḥ śrutisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tāvacca vidyate|
nāpi paṣṭhīśruti- rasti|
tasmāt tṛtīyāśrutibalīyastvāt na dravyaguṇayoḥ saṃbandha iti|
valyalakṛta saṃbandhanirākaraṇaṃ avaśyam apramāṇakṛtatvābhiprāyeṇa ayaṃ bravīti iti matvā eka- vibhaktiyogāt (ekavibhaktinirdeśāt iti mūle) ityāha|
'tadanupapannaṃ' iti valāvalapradarśanām|
prathamaṃ tāvat svāsābhyarthana aruṇāpratipadikasya guṇavacanatvaṃ gamyate, padāntarasaṃnidhānācca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ iti balāvasam|
tatrāha 'kevalaaruṇācitvaṃ liṅgād yadyapi gamyate|
tathāpyagatito vākyāllakṣaṇāvṛttitvāśritā||
' idānīṃ tṛtīyāśrutibalīyastvāt kriyāsaṃbandhavāgāt dravya- saṃbandhaṃ darśayati|
bhā-- (pṛ. 686) nanu ca guṇasya kriyāsaṃbandhā- bhāvāt avivakṣitā kārakavibhaktiḥ, iti ekahāyanī- saṃbandho'yamavasthitaḥ|
evamapi nopapadyate|
yadi kāra- kābhidhānaṃ avivakṣitaṃ iti aruṇāśabdena etena dravyama- bhidhātumiyate, tadā prātipadikārthasya avyatirekaḥ iti prathamā vibhaktiḥ prāpnoti|
na hi tṛtīyāntaḥ tamabhi- saṃbandhaṃ śaknoti vaktum|
na ca anyathā'nupapattiḥ, iti anyo'sya anupapadyamāno'rthaḥ śakyate kalpayitum|
yathā 'agnau tiṣṭhati māṇavakaḥ' ityukte jvalane anupa- padyamānaḥ nāśve gavi vā kalpyate, abhisamīpavacanaḥ evādhyavasīyate, tadadihāpi apramathyataḥ śabdaḥ na kathaṃ cidapi atirikte prātipadikārthe bhavitumarhati|
tasmāt kāmaṃ anarthako''gampatāṃ, nāsya ekahāyanī- saṃbandho'vaśyasatyaḥ|
vā-- (pṛ. 686) tatrāpi agastyaiva pratyavasthānaṃ 'nanu guṇasya kriyāsaṃbandhābhāvāt' iti|
tasyottaraṃ tṛtīyārthakatvaprasaṅgāditi|
nahi agastyā anabhidheyo'rthaḥ śakyaḥ|
prayetum|
na cātra lakṣaṇāyā'pi sakṛddvitīyā- vat tṛtīyā arthavatī kārakasāmānyāsyāpi aniṣṭatvāt|
bhā-- (pṛ. 687) āha, na brūmo na kārakaṃ aruṇāśabdena abhidhīyate iti|
vyaktaṃ aruṇāguṇa- viśiṣṭaṃ etena kārakaṃmabhidhīyate|
kadā cit ki cit vidhivisataṃ bhavati, kadā cit upasarjanabhūta'rtho vidhivisataḥ, pradhānībhūto'nuvādaḥ|
tadyathā 'daṇḍī' iti upasarjanabhūtadaṇḍapuruṣapradhānakaḥ śabdo'gamyate, kadā cit nirjāte puruṣe daṇḍaguṇavidhānārthamucāryate 'daṇḍī prapānavanāha' iti|
yathā 'lohitoṣṇīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' iti|
evaṃ ihāpi yadi upasarjana- bhūtaḥ aruṇī guṇaḥ, pradhānabhūtaṃ kārakaṃ, tathāpi anū- dite kārake aruṇāguṇavidhānārthaṃ vacanaṃ yujyate|
tasmāt ekahāyanīsaṃbandhaḥ upapadyate nāsti vākyabheda iti|
naitat sāram|
atra hi ekahāyanīkrīṇātyoḥ anava- buddhaṃ saṃbandhaṃ bodhayituṃ ayaṃ ekahāyanīśabda uccāritaḥ|
sa eṣa kathamiva aruṇāśabdena saṃbadhyate|
tadetadabhihita- mapi punaḥpūnaḥ paryanuyujyate|
( ekahāyanīśabdya krīṇātinā anvayaḥ na aruṇāśabdena|
) kathaṃ punaḥ ekahāyanīśabdasya krīṇātinā aruṇāguṇena ca samāne samabhivyāhāre, krīṇā- tinā saṃbandho'pyupagamanīyaḥ, na punaḥ aruṇākhyena iti|
śabdaprāmāṇyāt|
bhavati hi kriyāsaṃbandhasya vācikā vibhaktiḥ|
ekahāyanīśabdamanu niviṣṭā, na tu guṇasaṃbandhasya vācikā|
kā punaḥ kriyāsaṃbandhasya vācikā, kā vā guṇasaṃbandhasyeti? kārakalakṣaṇā kriyāsaṃbandhe vivakṣite bhavati dvitīyādiḥ|
avivakṣite
punaḥ kārake saṃbandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī|
na cātra ṣaṣṭhī paśyāmaḥ|
paśyāmastu khalu tṛtīyām|
ataḥ krīṇātinā saṃbandhamabhyupagacchāmaḥ|
ekahāyanīśabdaḥ, na aruṇā- śabdena iti|
kathaṃ tarhi bhavati atra saṃbandho nīla- mutpalamiti|
ucyate|
bhavati, na tu śrutilakṣaṇaḥ, kiṃtu vākyalakṣaṇaḥ|
upalakṣaṇaśabdasaṃnidhāne tadapekṣo nīlaśabdaḥ tena ekavākyatāṃ abhyupagacchan na ajahatsvārthavṛttiḥ upalakṣaviśeṣābhidhānaparaḥ uccāryamāṇaḥ saṃbandhamabhyupaiti|
nanu ihāpi vākyalakṣaṇaḥ taddeva aṣṭaminā samaṃ saṃbandhaḥ ekahāyanyā yujyate|
neti brūmaḥ|
śrutirhi vākyāt balīyasī|
śrutiśca kriyāsaṃbandhamāha, na guṇasaṃbandham|
yadi punaḥ śrutisāmarthyāt kriyāsaṃbandho'- bhyupagamyeta, ekavākyatvādāpi guṇasaṃbandhaḥ|
naivaṃ śakyam|
yo hi anyena saha saṃbandhamucyate, na tasmīpagato'pi anyaḥ tena saha saṃbandhamarhati|
yathā 'bhāryā rājaḥ puruṣo devadattasya' iti bhāryāviśeṣaṇārthaṃ uccāryamāṇo rājaśabdaḥ na puruṣeṇa saṃbadhyate|
tadviha kriyāviśeṣa- ṇārthaṃ uccāryamāṇa ekahāyanīśabdaḥ na aruṇāśabdena saṃbandhamarhati|
vā-- (pṛ. 687) parastu āha, liṅgasaṃkhyāvat āśrayadvārāt kārakamanupraviśya prātipadikārthā vidhyāsate iti|
asti hi etadapi darśanaṃ, yat guṇaśabdebhyo vinā'pi kārakatvena kārakaviśeṣaṇatvāt dvitīyādayo bhavantīti|
'naitat sāraṃ' iti|
yadyapi kathaṃ cit aruṇayā ityasya ekahāyanīsaṃbandhayogyatvaṃ, tathāpi kriyā''śritāyāmekahāyanyāṃ 'aikadhanye parārthavat' ( 1|4|18 ) ityevamabhyupasaṃbandhabhāve balīyasā kraya- saṃbandhena guṇasaṃbandhanirākaraṇam|
nahi atra kriyāsaṃbandha- vibhaktivat guṇasaṃbandhavibhaktiḥ ṣaṣṭhī dṛśyate|
nīlotpale tu śrutivirodhabhāvāt vākyalakṣaṇo'pi saṃbandho'vagamyate iti vaiṣamyam|
ye tu sāmānādhikaraṇyavikalpāḥ, tān ‘niyamo vaikāthyaṃ hi’ ( 6|8|10|35 ) ityatra paṭhā- nyādhikāre sūtre sarvānaiva vakṣyāmaḥ|
sarvathā lakṣaṇakaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ iti durbalam|
na ca kārakavibhakti- tvāt guṇānāṃ kārakavibhaktiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? kārakatvādeveti|
etadapi padekatvavivakṣādhikaraṇe ( 6|8|10|35 ) vakṣyate|
bhā-- (pṛ. 688) āha satyamevametat|
asa- tyāmākāṅkṣāyāṃ ānantaryamakāraṇam|
sarvatra tu bodhite padārthe vākyārtha upapadyate, nānyathā|
sāmānyavṛtti hi padaṃ, viśeṣavṛtti vākyam|
sāmānyena abhimṛṣṭānāṃ padārthānāṃ yadi śeṣe avasthānaṃ sa vākyārthaḥ|
tadetaduktaṃ ‘tadbhūtānāṃ kriyārthena samāmnāyo'rthasya tannimitta- tvāt’ ( 1|1|726 ) iti|
tatra pratyakṣaḥ padārthaḥ, vākyārthaḥ punarānumānikaḥ|
tadetadavagamyatāṃ, kevala- svārthavṛtti padaṃ anupadeśaṃ, iti padāntareṇa saṃnihitena ekavākyatvamabhyupaiti, nānyeti|
tadiha yadyapi atra hāyanīśabdaḥ: krīṇātinā saṃbadhyamānaḥ kṛtārtho na padānta- reṇa saṃbandhamākāṅkṣati, aruṇāśabdastu padāntareṇa saṃbandha- malabhamāno'narthakaḥ, iti ekahāyanīśabdena ekavākyatā- mabhyupaiti|
nanusaṃtaṃ kriyāsaṃbandhārtho nāruṇāsaṃbandhārthaḥ iti|
āha, aruṇāśabdasya anarthakyaparihārāya ubhayasaṃba- nyārtha iti vadāmaḥ|
anyārthamapi kṛtaṃ anyārthamapi śaknoti kartum|
tadyathā śālyarthe praṇīyante, tāmyaśca pānīyaṃ pīyate upagṛhyate ca|
evamihāpi krayasaṃbandhārthe ekahāyanīśabda uccāryamāṇaḥ aruṇā- śabdena saha saṃbandhasyate, na kiṃcit duṣyati|
tasmānna vākyabheda iti|
vā-- (pṛ. 688) ‘āha satyamevametaditi’ punarapi śrutivirodhaparihārārthameva yatate|
kathaṃ? ‘tantreṇo- bhayasaṃbandhe virodhaṃ prasadyate|
prāsaṅgike dvihai kasmin virodho bhaviṣyati|
’ ‘sarvatra tu bodhitaṃ padārthaṃ iti ko'yamupanyāsaḥ? ucyate|
‘sarvathā bādhitā tāvat padārthānāṃ svatantratā|
tenāneko- 'pi saṃbandhaḥ kalpyamāno na duṣyati|
’ aruṇā- śabdastāvata avaśyameva kena cit guṇinā saṃbandhanīyaḥ|
ekahāyanīśabdāpi kriyāsaṃbandhāt svātantryamapanītām|
tatra padāntarasaṃbandhe'pi ‘sakṛdvṛttyāḥ kimaguṇena’
itiyat tasya tāvatyeva śrutipīḍā, ityataḥ guṇapadenāpi saṃbandhyatāmiti|
( atha mukhyapūrvapakṣopanyāsaḥ:-) bhā-- (pṛ. 689) naitadasti|
yadyapi ayamaruṇāśabdaḥ anarthako mā bhūt iti ekahāyanyā saṃbadhyeta, tathāpi sarvasmin prakaraṇe niṣedhumarhati|
na ca enaṃ ‘somaṃ krīṇāti’ ityeṣa śabdaḥ śaknoti viśeṣitum|
nahi ayaṃ viśeṣaṇatvena uccāryate, kiṃ tarhi? apūrvo'yaṃ vidhīyate|
vā-- (pṛ. 689) ‘naitadasti’ iti abhyupetya dravyaguṇasaṃbandham|
ṛgatadravyasaṃbandhanirakaraṇāt ( na ) krīṇāteḥ|
vidhyanuvādaugapadyāccātravirodhaḥ|
yatra tu kriyāviśeṣaṇāni sarvāṇi bhavanti, tatra viśiṣṭavighā- nāt akleśo bhavati|
yatra tu kriyā vidhīyate dravyasya ca kiṃcit, tatra pratyayāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ vākyabhedamabhyupetya niyamābhāvo bhavati ityucyate|
viśeṣaṇaṃ hi prasiddhaṃ bhavati|
na ca vidhīyamānāvāsthaḥ krayaḥ prasiddhaḥ iti prakaraṇataikahāyanīmātrasaṃbhavaprasaṅgaḥ|
katamā punaranyā jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe ekahāyanī? sarvathā tāvat vākyena tasyāmapi guṇaḥ prāpyate, yadi tu sā na vidyate, kiṃ kriyatām|
dakṣiṇā tu vā kā cit bhavi- ṣyati|
anubrūyāyāṃ vā|
athavā uddiśyamānatvāt avidyaśaktilakṣaṇasakhyaikahāyanāmātragrahaṇāt savanīyāgrīpo- mīyorapi ekahāyanīyograhaṇādanīyam|
sadṛśyāyeṣu vā udāharaṇāntareṣu eva tat bhaviṣyati|
tadyathā ‘daśa- sudhīrmīmete’ ityatra somamānādapyevāmapi ahṛṣṭe- nirvāpapudīnāṃ daśasaṃkhyāvatprasaṅgaḥ|
bhā--(pṛ.690) nanu apūrvo'pi vidhīyamānaḥ: eka- hāyanīśabdavat itareṇa saṃbhantsyate|
katham? 1.prayojanāya hi uccāryamāṇaḥ śabdaḥ yena arthaḥ, tasmai tāvat prayoja- nāya avakalpyate, saṃnihitaśca buddhau bhavati|
tena buddhau saṃnihitena śakyate sākāṅkṣaḥ śabdaḥ saṃbandhayitumiti|
naitadevam|
yo hi asaṃbandhamāno'narthako bhavati sa saṃba- dhyate, nānyaḥ|
kuta etat? saṃbandhamāne hi sāmānyaṃ viśeṣe apratyāpyate|
tatra vākyena śrutiḥ pīḍitā syāt|
na cāyamasaṃbandhamānaḥ krīṇātinā, anarthako bhavati, prakaraṇagataiḥ abhisaṃbantsyate|
nanu etaduktaṃ prakaraṇe'pi asya saṃbandho'nupapanna iti|
nānupanaḥ|
ekasmin vākye anyonyo'rtho vidhīyamāno nānyena saṃbadhyate vacanavyakti- bhedāt|
anyā hi vacanavyaktiḥ: vidhīyamānasya, anyā guṇena saṃbandhamānasya|
aśātatvacca jñāyate vidhīyamāno- 'rthaḥ; jñātatvat anudyate guṇasaṃbandhārtham|
na ca sakṛduccā- ryamāṇo jñātatvat ajñātatvacca bhavitumarhati|
ekahāyanī- śabdaḥ kraye vidhīyamānaḥ: aśātatvacca syāt, aruṇā- śabdena saṃbandhamānaśca jñātatvat|
vākyabhede punarna doṣo bhavati|
prakaraṇe tu vākyāntaraiḥ kriyā dravyāntarāṇi ca prāptāni|
tairadi vākyāntaravihitaṃ saṃbadhyate|
tatra anya- smin vidhīyate, anyāsmin vākye anyadyate ityupapannaṃ bhavati|
tasmāt saṃyogato'viśeṣāt prakaraṇaviśeṣācca sarvasmin prakaraṇe dravyeṣu ( āruṇyasya ) niveśaḥ iti|
vā-- (pṛ. 690) paraḥ punaḥ: ekahāyanīcairu- pyābhyupagamavādalaghupadasaraḥ śaknute ‘nanu apūrvo'pi vidhīyamānaḥ: manasi viparivartamānaḥ: prasaṅgādeva viśeṣyate iti|
‘naitedevaṃ’ ityuttaram|
yāvadyāvat hi padārthau viśeṣyate tāvattāvat śruteḥ kharasabhaṅgaḥ|
tena ‘sakṛt pravṛttyāḥ: kimaguṇena’ ityevaṃ ekena kena cit viśeṣitaḥ: pareṇāpi viśeṣyatāṃ ityabhyupagantavyam|
na ca ānarthakyaṃ, prakaraṇe arthavatvāt|
tatrāpi evameva saṃbandha iti cet|
na|
vākyāntaraprāptadravyānuvādena guṇavidhau vairūpyaprasaṅgātvāt|
bhavapakṣe'pi svarūpataḥ, somaṃ ca prati kraye vidhīyamāne, dravyaṃ ca prati viśeṣaṇatvena anudyamāne vairūpyaṃ bhavati|
evaṃ eka- hāyanīpi krayaṃ guṇaṃ ca prati vairūpyāt naiva saṃbadhyate|
pūrve tu abhyupetyavādamātreṇa aṅgīkṛtam|
tadidānīṃ tatraiva parasya duṣṭā mā bhūt iti nirākriyate|
tena ayame
nyāyasya ca krayāṅgakatvāya upapannatvena pūrvapakṣa- mūlābhāvaprasaṅgāt upekṣaṇīyam |
tasmāt pūrvaiṇa nayena kṛtsne prakaraṇe (āruṇyasya) niveśa iti (pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ) |
bhā— (pṛ. 611) evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ |
arthe- katve dravyaguṇayoraikakarmyābhidhānam |
satya iti |
yatra arthaikatvaṃ śrūyate dravyaguṇayoḥ, tatra dravyaguṇau ekasmin padārthe niyamyetātām |
kutaḥ ? aikakamyāt ekakārya- tvāt |
ekaṃ hi kāryaṃ dravyaguṇayoḥ śrūyate krayasaṃbandhaḥ |
kathametadavagamyate ? ekavākyatāt ? kathamekavākyatvaṃ ? aruṇyā pijñākhyā ekahāyanā iti aparyavasito'rthaḥ sākāṅkṣatvāt abhidhātāpratipannoḥ |
somaṃ krīṇāti iti tu paryavasyati, tayoreva nairapekṣyatvāt |
vā— (pṛ. 611) evaṃ prāpte'bhidhīyate |
‘yatra dravyaguṇaikatve śravaṇādeva gamyate |
anyo- nyaniyamastatra tayoḥ satyādiāvad bhavet |
’ ‘arthaikatvaṃ’ iti vākyaviśeṣopalakṣaṇam |
‘aika- kamyāt’ iti punastadeva hetutvena upadiṣṭam |
athavā vākyārthaikatve eva ekavākyatā saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ |
tatra sarva- viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaikabhāvanāvidhiḥ, tādṛśīṃ kṛtvā kṛtārtho bhavati iti parigrahāt sarvaniyamo bhavati |
yathā ‘deva- dattaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ odanaṃ pacati’ ityukte sarveṣāṃ ekapākaviṣayatvam |
evamihāpi kevalasyāvat dravya- guṇayoranuṣṭhānameva nāsti iti na vidhīyate |
kriyā- ntarasaṃbandhamapi śrīṇāte : paraḥ pratyayo na śaknoti kartum |
dravyasaṃbandhe tu sarvatra vidhīnāmeva śakya- bhāvaḥ |
sarvatra hi bhāvanāviśeṣaṇasyātirike'rthe vidhi- vyāpāro nāsti iti uttarādhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |
tṛtīyā- nirdeśācca dvayorapi aruṇaikahāyanāyoḥ parasparamapekṣya svasādhyakriyāmātrāpekṣiṇoḥ vākyena taddeśeṣarūpasaṃbandho vijñāyate |
kutaḥ ? kārakaṃ śrutyate kutraikriyā kartuṃ karoti ca |
tasmāt dravyasaṃbandhaḥ kārakasyāsti kasya cit |
niṣpannatvāviśeṣānna nāpekṣeṣāṃ parasparam |
guṇānāṃ ca padārthatvātsaṃbandhaḥ samatvataḥ (3|1|13) |
na cāpyanyonyasaṃbandhe vidhireṣāṃ pravartate |
tadgītā vayaṃ ceti kriyāsaṃbandhakalpanā |
kriyā'pi na vinā kaiścit sādhyate kārakaḥ ka cittu |
bhūtabhavyavaśatavena kriyākārakasaṃgatiḥ |
yathā ca dravyamicchanti sādhakatvena karmaṇām |
tathā guṇama- pītyevaṃ nāraṇyasyāpyanyasaṃgatiḥ |
yathaiva dravyena vinā kriyā'nupapatteḥ ekahāyanī krayo gṛhṇāti ‘tathā guṇa- viśeṣeṇa dravyaṃ yāvadalakṣitam |
tāvattena kriyāsi- dvinirvāsyate'pekṣyate guṇaḥ |
’ tasmāt so'pi kriyā- jhamiti |
tathā ca ‘dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣu’ (3|1|13) iti guṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam |
nanu nāntarīyakatayā dravyagrahaṇe guṇānu- ṣṭhānāt pṛthak prayatnābhāvāt na dravyavata guṇāpekṣā tathāhi ‘na dravyamanupādāya pravṛttiḥ karmaṇīdhyate |
pūrve dravye gṛhīte tu tadguṇo'pyanubadhyate |
’ ucyate |
‘kamaṇyapi kṛte pūrvaṃ na dravyeṇa prayojanam |
dravyākāṅkṣā'tha pūrvaṃ syāt sā guṇe'pi pratīya- tām |
’ yathaiva hi tayordravyagrahaṇena guṇo'pi kaścit gṛhīta eveti na pṛthagupādānaṃ prayojayati, tathā kriyāpādāne'pi yatkiṃcit dravyamupāttaṃ iti nāpekṣitavyaṃ, (dravyamapi) |
atha tu prāgupādānāt dravyaviśeṣāpekṣā bhavati, tat itaratrāpi prāk dravyopādānāt bhavetvāpekṣā ‘kiṃguṇakaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhṇāmi’ iti |
sarvathā tu etāvānatra viśeṣaḥ, praśnānottarakālamapi kriyāyāṃ dravyaṃ vyāpyate, guṇastu prajñānāt na pṛthak dravyavyatirekeṇa vyāpyate, tāvattaiva caritārthatvāt |
na ca tathā vyāāpyatasya anyā- putatvaṃ, anekaprakāratvāt vyāpārāṇām |
pariccheda- kāle tu asya (guṇasya) adhikavyāpāratvaṃ viviccyate |
tathāhi ‘dravyeṇa sādhanīyayemita jñātā yadā kriyā |
kīdṛśateneyapekṣā'syā guṇe'pyeṣyate tadā |
’ tenātra yadi tāvat veda evaṃ kaṃ cidviśeṣaṃ dāsyati, tataḥ tena ityavadhārayiṣyate |
yadi tu na dāsyati, tataḥ arthāśrita eva yaḥ kaścit pramāṇavān bhaviṣyati ityayagame sati vidhīyamānasya aruṇaderaṅgasya bhavati |
sarvatra ca śabdāt acodite'rthe ‘arthādvā kalpanedeśāt’ (1|4|14 25) ityevaṃ ajñānasaṃgrahasyudāsa dṛṣṭaḥ ‘aruṇatvena kriyā sādhyate’ iti vispaṣṭe codite, śabdāntarāt abhyāhārādīnāṃ abhāvāt ‘yathā śaknuyāt’ ityupapanthe
sati ‘tatsādhanabhūtaṃ dravyaṃ paricchindatā’ ityetāvadava- dhāryate |
kutaḥ ? ‘guṇānāmevamātmatvaṃ sarvatra śrava- dhāritam |
nānayathā, niṣkrayatvācca viśeṣevamanu- grahāt |
’ krayagatastāvat vidhiḥ tṛtīyopanīta kathaṃ cida- ruṇimānaṃ na muñcati |
sa ca nānyena prakāreṇa tadaṃśatvaṃ bhajate |
na ca akhaṇḍarūpaiva sarveṣāṃ sādhanatā |
na ca svasama- vāyinyeva kevalā calanāmrikā vā kriyā sarvatreṣyate |
na ca pradhānakriyāyāḥ |
sarvatraiva sākṣāt sādhanāni bhavanti, avāntaravyāpārādhīnatvāt saṃbandhasya |
arūṇā- dīnāṃ ca yogyatvāt dravyapariccheda eva svavyāpāre vijñāyate, tatra eṣāṃ kartṛtvāt |
itaratra karaṇatvaṃ bhavi- ṣyati |
tena arūṇapadāt etāvadavagataṃ ‘kiṃcit dravyaṃ paricchindatā arūṇaguṇena krayaḥ sādhyitavyaḥ’ iti |
tathā ekahāyinyā'pi anyathā sādhanatvasaṃbhāvanāt ‘kena cit guṇena me paricchedaḥ kartavyaḥ’ ityetāvadapekṣyate |
tatra guṇaḥ yatkiṃcit dravyaṃ paricchedyaṃ āśratvena ape- kṣitaṃ ārabhate, dravyamapi yaṃ kaṃ cit guṇam |
ubhayā- pekṣāllakṣaṇa saṃbandhaḥ śīghraṃ nirvatyate |
na ca dvayantara- guṇānāṃ atra vākye sāpekṣatvaṃ pratīyate |
tena nagnāśvadravyatvat vinā'pi panthā anayoreva saṃbandhaḥ |
saṃdihitātikramakāraṇābhāvādvāpya evageya vijñāyate |
kiṃca ‘krayaśravāgatadravyaguṇaḥ prādhānyasaṃmataḥ |
ani- cchannaścatraṃ ca cit guṇaṃ dravye niyacchati |
’ yat nāma guṇaḥ anyathānupapatteraśrutaṃ dravyamānayati, tathā ekahāyanīṃ ca śrutaṃ aśrutamānayati, tamapi kraya eva śrutāguṇamiguṇatvāt necchati |
yadi hi asau aniyatadravyaguṇaḥ syāt, tato yatkiṃcidapi ānīyamānaṃ saṃheta |
nirapekṣadravyaguṇaviśeṣādeva naiva yathācoditaḥ kraya ubhayaviśeḥ kriyeta, aśrutā ca pradhānasya sata āvṛttirāpadyeta |
vikalpe vā punaḥ viśiṣṭavidhiācyate |
pradhānatvādeva ca guṇadvayasya dravyāntaraguṇānākṣepa krayaṇaṃ niruṇddhi |
kāsyabhojinyāyena vā amuka'pi aniyamaṃ vārayet, kimuta mukhya eva san |
na ca aśruta- kalpanā vinā anupapattiḥ, śrutayoreva parasparasaṃbandhena paripūrṇatvāt |
evaṃ ca svavākyagatamapi sāmānādhi- karaṇyaṃ samarthayitaṃ bhaviṣyati |
na cātra śrutivirodhaḥ, yathā vakṣyati ‘na śrutibhūte vākyārtho na’ iti |
tathāhi |
‘krayāpekṣita evāyaṃ saṃbandhaḥ kriyate punaḥ |
na cātrā- nuguṇā vṛttirdurbalā'pi virudhyate |
’ kraya eva hi dravyaṃ gṛhṇan evamapekṣate ‘ko guṇa etat paricchetsyati’ iti, guṇamapi gṛhṇan apekṣate, ‘kiṃ dravyaṃ etasya āśrayo bhaviṣyati’ iti |
tenaiva tayoḥ krayavaśena anyonyānuguṇyaṃ pratipadyamānayorepi na parasparajñājñatvaṃ bhavati |
yastu manyate paricchedakatvāt guṇasya dravyājñatvaṃ pratīyate iti, sa vaktavyo guṇasyāpi krayamanyathā sādhayitumaśakyataḥ dravyaṃ āśratvaṃ pratipadyamānaṃ añjamiti |
tasmāt krayāṅgabhūtayoreva nāntarīyaḥ parasparapakāro bhavann añjatvamāpādayati iti draṣṭavyam |
yastu prakaraṇe niveśaṃ manyate, tasya kena guṇe vidhīyate iti vaktavyam |
krayavidhinā tāvat saha naiva saṃbandha iṣṭaḥ |
prayogavacanastu kriyātmakaṃ dūrapāpekṣate |
na ca aruṇapadasya evaṃvidhiśaktirasti |
yadyapi kārakatvena dravyāṇi pratīyante, tathāpi tatpadānyavidhāyakavākyeva |
ye'pi tatsaṃbandhakriyāviṣayā vidhayaḥ, te'pi paryavasitāḥ |
saṃprati pratīyamānā api na vidhātuṃ samarthāḥ |
na caiṣāṃ dravyaviśeṣaṇapu vyāpāraḥ |
tasmānna kathaṃ cit prakaraṇe niveśate ‘ekārthāstu vikalperan’ (12|1|4|10) i
viruddham |
na ca vikalpaḥ, ekaṃ kāryaṃ, sāmarthyabhedastu |
sākṣāddhi dravyaṃ kriyāṃ prati upakaroti, guṇastu viśinaṣṭi sādhanam |
yadi evaṃ, na tarhi guṇaḥ kriyāmabhinirvartayati, sādhanasyāsau viśeṣaka iti |
naitadevam |
guṇasya kriyā- mabhinirvartayata etadeva sāmarthyaṃ, yat sādhanaṃ viśinaṣṭi ! ākāṅkṣati ca kriyā sādhanaviśeṣaṇam |
cihnabhūto hi guṇaḥ sādhanaṃ lakṣayati |
asati cihne na lakṣyeta katamat sādhanaṃ kriyāyāḥ iti |
tataḥ kriyāṃ nādhyavasyeyaṃ kartuṃ, iti bhavati kriyāsādhanaṃ guṇaḥ |
na caivaṃ sati vikalpo bhavati, yathā adhikaraṇasya kartrādīnāṃ ca |
adhikaraṇaṃ hi kartrādīni dhārayati |
tāni adhāryamāṇāni na śaknuvanti kriyāmabhinirvartayitum |
tathā kartā kartrādīni samā- datte, tāni asamāhitāni na śaknuvanti svasvamarthamabhi- nirvartayitum |
yasmistu sādhanopakāre kāryaṃ tasminneva- pakāre anyat sādhanaṃ vidhīyate, tatra vikalpaḥ |
yathā 'brīhibhiryajeta' , 'yavairyajeta' iti |
ubhaye'pi taṇḍulanirvṛtyarthāḥ |
vā-- (pṛ. 614) avāntaravyāpārānekāryatvama- gṛhītvā vadati 'yathaikakāryatā kimiti vikalpo na bhavatīti' |
siddhāntavādī tu āha, naitena asamarthati- pakṣaḥ |
kṛtsnaprakaraṇaniveśaḥ sidhyati, krayasaṃbandho vā bādhyate |
tasmāt siddhāntāntaradūṣaṇatvāt nigrahasthāna- miti |
'na ca vikalpaḥ nānākāryātvāt' iti avā- ntaravyāpārābhiprāyeṇa |
parastu pradhānakāryanātmamevoktaṃ iti matvā āha 'nanu idānīmevoktaṃ' iti |
'tathāpi- viruddhaṃ' yat pūrvamukte amṛtatvāt niṣkiyo guṇa iti |
nanu pūrvapakṣavādinā taduktaṃ, idānīṃ siddhāntavādī na sakriyaṃ bravīti iti yukto viropopanyāsaḥ |
ucyate 'saṃdehaḥ kriyate sarvaiḥ sādhāraṇapade sthitaḥ |
tatra cāmūrtetaveti siddhānte'pi virudhyate |
' athavā pūrvapakṣavādinā tat hetutvena uktam |
hetuśca ubhayasiddho bhavati |
yadi cāyaṃ asiddho bhavet tataḥ tadānīmeva udbhāvyeta |
yatastu nodbhāvitaḥ, tato- 'bhyupagataḥ |
tathā cedānīṃ siddhavat arthakyābhi- dhānāt sakriyatvaṃ abhidadhato vipratiṣiddhamāpadyate |
'naitadviruddhaṃ, na ca vikalpaḥ' iti śaktibhedanimittā- vāntaravyāpārānāntvāt |
taddarśayati, dravyaṃ sākṣāt sādhanaṃ, guṇastatparicchedārtha iti |
parastu etāvattat 'itarat tadarthaṃ' itivat guṇasya dravyārthatvaṃ manyamāna āha 'yathaivaṃ na tarhi' (guṇaḥ kriyāmabhinirvartayati iti) |
'naitadevaṃ' iti dvāramātratvaṃ tāvat dravyasya darśayati |
bhā-- (pṛ. 616) evaṃ tarhi tadevaṃ saṃjātaṃ, bhavati ekahāyanīvidhānaṃ, tadviśeṣaṇaṃ ca aruṇo guṇaḥ |
tatra sa eva doṣo vākyabhedaḥ prasajyeta iti |
na brūmaḥ aruṇādravyaṃ ekahāyanīśabdena saṃśravyate iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? krīṇātinaiva saṃśravyate |
evaṃ hi śrūyate aruṇaguṇena krayaṃ abhinirvartayet iti |
yathā ca tena nirvartyate tathā yati- tavyaṃ bhavati |
na ca aviśiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ guṇaḥ kriyāṃ abhinirvartayati, iti arthāt sādhanaviśeṣaṇāṃ prati- padyate |
yathā 'syālyāṃ pacet' iti kriyāsādhanatve nirdiṣṭe arthāt saṃvapane dhāraṇe ca syālīṃ vyāpārayati, tadihāpi dravyam |
tasmāccāsti vākyabhedaprasaṅga iti |
vā-- (pṛ. 619) paricchede doṣadvaye vastuvṛttaṃ ekahāyanīdvāratvaṃ apaśyan vākyenaiva dvāradārisaṃndhakara- pāt vairūpyāpattiṃ codayati 'evaṃ tarhi' iti |
'na brūmaḥ aruṇāśabdaḥ' iti sāmarthyakāritaṃ ekahāyanī- saṃśravaṃ darśayati |
bhā-- (pṛ. 616) nanu evamapi vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
kathaṃ ? pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptirdṛṣṭā iti |
yathā 'deva- dattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā bhojyantāṃ' iti pratyekaṃ bhujiḥ samāpyate |
yathā ca 'yasya pitā pitāmahaḥ somaṃ na pibet' iti |
evamihāpi 'aruṇayā krīṇāti, eka- hāyanyā krīṇāti' iti |
naitadasādhyasya bādhakam |
evamapi kraye eva aruṇāmā niveśayati, na sarvasmin prakaraṇe iti |
vā-- 'nanu evamapi vākyaṃ bhiyeta iti niyama- nirākaraṇārthāmāha |
satyapi krayasaṃbandhe pratikārakaṃ kriyānya- tvāt arthabhedanimitto vākyabhedaḥ asatyeveti |
tathā ca lokavedayordṛṣṭaṃ iti udāharaṇadvayam |
pratyekaṃ devadattādiṣu bhojanaṃ, pituḥ pitāmahasya vā asomapatvaṃ prātyapaśo-
nimittatvena ucyamānaṃ sāhityavivakṣayā siddham |
tatra na pinet iti saṃbandhaḥ |
'naitadasādhyasya bādhakaṃ' iti vikalpapakṣadeva asaṃbandhopanyāsaḥ |
bhā-- (pṛ. 616) satyameṣa doṣo na bhavati kiṃtu anaruṇayā'pi ekahāyanyā krayaḥ prāpnoti, aru- ṇayā ca anekahāyanyā |
tatra yaduktaṃ dravyaguṇayorniyama iti sā pratijñā hīyate |
na tarhi brūmo vākyabheda iti |
kathaṃ ? krayasya hi dravyāruṇimānau upadiśyete na krayastayoḥ |
na ca pradhānaṃ pratiguṇaṃ midyate, pratipradhānaṃ hi guṇe midyate iti |
asita cāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ samudāye vākyapari- samāptiriti, yathā 'gargāḥ śata daṇḍayantāṃ' iti |
tathā 'abhiputya hutvā bhakṣayanti' iti |
tasmāt ubhaya- viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ krayo vidhīyate |
kathaṃ punastasmin itarasmin dṛṣṭānte sati ekāntena avadhāryate samudāye eva vākyasamāptiḥ, na pratyayavamiti |
atra brūmaḥ |
iha dravyāruṇimānau ubhāvapi kriyāsaṃbaddhau upalabhyete paraspareṇa asaṃbaddhau |
krayo'pi dravyāruṇimabhyāṃ viśiṣṭa upalabhyate, nānyatareṇa |
tatra yadi dravyaparaṃ aruṇimamaparaṃ ca bhavati vacanamidaṃ, tataḥ pratyayavayaṃ asaṃśayaṃ kraya- saṃbandhaḥ |
atha krayavidhisyā abhidhīyate, tato yathaivāyaṃ ekahāyanīviśiṣṭaḥ, evaṃ aruṇamaviśiṣṭaḥ, iti niyamataḥ ubhayasaṃbandho'bhyupagamanīyaḥ |
na cātra dravyāruṇimānau īpsitau |
īpsitastu krayaḥ |

vāla. pṛ. 30, arthavādakalpo vidhi- dvividhaḥ svatantrārthavādakalpyaḥ vidhvantaraśepārthavāda- kalpyaśca |

paruktikalpyo yathā 'tābhyāmeta- mamīpomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ pūrṇamāse prāyacchat' iti kriyāyāṃ kartṛtvena anuṣaṅgāt |

tathā paridevanasarūpaḥ- yāvajjīvādhikāraṇe vārtike 'āhitāgnivā eṣa san agnihotraṃ juhoti na darśapūrṇamāsau yajate yā āhutibhājo devatāstā anyāyāyinīḥ karoti' iti paridevanasarūpaḥ |
arthavādaḥ ityuktam |
(atra vārtikapaṅktistha 'āhi- tāmirvā eṣa san dīkṣatasa dānādau niṣiddhe vidhva- ntaraśobhataḥ paridevanasarūpārthavādo bhavati' iti |
pṛ. 629) |
praiṣaḥ-- 'amṛtaḥ somamāhara' iti |
anveṣaṇaṃ- 'iha vā saḥ, iha saḥ' iti |
praśnaḥ- 'veda karṇa- vatī sūrmī' iti |
prativacanaṃ-- 'vidmo vai' iti |
anupaṅgaḥ-- 'yadastana kaṇḍūyeta pāmanabhātukāḥ prajāḥ syuḥ, yat satye namaṃbhātukāḥ, kṛṣṇavipāṇayā kaṇḍūyeta' iti |
iha nabhaṃbhātukāḥ ityatra prajāḥ syuḥ ityanuṣaṅgaḥ |
iti karikaraṇabahuḻaḥ-- 'utsṛjyā''sa notsṛjyā''sa iti mīmāṃsante brahmavādinaḥ tadāhuḥ (tat u āhaḥ) utsṛjya- meveti, amāvāsyāyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ cotsṛjyamityāhu- rete hi yajñaṃ vahata iti, te tvāva notsṛjyamityāhuḥ ye āvāntaraṃ yajñaṃ mejāte' iti |
ityāhopaniṣadaḥ-- 'devasya tvā savituḥ prasave iti spamadatte prasave' iti itividhivaikāryaśeṣaḥ |
'aśvinorvāhubhyāmityāha, aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstāṃ, pūṣṇo hastābhyā- mityāha yaccai' iti |
ākhyānakārūpaḥ- 'puruṣaṃ vai devāḥ paśumālabhanta tasmādālabhyānmedha udkrāmat so'śvaṃ prāviśata, tasmādaśvo medho'śvamedhastasmānmedhamayārjata sa kiṃpuruṣo'bhavat te'śvamālabhanta so'śvā- dālabhyādudakāmata sa gāṃ prāviśata' ityādi |
hetuva- nigadāḥ- 'śaryeṇa juhoti' ityasya vidhivaikāryaśeṣaḥ 'tena hyaṃ kriyate' iti |
nirvacanarūpaḥ-- 'tadena- madhināt tadabhno dadhitvaṃ' iti |
nindā'rthavādaḥ-- 'na brahmā sāmāni gāyati' iti niṣedhārthavādaḥ |
'upavītā vā etasmāyaḥ' iti |
praśaṃsā- 'vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā' iti |
yadyapi nindā'rthavadyatirikteṣu sarveṣvapi arthavādeṣu praśaṃsā'rthatvamaviśiṣṭaṃ, tathāpi vāyupraśaṃsadvārā vidheyavāyavyapaśuyāgapraśaṃsā itaratra tu na tathā iti bhedaḥ |
saṃśayārthavādaḥ-- 'hotavyaṃ gārha- patye na hotavyaṃ' iti |
vidhikalpakaḥ-- 'yajña- mānasaṃmitataudumbarī bhavati' iti |
parakṛtiḥ-- 'iti ha smāha baṭukurmāṇipāneva mahaṃ pacata' iti 'tasmādāraṇyamevāśrīyāt' ityasya vidhivaikāryaśeṣaḥ |
purākalpaḥ- 'ulmukaiḥ sa pūrvaṃ samājamṛtānasurā rakṣasi nijainuḥ' iti 'tasmād gṛhapatevāmiṣu nimethya nirvaperan' iti
puroḍāśatvajātimātrāprāpakaḥ |
idamapi 'saṃdigdheṣvākya- śeṣāt' (1|4|19-29) iti nyāyādeva siddham |
jātividhirūpaḥ— 'tāvatanmāmagrīśomāvājyasyaiva nāupāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti |
etadapi aprāpta- paurṇamāsīkālavidhiparatvāt na ājyatvajātividhiḥ kilu 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate yad dhruvāyāmājyaṃ' iti prātāyā upāṃśuyājadravyaparicchedakatvajāteranuvādaḥ ityuktaṃ daśame upopānye |
guṇavidhiḥ— 'sudhīrūpa- dadhāti' iti vārtikakṛnmate |
bhāṣyakṛt nopadhānamātra- vidhiḥ mantrānuvādaśca, kiṃtu upadhānamātravidhau doṣokteḥ mantramātravidhau doṣokteḥ viśeṣavidhau mukhyānāṃ sahiliṅgakānameva mantrāṇāṃ vidhiprasaktau 'yat saptadaśakā upadadhāti' iti vākyaśeṣāt gauṇyā saptadaśasaṃkhyāvidhiḥ |
tadetat spaṣṭīkaraṇā (bhūmā 1|4|12-13-5) bhaṭṭasomeśvaroktam |
guṇavidhi- sarūpaḥ— 'yadākapāle bhavati, gāyatryainaṃ brahmavarcasena punāti' ityasatsarvajātividhirūpatvāt |
tadidam vaiśa- narādhikaraṇe (1|4|12) |
kriyāvidhiḥ— mṛtāmihotre 'adhastāt samidhaṃ dhārayannanudravet' iti vidhervākya- śeṣaḥ 'upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti |
tatra tṛtīye (3|4|15) ukte, devebhyaḥ ityukteḥ daivāgnihotre jīva- dagnihotre uparidhāraṇasya kathaṃcidācārādinā aprāpteḥ hisaṃbadaparityāgena vidhiḥ kalpyate iti |
kriyāvidhi- sarūpaḥ— 'yo vidagdhaḥ sa nairṛto, yo'dṛtaḥ sa raudro, yaḥ śrutaḥ sa sadaivaḥ', tassādvidahatā śrapayitavyaḥ' sadaivalāya' iti darśapūrṇakaraṇārthāta vākyaṃ audumbarādhikaraṇe 'prakaraṇe ca saṃbhavannapakṣoṃ na kalpyate vidhyānarthakyaṃ hi taṃ prati' (1|4|24) iti sūtre bhāṣyakṛtā udāhṛtya 'vidhipakṣe tu yatra naiṛtastatra vidadhatā nīyeta' tathā sati prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate iti kriyāvidhinirbharastaḥ |
iti |
nimittavidhiḥ-- agre śrūyate 'yo vai saṃvatsaramaśvamedha- bhṛtvā''miṃ cinute yathā sāmi garmo vipadyate tādageva tadārtimācchet vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ purastānnirvapet' iti |
atra caturthe (4|1|6) 'vaiśvānarasya nityaḥ syāt' ityadhikaraṇe saṃvatsarabharaṇaṃ arthavādamātraṃ iti nityatā iti pūrvapakṣayitvā kartṛsamānādhikaraṇe yacchabdaḥ nimittatāṃ saṃvatsarabharaṇasya pratipādayati iti naimittiko vaiśvānara- yāgaḥ |
iti siddhāntam |
nimittavidhisarūpaḥ— jyotiṣṭome śrutaṃ 'yāṃ vā adhvaryuśca yajamānaśca devatāma- niritastasyā āvṛtyacce, yat prājāpatyaṃ dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇāti śāmyatyevainaṃ' iti |
'dadhigraho naimittikaḥ śrutisaṃyo- gāt' ityadhikaraṇe (4|1|5) devatantarāyo nimittaṃ yacchabdāt iti pūrvapakṣete siddhāntitaṃ akartṛsamānādhi- karaṇasya yacchabdasya nimittatāpratipādakatvābhāvāt artha- vādamātraṃ antarāyaśravaṇaṃ iti nityo dadhigrahaḥ |
iti |
kartṛvidhiḥ--- ṣaṣṭhe (6|1|1) caturhotṛsaṃjñakamantraiḥ puru- pārthatayā vihitā japā homāśca 'caturhotāraṃ prayuñjīta 'caturhotrā prajākāmo juhuyāt' ityatra pūrvapakṣitaṃ, homā āvahanīye kāryāḥ 'eṣā vā anāhitāmeḥ' ityartha- vādamātraṃ japastulyatārthaṃ, iṣṭiśabdena japokteḥ yaiṣā anā- hitāmeḥ kriyā japātmikā seṣṭiḥ iti |
siddhāntastu vacanānarthakyediṣṭivyalakṣaṇaparihārāya ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā anā- hitāmyāgnidvārā homātmakatvarkāḥ |
iti kartṛvidhi- sarūpaḥ--- ṣaṣṭhe (6|1|12) 'iti ha sbāha baṭukurvarṣi- rmāṣāneva madyaṃ pacata' iti vṛṣṇigauraiva māṣapākaḥ kartavyo nānyaiḥ |
iti pūrvapakṣayitvā nirastam |
tadidaṃ māṣapākavidhivikalpanāṃ kṛtvā cintitam |
kālavidhiḥ— 'tāvantāmagrīśomāvājyasyaiva nāupāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti |
tadetat daśame upopānye uktam |
kālavidhi- sarūpaḥ--- 'apahatapammāno vā ṛtava iti yadā ka cana kadā canopanamedyadādhītātha yajeta' ityasya śatapatha- vidheḥ śeṣaḥ |
tena na vasantavyatiriktaṛtuvidhivyati- ṣṭome, yadā ka cana iti vihita eva tadvidhisiddheḥ |
idaṃ ca pañcame (5|1|5) 'svakāle syādavamitaṣedhāt' ityadhikaraṇe tannarane yadā ka canetyādeḥ śatapathavākyasya jyotiṣṭome ṛtvantaravidhivokteḥ, taccheṣasya kāla- vidhirūpatvaṃ arthāduktam |
deśavidhiḥ-- tāṇḍake 'sarasvatyā vinaśane dīkṣante, adhvaryuḥ śamyāṃ parāsyati, sā yatra nipatā tadārṣapatyaḥ, tataḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat prakramān prakrāmati tadāhavanīyaḥ |
pratīpaṃ yanti, pūrveṇa pakṣas
arthavādabhedāḥ 639 arthavādādhikaraṇam
yanti, dṛṣṭavatyā apye aponaptrīyaṃ caruṃ nirupya yanti' iti vidhāya vākyaśeṣaḥ 'ṛtuścaraṇādiśadādhī- nāni sarasvatī vinaśanāt prākṣaḥ pralavaṇaḥ' iti |
sa sāvantaṃ deyaṃ yāne vidadhāti |
ata eva tanmūla upa saṃhṛtaṃ 'yadā plakṣaṃ pralavaṇamāgacchanti athotyānaṃ, prākṣaṃ pralavaṇamāgamāya amye kāmayeṣṭiṃ nirvapante, tasyāmbāṃ ca purvī ca dhenuke dattvā kārapacavaṃ prati yamunāmavabhṛtha- mabhyavayanti' iti |
vārtike tu catustriṃśadavanīnāni iti śrudantaraṃ vyākaraṇadhikaraṇe (3|4|8) uktam |
deśa- vidhisarūpaḥ— 'ṣaṭtriṃśatprakramā prācī, triṃśatpavane, caturviṃśatiḥ purastāt' iti saumikamahāvedimānavidheḥ vākyaśeṣaḥ 'iyati kṣayāmahave'syāṃ kartuṃ' iti tadetat 'cīkīrṣayā ca saṃyogāt' ityadhikaraṇe (3|1|3) tṛtīya bhaṭṭasomeśvaroktam |
niṣedhavidhiḥ— aitareya- brāhmaṇe hariścandropākhyāne 'hiraṇyakaśipāvāsina ādhve' iti hotṛkartṛkasya ṛtvarthasya 'putrakāmā hyākhyāpya- yeran' iti ca puruṣārthasya śaunaḥśepākhyānavidheḥ vākyaśeṣe 'niyoktāraṃ na vividuḥ' 'vivāsitāraṃ na vividuḥ' iti śāmimantrairlābhoktyā 'mahamaparaṃ śataṃ dattāhamenaṃ viśasiṣyāmi' iti ca lobhāt pravṛttyuktvā 'na hiṃsyāt' iti sāmānyaniṣedhaḥ ṛtvijāṃ svādhi- kārikaḥ; parādhikārikeṇa sāmākhyānikena kartṛmātra- tayā ṛtvijaḥ spṛśatā'pi anādhitaḥ pravṛtho'sti, ata eva tṛtīye 'śamitā ca śabdabhedāt' ityadhikaraṇe (3|1|13) vārtikakṛtā uktaṃ 'ata eva ārvijaṃ nindanti' iti, tathāpi viśeṣaniṣedho doṣopayogārtham arthavādeneti |
niṣedhavidhisarūpaḥ— 'atho khalvāha- ranāhutirvai jatilāśca gavedhukāśca' iti |
daśame hi anāhutiti nindyā niṣedhakalpanāṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā 'na hi nindaṃ nindituṃ pravartate api tu vidheyaṃ stotuṃ' iti śāstrāntarakaraṇe prasaṅgadakena nyāyena 'yat payasā'gnihotraṃ juhoti' iti payovidhiśeṣatvāt na niṣedhakalpanā iti siddhāntam |
saṃdigdhārthopā- dānanirṇāyakaḥ— 'sārasvatī bhavataḥ' iti vidhau 'etadvai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ yat sarasvatī sarasāṃśca' iti |
atra sarasvān devatā yasya asau sārasvataḥ, aparo'pi tathā, tataḥ sārasvataśca sārasvataśca sārasvatī, uta sara- svān devatā yasya ityekasmāditaḥ, aparaśca sarasvatī devatā yasya iti taddhitaḥ, tattayorekaśeṣaḥ iti saṃdigdhe kṣīpuṃsadevatya eva evāyaṃ na puṃdvayadevatyaḥ iti nirṇayaḥ asmādarthavādādbhavati |
tadetat pañcame 'mukhya- krameṇa vā''jñānāṃ' ityadhikaraṇe (5|1|7) śāstradīpikāyā- muktam |
saṃdigdhārthaśaktigrāhakaḥ-- 'yavamatībhi- rrirdumbarī prokṣati' iti vidhervākyaśeṣaḥ 'yadā vā anayā oṣadhayo mriyante athaite modamānā ichonti' iti |
taduktaṃ 'śāstraśca vā tannimittatvāt' ityadhi- karaṇe (1|3|6) |
upamānārthavādaḥ— 'yathā vai śyeno nipalādate evamayaṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ nipalādate yamabhiricarati dvayenena' iti |
taduktaṃ 'tadyapadeśaṃ ca' ityadhikaraṇe nāmadheyapāde (1|4|14) |
bāla. pṛ.
oṃ arthavādādhikaraṇam |
arthavandhyāyaḥ |
artha- vādaprāmāṇyādhikaraṇam ||
(arthavādapādasya viṣayaḥ kathyate) vā— 'siddha- pramāṇabhāvasya dharme vedasya sarvaśaḥ |
vidhyārtha- vādamantrāṇāmupayogo'dhuniocyate ||
' sāmānyataḥ prāmāṇye siddhe adhunā vibhajya viniyogaḥ prati- pādyate |
avadhṛtaprāmāṇyasya vā vedasya idānīṃ samastasya vidhyārthavādamantrāṇāmeva yathāvibhāgaṃ dharme prati upayogaḥ pratipādyate |
āmnāyasya kriyārthatvādarthaikyamatadarthānāṃ tasmādanityamucyate |
bhāṣyaṃ— 'so'rodīt yadarodīt tadrudrasya tvam' 'prajāpatirātmano vapāmudakhidat' 'devā vai devayajanamavyavasāya diśo na prājānan' ityevādīni samānāntāraḥ samāmananti vākyāni |
tāni kiṃ kaṃ ciddharmaṃ pramimate, uta na iti vicāraṇā |
tadabhi- dhīyate |
kriyā kathamanveṣṭā iti tadvituṃ samāmnātāro vākyāni samāmananti |
tat yāni vākyāni kriyāṃ
arthavādādhikaraṇam
nāvagamayanti kriyāsaṃbaddhaṃ vā kiṃcit, evameva bhūta- maye anvācakṣate, kaditavān rudraḥ, vapāmucchisde prajāpatiḥ, devā vai diśo na prajajñire ityevajātīya- kāni, tāni kaṃ dharmaṃ pramimīran ? athocyeta adhyā- hāreṇa vā, viparīṇāmena vā, vyavahitakalpatayā vā, vyavadhāraṇakalpatayā vā, guṇakalpatayā vā kaścidarthaḥ kalpyiṣyate iti, sa kalpyamānaḥ kaḥ kalpyeta ? rudraḥ kila roda, ataḥ anyenāpi roditavyam |
ucchisde ātmavapāṃ prajāpatiḥ, ataḥ anyo'pi ucchidet ātmano vapām |
devā vai devayajanakāle diśo na praśātavantaḥ, ataḥ anyo'pi diśo na prajānīyāt iti |
tathāśakyam |
iṣṭaviyogena abhihatena vā yat brāhmaṇamocanaṃ tat rodanaṃ ityucyate |
na ca tadvicchato bhavati |
na ca kaścit ātmano vapāṃ ucchiva tāmyau prahṛtya tat usthitena tūpareṇa paśunā yathuṃ śaknuyāt |
na ca devayajanādhyavasānakāle ke cit diśo muhyuḥ |
ata eṣāṃ anarthakyam |
tasmāt evaṃjātīyakāni vākyāni anitāni ityucyante |
yadyapi ca nityāni, tathāpi na nityamarthaṃ kurvanti iti |
sa eṣa vākyaika- deśasya ākṣepaḥ, na kṛtsnasya vākyasya |

naivam |

śubhācārakāle brāhmaṇaḥ, punaḥ aśubhācārakāle śūdra- atra utpādakajātismaraṇaṃ |
ayaṃ ca upāyāyotpādaka- |
iti anavasthitatvam |

grahādi kurvatāṃ yugapat brāhmaṇatvāgrāhaṇatvavirodhaḥ |

iti |

paunaruktyāt tarhi atra vicāritavyaṃ atha āha, |

divi' iti apratiṣedhabhāginamarthaṃ pratiṣedhati |
vijñā- vicāra iti |
stutyarthatā'pi ca asatyasya nāsti iti |

vyasthitameva |

thaimeva tat |
atha pramāṇaṃ, naiṣa virodho bhavati |

na caitathyaṃ, hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya cetayamiti |
vā-- trīṇyapi pṛthivyādivacanāni apratiṣedhabhābhi- namarthaṃ pratiṣedhanti |
antarikṣe divi ca tattvat aprati- tvāt pratiṣedhāviṣayatvam |
ataśca paryudāsitatvāt na paryudāsaḥ |
anantarikṣe hi divi ca pṛthivyāṃ nityaṃ cayanaṃ prāptaṃ iti tadvidhiranarthakaḥ |
athāpi nityānuvādaḥ, tathāpi akriyārthameva |
pṛthivīcayanapratiṣedhaparyudāsau tu cayanavidhyādhena aśakyau |
bādhe ca vidhānārtha- kyam |
vikalpe'pi pakṣe bādhaḥ |
kāmasaṃyogācca agre- rasyeva pākṣikatvam |
durlabhaśca pratiṣedhaḥ pṛthivīparatve sati cayanai kalpyatvāt |
etadevāsya svayamākulatvam |
vidhva- ntarameva 'hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya cetavyaṃ' 'iṣṭakābhiragniṃ cinute' etacca ākulayet |
prarocanābuddhistu naivopalabhyate |
anityasaṃyogāt |
bhāṣya-- anityasaṃyogaśca vedaprāmāṇye sati ' paraṃ tu śrutisāmānyānmātraṃ' (1|1|8|139) iti parihṛtaḥ |
idānīṃ vaidaikadeśānāṃ āśritānāṃ punarapīdakaḥ uttiṣṭhati ' varaḥ prāvāhāṇikāmayata' iti |
vā-- sarvopakhyeyaneṣu anyaparatvasaṃbhavatvāt svarūpa- pratipādanāt anityasaṃyogaḥ |
sa ca samastavedaprāmāṇye sati kathaṃcit anyathā nīyeta |
yadā tu yathaiva pramā- ṇānāṃ madhye śabdaḥ, tatrāpi ca vedaḥ pramāṇaṃ, tathaiva vede- 'pi vidhimātraṃ yuktvā kalpyate, tadā itarekadeśavat anilyārthaikadeśaprāmāṇyaṃ yathāśrutāgrahaṇāt āpannaṃ kiṃ nivābhyate |
tasmāt evamādīnāṃ anapekṣya artha adhyayana- mātrādeva phalaṃ kalpyam |
athavā yathā etāni upekṣā- phalāni tathā tadviparyaṃ pratyakṣamapi pratipattavyam |
atha kasmāt mantravat yathāprakaraṇaṃ prayogakāle na prayujyate, prayoga- sāmarthyābhāvāt |
nahi mantrāṇāṃ pāṭhamātreṇa viniyogaḥ; kiṃ tarhi tatsāmarthyāt |
na cātra tadasti |
athavā yathā teṣāṃ pūrvapakṣe kāryāntarābhāva rūpamātraṃ grahīṣyate tathā atrāpyastu |
yat sūtrakāraṇe anityatvamukte, tat prāmāṇyāpekṣayā, na aprayojyatvā |
vidhinā tvekavākyatvāt stutyarthena vidhīnāṃ syuḥ |
bhāṣya--idaṃ samāmnāyate ' vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta bhūtikāmaḥ, vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā, vāyumeva svena bhāga- dheyenopadhāvati, sa evainaṃ bhūtiṃ gamayati ' iti |
vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā ityatra yadyapi kriyā nāvagamyate kriyā- saṃbaddhaṃ vā kiṃcit, tathāpi vidhyuddeśena ekavākyatvāt pramāṇam |
' bhūtikāmaḥ ' ityevamanto vidhyuddeśaḥ, tena ekavākyabhūtaḥ ' vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā ' ityevamādiḥ |
kathamekavākyabhāvaḥ ? padānāṃ sākāṅkṣatvāt vidheḥ stuteśca ekavākyatvaṃ bhavati |
bhūtikāma ālabheta |
kasmāt ? yato vāyuḥ kṣepiṣṭhaḥ |
nāyamabhisaṃbandho viva- kṣitaḥ ' bhūtikāmena ālabhyaṃ ' iti |
kathaṃ tarhi ? ' ālabheta, yatastato bhūtiḥ ' iti |
bhidau imāvarthau, ubhayābhidhāne vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
kimarthā stuti- riti cet, kathaṃ roceta, nānuṣṭhīyeta iti |
nanu prāk stutivacanāt anuṣṭhānaṃ bhūtikāmāntāt siddhaṃ, stuti- vacanamanarthakam |
nahi |
yadā stutipadasannidhānaṃ tadā pūrveṇaiva vidhiḥ, yadā stutipadasaṃbandhaḥ, na tadā bhūtikāmāsya ālambho vidhīyate |
yathā paṭo bhavati iti, paṭa utpadyate ityarthaḥ; nirākāṅkṣaṃ ca pada- dvayam |
yadā ca tasminneva rakta iti aparaṃ śrūyate, tadā rāgasaṃbandho bhavatītyarthaḥ; bhavati ca raktaṃ prati ākāṅkṣā |
evaṃ yadā na stutipadāni vidhiśabdenaiva tadā prarocanā, yadā stutivacanaṃ tadā stavanena |
nanu evaṃ sati kiṃ stutivacanena, yasmin sati adhivāyakaṃ, mā bhūt tat, tadabhāve'pi pūrvavidhineva prarocyiṣyate iti |
satyaṃ, vinā'pi tena sidhyet prarocanaṃ, asti tu tat |
tasmin vidyamāne yo'rtho vākyasya, so'vagamyate |
stutiḥ prayo- janaṃ tayoḥ |
tasminvidyamāne vidhinā prarocanaṃ iti |
nanu saravapi stutipade pūrvasya vidhirūpatvāt vidhi- rabhipretaḥ syāt, na vivakṣyeta stutipadasaṃbandhaḥ |
āha, stutipade hi anarthakāni anabhivyañjanu sākāṅkṣāṇi |
bhavantu anarthakāni iti cet, na gamyamāne'rthe avi- vakṣitārthāni bhavitumarhanti |
yo'sau vidhyuddeśaḥ, sa
śaknoti nirapekṣaḥ arthe vidhātuṃ, śaknoti ca stutipadānāṃ vākyaśeṣī bhavitum |
pratyakṣaṃ vākyaśeṣabhāvaḥ |
ataḥ asmāt vidheḥ stutimavagacchāmaḥ |
nanu nirapekṣādapi vidhivagamyiṣyāmaḥ |
bhavatyevaṃ, naivaṃ sati kaścit virodhaḥ |
kiṃtu aśakyaḥ stutipadasaṃbandhe sati vidhyartho vivakṣita- tum |
vākyaṃ hi saṃbandhasya vidhāyakam |
dvau cet saṃbandhau vidadhyāt ' bhūtikāma ālabheta ' ' ālambhena ca eṣa guṇe bhaviṣyati ' iti, bhidyeta tarhi evaṃ sati vākyam |
atha yaduktaṃ na kriyā gamyate, na tatsaṃbaddhaṃ vā kiṃci- diti, ' stutyarthena vidhīnāṃ syuḥ ' |
stutiśabdāḥ stuvantaḥ, prarocayamānāḥ anuṣṭhātṝn, upakariṣyanti kriyāyāḥ |

tasmāt 'nāyamabhisaṃbandho vivakṣitaḥ' ityādi- bhāṣyaṃ evaṃ netavyaṃ, na pūrvatraiva sāṅgavidhiparyavasānaṃ vica- kṣitaṃ, vidhitvāddāraprarocanākalpanāyāṃ atigaurava- nimittāt vākyabhedāt |
'kimarthā stutiḥ' iti pūrvai- ṇaiva prarocanā'pi siddhā ityabhimānāt |
'kathaṃ roceta' iti vidhnugrahakathanam |
'nanu prāk' iti pūrvami- prāyavivaraṇam |
'nahi' iti, stutyābhāve tasya śakti- dvayaṃ agatyā ādhīyate, na saṃvandhyantyāpi ityetat, tadā bhūtikā masya vidhiḥ samāpyate ityāha |
'yathā paṭaḥ' iti gatārtham |
'vidhiśabdena tadā prarocanā' iti vivṛtaṃ kāryanānātvaṃ vidhisutyoḥ |
'nanu evaṃ' iti asti cet prarocayitumapi śaktiḥ, kasmādanyat apekṣyate iti |
'satyaṃ' iti, tasmāt vidyamāne tasmin, na avi- dyamāne yo'rthaḥ sa gamyate |

nahi nirvi- payā stutirupāpadyate |

'ataḥ assāt' vidheḥ iti idānīṃ ṣaṣṭhī, vākyaśeṣa- saṃbandhāditi eva asya stutimavagacchāmaḥ, na khata ityarthaḥ |
'nanu nirapekṣatvādi' iti, yadi ka cit ani- tikartavyatākasya vidheḥ pravartanaśaktiḥ, kasmādanyadapekṣate tena satsvapi anādaraḥ syāt |
ācāryastu sopahāsa- māha, yatrāsau kevalaḥ prayujyamāno nirapekṣaḥ, tatra bhavatu, na kaścidvirodhaḥ |

rudra iti rodananimittasya śabdasya darśa- nāt ' yadarodīt ' ityucyate |

kathaṃ punaḥ anuṣṭhiānyāṃ vapāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ ātmano vapāṃ udakkhidat ityāha ? ucyate |

adhyāhārapakṣakhaṇḍanam |
nanu arthameva adhyāhṛtya vākyaṃ pūrvatāṃ, kiṃ śabdakalpanā |
nāthe- mātreṇa pūrṇaṃ saṃbhavati |
ekavākyabhūtapadadvayapratipāditā hi padārthāḥ vākyārthe pratipādayanti nānyathā |
nahi ānaya ityetāvati ukte, gāṃ ityukte, pratyakṣapratibhe- 'pi gavi gavā saha ānayanaṃ anvīyate |
evaṃ ca vikṛtiṣu sauryādiṣu asatrametārthāṇyadipadanivṛtteḥ nyūna- sākāṅkṣa mantravākyapūraṇāya sūryādipadakṣepatāt ūha- siddhiḥ |
arthādhyāhāravādināṃ tu sūryeṇa adhyāhṛtena viśiṣṭaṃ nirvāpāmidameva prakāśayati iti nohaḥ sidhyet |
tathā yatra adhikāravākye arthavādamātra śrutaṃ 'prati- tiṣṭhanti ha vā etā rātrīrupayanti' iti, tatrāpi bhavanmate vidhyartha eva adhyāhāryaḥ; na vidhidhvadaḥ |
tataśca prākṛtasyopakārasya padārthānāṃ ca nāpūrvedamarthya sidhyet |
sasyapi hi arthānāṃ ākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogya- teṣu nāmidhānamantareṇa anyasiddhiḥ |
na ceha apūrvā- bhidhāyī śabdo'sti, yo'pūrve prākṛtairanvitaṃ abhi- dadhyāt |
nāpi prākṛtāḥ śabdāḥ vikṛtau santi, ye svārthān apūrvānvitānabhidadhyuḥ |
na ca arthavāda- padārthaiḥ teṣāmanvayaḥ, nāpi upatyapūrvayeṇa iti ananvaya eva syāt |
evaṃ prakṛtāvapi 'sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo darśa- pūrṇamāsau' ityatra vidhiśabdasya anāmnānāt anadhyā- hārācca vidhyarthasya svargakāmādhikārāpūrvāt āgneyāyu- tparyavyebhyaśca pṛthagbhūtasyādhyāhārāt na samidādīnāṃ aida- madhyaṃ sidhyet |
nahi samidādiyataḥ avaghātādivat, adhikārāpūrvānvitaṃ svargabhābhidhātumalaṃ, syātpūrvaviṣaya- vyākhyātāt |
tasmāt īdṛśeṣu adhikāravidhiṣu vidhiśabda eva adhyāhāryo nāthīḥ |
na ca vidhyarthasya atyantā- laukikatayā pramāṇena tadābhāsena vā buddhau āropayitu- maśakyatvena abhimatāsya buddhisaṃnidhānātkaḥ adhyāhāraḥ aśrutavidhiśabdakeṣu adhikāravākyeṣu vā, utpatti- vākyeṣu 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ' ityādiṣu vā śakyate, ityakāmenāpi śabdādhyāhāraḥ aṅgīkartavyaḥ |

kṛṣṇalānāṃ ca haviṣmeva, na prakṛtitvaṃ, ityavaghātaprasaktyaiva abhāvat ayaṃ vicāro'nupapanna iti vācyam |
samprakṛtikkaviṣkyaṃ kṛṣṇalavidhānena haviṣ- statprakṛtitva nivṛttyā kṛṣṇalānāṃ haviḥsthānāpannatvavat haviḥprakṛtisthānāpannatvamapi asti, ityavaghātaprāpya- virodhāt |
vi— avaghātaḥ kṛṣṇalānāmasti no vā, 'sti pākavat |
prayoktavyā caret pākabhavaghāte tu nāsti sā ( pratyakṣetiḥ ) |
bhāṭṭa— yat mūle varṇakāntareṇa 'prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapecchatakṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ ' ityāhya kṛṣṇa- leṣu vituṣībhāvaprayojanābhāvāt avaghātasya bādha ityuktaṃ, tat kṛṣṇalānāṃ pradeyatvaprakṛtitvaṃ kṛtvācintā |
vastu- tastu kṛṣṇalānāṃ satyapi ghṛtādhikaraṇavācanikāgnisaṃyoga- mātrarūpe paṇe vaiśyābhāvena kṛṣṇalaprakṛtikkacarupārthā- tarotpattau pramāṇābhāvāt teṣāmeva pradeyatvāttaḥ āgneyaprakṛtitvena pradeyapuroḍāśadharmāṇāṃ paryagnikaraṇādīnāṃ prāptāvapi pradeyaprakṛtitvabhūtahavirmāṇāṃ teṣu pramāṇābhāvāt na vaituṣyābhāvaprayukto bādhaḥ |
na ca havirmābhāve nirvapāsyābhāvāt ' nirvapet ' ityanuvādānupapattiḥ |
prākṛtavaidharṇāpātrāsāvapi arthātātlokikapṛthakkaraṇarūpa- nirvopasyaiva tena yāgalakṣaṇārthamanuvādāt |
na ca codanāliṅgātideśena avaghātaprāpyabhāve'pi caruśabdasya nāmātideśavidhayā carudharmātideśatvamaṅgīkṛtya avaghātaprāptirāśaṅkituṃ śakyā |
caruḥ prakṛtyāvahita- tvena taddharmāṇāmasiddheḥ, sauryādāvatideśaprāptānāṃ dharmāṇām vidhānādadhikāre'pi avaghātasya taddharmatvābhāvāt |
na ca caruśabdo'yaṃ kṛṣṇalānāṃ caruprakṛtitvāvagamārthaḥ ityapi śakyaṃ vaktuṃ, kṛṣṇalajanyadravyānurānupattau teṣu tatprakṛtitvasya bādhita- tvāt |
ataścaruśabdo'yaṃ acarāveva agnisaṃyogarūpaśrapaṇa- vatsavasāhacaryāt gauṇaḥ san āgneyaprakṛtitvasādhakakaṭhina- tvāparpāyaviśadatvasāhacaryātpohalako'nuvāda ityuktam- ghṛme ( 8|18 ) |
' ghṛte śrapayati ' ityanena hi na śrapaṇaṃ vidhīyate, viklṛttyabhāvena śrapaṇāsaṃbhavāt |
api tu lakṣaṇyā ghṛtādhikaraṇāmiśrayogamātram |
tena kṛṣṇalānāṃ pradeyatvāt pradeyadharmāḥ paryagnikaraṇādayaḥ prāpye- ran, na tvavaghātādayaḥ; iti na tatra vaituṣyābhāvaprayukto bādhaḥ ! sa tu paraṃ savanīyahavirantargatalājavyaparivāpe |
tatra hi dhānāprakṛtitvena yavānāmiha lājaprakṛtitvena vrīhiṣu prāptau avaghātasya vaituṣyābhāvadeva prayojanaṃ, na tu svarūpeṇa |
prakṛte ca tasya pradeyapāke virodhivādasaṃbhavaḥ; satuṣadravyasya bharjane lājaniṣṭhatveḥ |
ata eva dhānāvat bharjanottaramapi nāvaghātaḥ; lājavattvadhātāpāteḥ |

ata eva upakārapṛṣṭhabhāvena padā- rthānāṃ vikṛtāvātideśaḥ; prakṛtau nirūpitarūpāṇāmeva vā vikṛtāvātideśaḥ iti daśame vakṣyate |
tadiha upodghātatayā kiṃ prokṣaṇāvaghātādīnāṃ 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi ' ityādivākyanipādānāṃ ca prakṛtau vrīhitvāvacchinnoddeśena vidhānaṃ tataśca vrīhyanyā- dimyuktāste, athavā apūrvasādhanatvāvacchinnoddeśena tata- śāpūrvayuktā iti cintyate |
brīhmādiprayuktatve śyāmāke carau saurye vā vrīhmādīnāmabhāvāt prokṣaṇādīnāṃ lopa eva, na tuhaḥ |
apūrvaprayuktatve tu śyāmākādīnāmapi tadrūpāva- cchinnatvāt siddhayūhaḥ |
tatra yatrāpi ārādupakārakatve na śrutamuddeśyatā''vacchedakaṃ, tatrāpi karaṇāgrāhakākāṅkṣā- rūpetikartavyatā''kāṅkṣākramakaraṇena yāgajñāllaiva prayājādividhānāt yāgatvamevoddeśyatā''vacchedakaṃ, na tu apūrvasādhanatvaṃ samprādhānyāpatteḥ |

na vā'ti- deśo'cchedeḥ, apūrvaviśeṣārthatve iva āgneyādyarthatve'pi 'tadvat kuryāt' ityatideśena āgneyasthānapace saurye dharmātideśopapatteḥ |
ataste yāgaprayuktā eva, tadā kimu vakṣyata yat, brīhmādisaṃyogenaiva prokṣaṇādidhaśravaṇāt vrīhitvādimeva uddeśyatāvacchedakamiti |
na ca vrīhi- yāgādisarūpārthatve dharmāṇāṃmānyatvaṃ, teṣāmapi agnivat phalavattvena tadabhāvāt |
na ca amīnādhānānvayatirekena utpattau pramāṇābhāvena tadabhāve'pi vrīhmādīnāṃ prokṣaṇādi- vyatirekeṇāpi jāyamānatayā ānarthakyapāttastadasyaiveti vācyam |
tādṛśānarthakyaparihārāya prokṣaṇādiviśiṣṭa- vrīhīṇāmeva kalpitavākyāntareṇa yāgārthatvasya apūrvatva- syaiva vā bodhopapattī, niṣādapatyanyāyena (6|1|13|1) vrīhipade yavādisādhāraṇyena apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā pramā- ṇābhāvāt |
astu vā vrīhipade lakṣaṇā, tathāpi lāghavād- pasthitatvācca vijātīyayāgasādhanavrīhitvādimeva lakṣyate, na tu apūrvasādhanatvam |
na ca yāgasyāpi niśatopā- yatvena prokṣaṇādivyatirekeṇāpi jāyamānatvāt ānartha- kyāpattiḥ, yāgatvāvacchinnasya apūrvatvāvacchinnasya vā jāyamānatve'pi vijātīyayāgatvāvacchinnasya prokṣaṇādi- vyatirekeṇa jāyamānatve pramāṇābhāvāt |
nahi āgneyatvāva- cchinnaṃ prati prokṣaṇāditā cit sāmagrī kalpatā'sti, yena tajjanyavyaktau āgneyatvābhivyaktirbhavet |
prokṣaṇā- daiva tu vidhānabalena tatsāmagrītvāt tadvyatirekeṇa tadu- papattī pramāṇābhāvena na yāgasvarūpārthatve ānarthakyaṃ prokṣaṇādīnām |
ata eva ārādupakārakāṇāmapi yāga- svarūpārthatve nānarthakyam |
iti prāpte, yadyapi tāvat vijātīyayāgasādhanatvameva prokṣaṇādimuddiśyatā''vacche- dakaṃ, tathāpi apūrvasādhanatve iva vakṣyamāṇarītyā na tatra vrīhitvādi praviṣṭaṃ, iti śyāmākebhyapi tatsatvāt ūha- siddhirinyāyaivaṃ |
vastutastu, na vijātīyayāgasādhanatvaṃ uddeśyatāvacchedakaṃ, vijātīyayāgavyaktīnāmi vyāpa- kībhūtayāgatvāvacchinnasyevagatatvatāt tadavacchinnaṃ prati dravyatvāvacchinnasya lokata eva kāraṇatvāvagateḥ sāmagrī- vaśena vrīhmādi dravyaṃ vinā'pi, dravyāntareṇa kadā cit vijātīyayāgavyaktīnāmupatvau bādhakābhāvena ānartha- kyasya tadavacchatvāt |
na ca sāmānyasāmagryāḥ viśeṣa- kāraṇasattvāhityā eva kāryajanakatvaniyamaḥ; anyatra tathātve'pi prakṛte tathā kalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt, 'tadeva yādṛk tādṛk ca hotavyaṃ' iti liṅgānuptatteśca |
ata evānaiva vrīhyā pañcāprātimupapādya phalato niyama- vidhitvaṃ vrīhmādividhīnāmupapatteḥ pratinidhiṣva |
ato dravyatasaṃskāravidhivyaḥ sarve apūrvasādhanībhūtavidhayā eva vyāpakībhūtapūrvāvacchinnaṃ prati dravyādinā kāraṇatvasya lokata'klṛptatvena niruktapratibandhakatvāpatteḥ |
ārādupa- kārakāṇāmapi anayaiva rītyā apūrvajananākulayogyatā- saṃpādakalatvaṃ dravyaṃ, na tu yāgārthatvaṃ, ānarthakyapātteḥ |

bhāṭṭa-- anārbhya prajāpatirvaruṇāyāśvamanayat, sa svāṃ devatāmācchat, sa paryadaiyata, sa etaṃ vāruṇaṃ catuṣkalamapaśyat, taṃ niravapat, tato vai sa varuṇa- pāśādamucyata |
varuṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti, yo'śvaṃ prati- gṛhṇāti, yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvato vāruṇān catuṣkalān nirvapet' iti śrutam |
pratigrahaśabdo'tra dānaparaḥ iti uttarādhi- karaṇe vakṣyate |
tataśca yata mitrādāyādibhyaḥ laukikaṃ dānaṃ tatsaṃbandhinī iyamiṣṭiḥ, kiṃvā aśva- dānamātrasaṃbandhinī, kiṃvā agnimatyaṃṅgābhūtāśvadāna- saṃbandhinī iti cintāyāṃ, arthavādānurodhena dāna- viṣayatvat asyā iṣṭeḥ doṣanirghātārthatvasyāpi avagamāt, doṣasya ca 'na kevariṇo dadāti' ityanena avihita- laukikaviṣayatvāt tadanurodhena asyā api laukikadāna- viṣayatvam |
idaṃ hi vakṣyaṃ yatra aniyamena sāmānyato vihite aśvaviṣaye (aśvadāne) icchayā pravṛttiḥ, yatra vā naiva vihitaṃ yathā mitrādāyādibhyaḥ; tadipyama |
ata eva yatra viśvajidādau sarvasvadāne aśvadānaṃ niyataṃ, tatra tadprakaraṇasthena vākyāntareṇaiva tasya paryudāse'pi asyā śāstrā'ntarīyavacanasya uktaviṣaye niṣedhatvameva |
atastatra niṣedhatvena doṣāpagateḥ tannirghātārthatayā iṣṭepi tadvi- payatvaṃ bhedanahome'styeva bhedanavat darśapūrṇamāsaviṣayatvam |
ata eva doṣanirghātaḥ phalaṃ, aśvadānaṃ ca nimittaṃ, na tu śeṣā |
tathātve uktaphalānupapatteḥ, adhyabhiviritakratu- saṃnnibhābhāvācca |
yadi tu asyāḥ doṣanirghātā- rthatvaṃ nābhyupagamyate, tato yāvacchabdasamabhivyāhāreṇa aśvadānasya uddeśyatvāvagateḥ tāvacchabdasamabhivyāhṛtā- prāpteḥ tadaṅgatvāpātāt nimittatvānupapattiḥ |
nāhi yāva- cchabdo nimittatvāvācī, api tu sākalyavācī |
na ca yāvattvācchabdamātrāṃ kriyādravyasya saṃnnidhamātrāvagatau śeṣi- tvapakṣe ārādupakārakatvena tantratvāpatteḥ tāvacchabdārtha- prāptyabhāvena vidheyatvaprasaṅgāt, nimittatvapakṣe ca pratini- mittaṃ naimittikābhyupagamena tāvacchabdārthasya prāptatvena avidheyatvāt vidhilāghavānurodhena nimittatvāvagatiḥ |
siddhānte'pi sulabhā iti vācyam |
pakṣadvaye'pi nimittatānuparodhena pradhānānurodhena vā āvṛttipakṣato kālai- kyena tantratvaprāpteḥ tāvacchabdasya pratiprasavavidhilāvaśyaṃ- bhāvāt |

dvitīyastu, yasmāttat arthavāde jalodarāparaparyāyo varuṇagrahasyo doṣaḥ, sa naiva pratyakṣādinā vaikasaṃhitāmirvā aśvadānajanyatāya ava- gamyate |

na ca 'gṛhṇīyāt' iti liṅā vihitatvena uktatvāt vihi- tasya upasthitiḥ, uddeśya vihitatvena viśeṣaṇayogāt |
ataḥ sarvaviṣayatvam |

16. aśvapratigraheṣṭau pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālacatuṣka- bhedaḥ ||
kapālāni ca kumbhīvat tulyasaṃkhyānām |
bhāṣya-- aśvapratigraheṣṭyāṃ vāruṇāśrutakapālāḥ puroḍāśā asaṃkhyeyāḥ śrūyante 'yāvato'śvān prati- gṛhṇīyāt tāvataścakapālān vāruṇānnirvapet' iti |
tatra vicāryate kiṃ dairghyaṃ kapāleṣu sarveṣāṃ śrapaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, athavā pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālacatuṣkabheda iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? kapālāni kumbhīvat |
yathā prājāpatyeṣu kumbhī tantraṃ, evaṃ tulyasaṃkhyānāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ kapālāni tantramityarthaḥ |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ? evaṃ sahalaṃ cānumahīṣyate, sarve caturṣu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtā bhaviṣyanti |
pratipradhānaṃ vā, prakṛtivat |
bhāṣya-- pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālacatuṣkabhedaḥ |
evaṃ yathāprakṛti kṛtaṃ bhavati |
prakṛtau darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prati- puroḍāśaṃ kapālāni bhinnāni, ihāpi tadeva mettvāni coṭakānugrahāya |
api ca yadi kapālāni tantraṃ bhaveyuḥ, naiko'pi puroḍāśaḥ catuṣkapālaiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ syāt |
sarve kapālavayeṣu pakkā bhaveyuḥ |
tatra kapālaśabdo bādhyate |

(atra sudhā. pṛ.1848- pūrvādhikaraṇasiddhāntasūtrayoḥ vāśabdajñāśabdayoḥ vyavahitayorapi apekṣitatayā anupaṅgeṇa yajñāṅgo dāne anaṅge vā ṛtvikarmaṇi iti saṃdigdhe ityevaṃ svayameva anyathā nyāyācce- athavā svāmiti [athavā svāmikarmātithyayoḥ iti ] ) |
kathaṃ punaryajamānavyāpāre nimittaṃ iti liṅgena gamyate ? taducyate, 'sāmarthyaṃ karmaṇastāvadekaṃ liṅgaṃ vivakṣitam |
aparaṃ vākyasāmarthyaṃ paurvāparyanirīkṣa- ṇāt |
' pūrvādhikaraṇena etat pratipāditaprāyaṃ yadyatra dāturihiriti |
yadā hi aśvapratigrahavataḥ karmaṇo'ṅga- meva ityavadhāritaṃ, tadā aṅgapradhānānāṃ ekadeśakāla- kartṛkatvāt ( 1|2|12 ) |
ya eva kratoḥ kartā, tenaiva iyamapi kartavyā |
yaśca kratoḥ kartā, sa 'svāmikarma parikrayaḥ ' ( 3|8|19 ) ityevamastvasya dātā |
tasmāt asaṃdigdhameva dāturihyā bhavitavyam |
etaddhi aṅgasya sāmarthyaṃ, yat pradhānena ekakartṛkaṃ sat upakāraṃ śaknoti kartuṃ, na bhinnakartṛkam |
tena pradhānavadeva itara- ssyāmapi ārṣijyaṃ kartavyaṃ, na yājamānamiti |
evaṃ siddha- 'pi vākyopakramopasaṃhāravirodhakṛtabhrāntisaṃśayavyudāsa- mātrārthe uttaramadhikaraṇamārabhyadhamya |
tasyāpi ca vākya- saṃtra-dhopakramopasaṃhārasya īdṛśameva sāmarthyaṃ, yat dāturvi- dhatte |
nahi etāvadeva vākyaṃ 'yāvata'svān pratigṛhṇī- yāt tāvataśvapālān varuṇārpaṇameva ' iti, kiṃ tarhi anyo'pi upakramaḥ 'prajāpatirvaruṇāyāśvamanayat ' ityā- dirasya vidyate |
sa ca dāturihaṃ pratipādayati ityuktam |
nanu etadyuktaṃ viruddhadeśavalīyatvāt bādhyate'sau iti |

tatra yo'yaṃ asthiyāgaḥ : saṃvatsare, sa kiṃ mṛtādhikāraḥ, uta jīvadadhikāra iti cintāyāṃ, 'etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet' itivat asthnāmevā- dhikārapratīteḥ |

dravyāgādau ca jīvadadhyāyeva sarvairmaraṇabhāvanā svetareṣāṃ anumatidānāt anumatidvārā kartṛtvāpatteḥ |

yāvadicchābhiḥ : śyenavyaktaḥ kartumaśakyatvāt, snātvādi- bhirapi anirdiṣṭaiḥ, iṣṭakātvāt, śyenavyakteḥ prayojana- kalpanāt, cinoteramukhātprārthatvāt, 'karmaṇyagnyākhyāyāṃ' iti ( pā0 3|1|92 ) smṛtiparityāgaprasaṅgācca caya- nena śyenavyaktiṃ kuryāt ityevaṃ tāvat nopapadyate |
tathā ākṛterapi icchābhiḥ kartumaśakyatvāt, devanirmita- tvāt, prayojanakalpanāt, cinoteramukhātprārthatvāt, smṛtivādhācca, ākṛtiṃ kuryāt ityepi nopapadyate |
pari- śeṣāt śyenamiva citaṃ abhisalyaṃ cayanena nirvartayet iti vākyārthaḥ |

nanu daṇḍiśabde prakṛtyā daṇḍo'bhidhīyate eva, kathamucyate 'na ca tāvat daṇḍo'bhidhīyate' iti, kathaṃ ca upalakṣaṇatvena ākṛtau upanyastāyāṃ viśiṣṭaḥ pratyāyyate iti viśeṣaṇa dṛṣṭāntatayā upanyastamiti |

tat siddhaṃ vyāpāratvena yatnatvena vā pratyayavācyo yatno bhāvaneti |

tasyāśca mukhyaviśeṣyatvenaiva anvayaḥ |
na ca ' caitraḥ pacati ' ityādī tasyāḥ prathamāntapadopasthāpye caitrādau prakāratayā anvayānumantraṇāt na mukhyaviśeṣyatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti iti vācyam |
' sthālyāṃ pacati ' ' kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati ' ' khādire vīryakāmasya yūyaṃ kuryāt ' ityādī prathamāntapadābhāve'pi śābdabodhānubhavena bhāvanāprā- rakṣaṇādabodhe prathamāntapadopasthiteḥ hetutvasya vaktuma- śakyatvāt |
na ca tatra prathamāntakatvaṃ tattadvidhādhyāhāraḥ, pratyayavācyasaṃkhvāyāḥ samānapadopasthāpyatvenasaṃbhavena adhyāhārāpekṣayā lakṣaṇāyā laghutvena ca ākhyātate kartṛ- lakṣaṇāyā eva yuktatvāt |
etena ' ākhyātārthaviśeṣye ākhyātārthaviṣayaviśeṣye vā prathamāntapadopasthāpye vā saṃkhyā'nvayaḥ; ' gaganena sthīyate ' ityatra prathamā- ntapadābhāvāt saṃkhyā ananvitaiva ' ityapāstam |
' kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati ' ityatrāpi anvayāpatteḥ; ' pacati ' ityatra kṛtiviśeṣyatvobhasvīkāre ananugamāt, ākhyā- tārthaviśeṣatvādina hetutvasya ākhyātajanyopasthiteḥ hetutvāpekṣayā gurutvāt |
evaṃ ca yatra prathamā'- ntapadābhāve'pi yatnameva vācyatā'- vacchedakaṃ ityāhuḥ |
' jānāti icchati yatate karoti bhavati naśyati ' ityādī āśrayatvapratiyogitvādi niddhalakṣaṇa |
na ca āśrayatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ iti vācyam |
nāmārthadhātvarthayoḥ abhedātiriktasaṃsargena anvayasya abhyu- pagantvāt |
anyathā ' taṇḍulaḥ pacyate, caitraḥ pacyate taṇḍulaḥ ' ityādī anvayodhāpatteḥ |
śakyatāvacchedakaṃ khvādiṃkaṃ jñāni iti |
tatrādipratyayāt arthapratyayasya ādeśisaraṇāt iti ke cit |
anye tu khānibhūtaṃ lādikaṃ ajānato'pi arthapratyayāt, śatrādīnāṃ sādhutvārthe kathitatvena prativyākaraṇaṃ miśratvena ca tatra śakticchedā- saṃbhavāt, ādeśavṛttitvādikameva śakyatāvaccheda- kam |
' gaccha ' ityādī śvādivikaraṇavṛtti tat ityāhuḥ |
saṃbhavatīti vācyam |
jñānakarmatvasaṃbhavāt, bhāvanā''śraya- tvasya tatsaṃbhavācca |
ataḥ ekavākyatvasya anupa- pattā'pi viśeṣyatvam |
na caivaṃ ' pākabhāvanā jāyate ' ityasminnarthe ' pacati bhavati ' iti prayogāpattiḥ; iṣṭā- patteḥ |
kiṃca ' bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ ' iti smṛteḥ ( niruktaṃ 1|1 ) bhāvanāprādhānyayoccikāyāḥ sārthakatvaṃ, anyathā ānarthakyāpattiḥ |
na ca neyaṃ bhāvanāprādhānya- bodhikā, kiṃtu ' dhātvarthaḥ kevalaḥ śuddho bhāvanā ' iti vaiyākaraṇaparibhāṣitadhātvarthaprādhānyabodhikā iti vācyam |
liṅapratyayavācyā- ( vāci ā ) khyātaśabda- sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ |
na ca ' sarvamākhyātajaṃ nāma ' iti smṛteḥ ākhyātapadena dhātvartha eva ityucyate iti vācyam |
' pākaḥ ' ityādī ākhyātapadāprayogāt |
nāma- nirvacane tu ākhyātapadaṃ tattatkṛtau lakṣa- ṇikam |
tena ākhyātaśabdasya dhātuvācitvā- bhāvāt pratyayavāci-ākhyātapadasāmānādhikaraṇyānu- papattiḥ |
ato'tra ' paṣṭhiṣṭhibhumo māghyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ ' itivat anekākhyātāthodeśena bhāvanāpradhānavidhiḥ |
tena ākhyātavācyalakṣya-kālasaṃkhyāmānākartṛkarmasu bhāvanāprādhānyaṃ vidyate ( bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ iti smṛtiḥ ) |
anyathā dhātvarthanirūpitaprādhānyavidhī ' prakṛtipratyayau ' iti smṛtiprāsatvena anuvāde āna- rthakyāpattiḥ |
vaiyākaraṇaparibhāṣaṇaṃ tu ' napuṃsake bhāve kaḥ ' ( pā0 3|1|14 ) ityādī dhātvarthagrahaṇameva, na tvatatvādyarthagrahaṇaṃ ityetadarthaṃ, na tu bhāvapadaśaktigrāha- kam |
evaṃ ' sattvapradhānāni nāmāni ' ( niruktaṃ 1|1 ) ityatrāpi ' pāvakaḥ, lāvakaḥ ' ityādyanekārthanāmasu liṅasaṃkhyā'nvayayoginaḥ prādhānyavodhanam |
ghaṭādi- pade'pi jātivyaktyormorapi prādhānyam |
ata eva ca ākhyātadhikaraṇe ( 1|3|15-35 ) jāti- vyaktyoḥ bodhadvayaṃ ityāhuḥ |
ataḥ anekārthapratipādakeṣu ākhyāteṣu bhāvanāprādhānyaniyamaḥ ' bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ ' ityanayā smṛtyā kriyate |

ākhyātārthaḥ : (bhāṭṭarahasyam) pākānukūla-vyāpārasāmānyasyaiva pratyārthatvaṃ, 'pākaṃ bhāvayati' iti ṇijantabhūtādhunā vyāpārasāmānyavācakena vivaraṇāt |
yadapi 'pākaṃ karoti' iti vivaraṇaṃ, tadapi karoteḥ vyāpārasāmānyavācakāt anukūlameva |
nahi karotyartha-tārthakaḥ, tathātve karoteḥ yatarthakameva akarmakatā''patteḥ |
phalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvaṃ hi dhātoḥ sakarmakatvam |
phalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvaṃ vākarmakatvam |
paceḥ phalaṃ viklattiḥ : odanavṛttiḥ : vyāpāraḥ : caitravṛttiḥ : iti vyadhikara-ṇatvāt sakarmakaḥ |
svāpasya phalaṃ sukhaṃ, tat caitra eva iti dvayoḥ samānādhikaraṇatvaṃ iti saḥ (svapiti :) akarmakaḥ |
tayadi karotiyatayoḥ : ākhyātatvaṃ, tadā eka-syaivārthasya phalavyadhikaraṇatvaṃ phalamānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca viruddham |
ataḥ karotipi vyāpārasāmānyavācyeva |
ata eva 'ratho gacchati' ityatra 'ratho gamanaṃ karoti' iti vivaraṇamapi saṃgacchate |
ataḥ karotibhāvarathayitvāṃ vivaraṇāt ākhyātāsyāpi phaledeyatvaṃ prakṛtadhātvarthātirikte vyāpārasāmānyaṃ vācyam |
tacca phalaṃ ka ciddhātvarthaḥ ka cicca svargādi ityanyadetat |
vyāpārasāmānyasya ca viśeṣā-kāṅkṣāpekṣitatvatā''śaṅkāyāḥ prayājādivākyaiḥ : viśeṣa-samarpaṇaṃ iti pārthavāriḥ |
vastutastu tattatphalabhedena tattadvāpārabhedena ca anugatatvalaghubhūtaśakyatāvacchedakā-bhāvāt 'pacati', pāke yatate, 'pākaṃ karoti' ityādi-vivaraṇāt ākhyātasya yatnameva śakyatā''vacchedakam |
na ca karotisadanukūlavyāpāraḥ |
vātarogādinā spandamāne caitre spandākurūvijātīyavyāyutaṃgorūpa-vyāpāratvapi 'nāhaṃ spandaṃ karomi, api tu vātarogā-maccharīraṃ spandate' iti pratīyatā karotyarthātmaka-pratīteḥ |
yatnasya śakyatā''vacchedaka lāghavāt |
evaṃ ca 'ratho gamanaṃ karoti' ityādau anukūlavyāpāre kuñjo lakṣaṇā iti dhyeyam |
na ca bhavyarthakartṛkarmakatvāviśeṣāt karoterbhāvayatiparyāyatvaṃ, paryāyābhāve'pi 'pi bhāvayati-śakyatāvacchedakayatnatvānavacchinnaśakyatāvacchedakatvenāpi bhavatyarthakartṛkarmakatvopapatteḥ |
na ca karotyarthātmakatve yatateriva akarmakatā''pattiḥ; satyapi yatnasyaiva-thaitve dhātvarthatā''vacchedakabhedena sakarmakatvākarmakatva-vyavasthopapatteḥ |
yataterhi caitraniṣṭhā kriyaiva yatnasamānādhi-karaṇaṃ phalam |
karotestu tadyadhikaraṇaṃ utpatyākhyaṃ dhātvarthatā''vacchedakaṃ phalam |
tataśca yathaiva pacati-gacchatyoryāpārarūpakriyaive phalebhedena vyavasthā, evamehāpi vyāpārarūpayatnaikatve'pi phala-bhedādeva sakarmakatvākarmakatvavyavasthopapattiḥ |
tat phalaṃ punaḥ ubhayatratā pramāṇāntarāvagamyameva dhātvartho-palakṣaṇaṃ, dhātuvācyameva vā ityanyadetat |
vastutastu etallakṣaṇasya kaustubhoktīyasyā adhyākhyādidoṣaduṣṭatvāt avivakṣāvirahaviśiṣṭakarmakāṅkṣāśaktatātvameva sakarmakatvaṃ, tadabhāvaśca akarmakatvaṃ ityevaṃ kaustubhoktalakṣaṇaṃ yuktam |
atra ca ākāṅkṣā samabhivyāhārātmikā śabdadharmaḥ |

evaṃ ekasyaiva granthapātoḥ caitraniṣṭha- vyāpāravācitvarūpadharmapuraskāreṇa karmasākāṅkṣatvāt sakarma- katvaṃ, puṣpaniṣṭhavyāpāravācitvena karmanākāṅkṣatvāt aka- rmakatvaṃ ca draṣṭavyam |

evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ |
arthāpattestaddharmā syāt taddharmakaṃ ca vāsaḥ |
sādhanaviśeṣanibandhanā hi te dharmāḥ, nānyānyanibandhanāḥ |
tasmādanyasminnapi tatkāryatvena bhavitumarhanti |
kathaṃ punarvāsovatsaṃ tatkāryatvaṃnamiti ? nimittatayā ādhāya parikreyeṇa, dakṣiṇeti tathā abhi- saṃyogo bhavati 'vāso dakṣiṇā' 'vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā' iti |
tasmādvāsovatsau anvāharyadharmā syātāmiti |
soma-- sūtrāttu-- vāsovatsaṃ anvāharyadharmakaṃ syāt anvāharyakāryaparikreyanimittakadakṣiṇāśabdayogāt iti |
vi-- 'anvāharyasa dharmo'tra na kāryaḥ kriyate- 'thavā |
, na taddharmatvo, maivaṃ sādhanatvaprayuktitaḥ ||
' bhāṭṭa-- vaikṛtī dakṣiṇā prākṛtadakṣiṇākāryapannatvāt prākṛtānvāharyādidakṣaṇādharmāṃ labhate ityapi tathaiva |
maṇḍana-- 'vatsādiranvāharyādidharmā |
' śaṃkara-- 'tatrānvāharyadharmātā |
' āgrayaṇe dyāvāpṛthivya ekakapālaḥ |
bhā. 7|1|5| 23, āgrayaṇe dyāvāpṛthivyaikakapāle cāturmāsyavaiśva- devikadyāvāpṛthivyaikakapālavidhittasya atideśaḥ |
āgrayaṇe vāsovatsayoḥ anvāharyasthānā- pannayorapi abhighāraṇasya bādhaḥ ||
tathā'bhighāraṇasya |
bhāṣyaṃ-- āgrayaṇe śrūyate, 'vāso dakṣiṇā' 'vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā' iti |
tatrāyamarthaḥ : samadhigataḥ anvā- haryadharmā vāsasi vatse ca kartavya iti |
athāyamarthaḥ : sāṃśayikaḥ, kimabhighāraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ neti |
kiṃ tāvatprāptam ? arthāpatteḥ kartavyamiti |
evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ |
tasmi- ghāraṇasya |
kim ? kriyate ? abhighāraṇaṃ hi anvāharye khādimne kriyate |
khādimnā hi odanasya parikreye upa- karoti |
na ca vāsasi vatse ca khādimnā prayojanam |
tasmāttatrābhighāraṇaṃ na syāditi |
soma-- iha tu adṛṣṭārthatvācca prayojanaṃ ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- 'abhighāro'sti no vā'tra, śakyatvādvāsa- vāsasoḥ |
asyanvāharyavat, maivaṃ svādutāyā asaṃbhavāt ||
' bhāṭṭa-- abhighāraṇasya tu prakṛtau adṛṣṭārthatvāt vāso- vatsādāvapi karaṇe prāpte, odanasyādimā''rthatvena hṛdyātva- saṃbhave adṛṣṭārthatvakalpanā''nupagateḥ khādimnaśca prayoja- nāmābhāvātkaraṇameva |
maṇḍana-- 'na cābhighāro vasane ca vatse |
' śaṃkara-- 'ubhayormighārasa |
bādhaḥ ityanuṣaṅgaḥ |
āgrayaṇe tattatsasyotpattikālāvadhikaḥ saṃvatsaro grāhyo na cāndrādiḥ ||
'saṃvatsarādyetadadhi bhavati' iti śrutau 'dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ' ityādiśrutatasiddhacāndrādisaṃvatsarā- nyatamaḥ eva vikalpena prāptaḥ |
iti prāpte |
'saṃvatsare sasyāni pacyante' ityādisu loke phalasasyāpākādyaiṣa- sasyapākāvadhikakālasyāpi saṃvatsaratvaṃ vyavahārataḥ sasya- pākānimittakameva tasyaivopalakṣitatvā niyamanasaṃbhave vika- tyāyogāt dvādaśamāsyānutirekasyāpi 'saṃvatsarādi' iti vādaḥ |
( 'paktu parāri eṣamo' (mas) bde pūrva pūrvatare abde, ityamaraḥ |
paratū pūrva abde, parāri pūrvatare abde, aimam : yati vartamāne abde ) |
saṃkarṣaḥ
āgrayaṇeṣu tattadravyakālayorniyamo na vikalpaḥ ||
'āgrayaṇenāṣṭakāmo yajeta' iti vidhāya vākyānantareṇa kālanāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca vidhānāt agni- hotradravyāṇāmiva vikalpaḥ syāt |
iti prāpte, prāpto-
āmayanstha 856 āmayaṇeṣṭinyāyaḥ
deśena kāladvayānekānuvidhāne vākyamedāt viśiṣṭa- vidhitvāvaśyaṃbhāvena vayāṇāmapi āmayaṇānāṃ abhyāsā- cchedaḥ |
naimittikānāmapi annādyakāmavākyena kāmyatā'pi |
kaupītakibrāhmaṇe tu śyāmākāgrayaṇaṃ vidhāya 'sasadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ, sacchantāvājyabhāgau' (4|12) ityādinā prākṛtājñāni uddiśya guṇaviśeṣān vidhāya, yavāgrayaṇadī- kṣato vidhāya 'etanmamevaitad brāhmaṇaṃ' (4|163) iti vācanikātideśavacanāt spaṣṭaḥ karmabhedaḥ, ato na dravyavikalpaḥ, nāpi karmavikalpo nimittabhedāt |
'dvirvā eṣa ādityaḥ' ityādinā ayanabhedena āvṛttiśruteśca |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|16.
oṃ āmayaṇākaraṇe'pi mutrādiśamīdhānyānāṃ bhakṣaṇaniṣedho nāsti ||
mutrādiśamīdhānyānāmapi pakkaupacilāviśeṣeṇa niṣedhe prāpte, teṣāṃ ayāgayogyatvādeva na niṣedhaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|12.
oṃ āmayaṇākaraṇe'pi śākāparṣādīnāṃ bhakṣaṇe na doṣaḥ ||
'sasyaṃ nāśnīyāt' iti vacanāntareṇa śākādīnā- mapi bhakṣaṇaniṣedhe prāpte, teṣāṃ yāgayogyatvābhāvena 'devā oṣadhīṣu pakāsu ājimīyuḥ; tā indrāgnī prathamamuda- jayatāṃ' ityupakramya navāśananiṣedhena devebhyo dātuṃ yogyānāṃ dhānyānāṃ pakānāmeva tebhyaḥ aniṣṭvā bhakṣaṇasya nindyā pakṣaśākānāṃ haritayavādīnāṃ ca bhakṣaṇe yathā- kāmyam |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|11.
oṃ āmayaṇasthaśrīhiśrutyā prakṛtau dravyavidhiḥ ||
'vrīhibhiridhvā vrīhibhiriva yajeta ā yevebhyaḥ' ityanena vrīhikālavakālāntarāle vrīhyagrayaṇabhāve sato vidhī- yate yatiśabdena prakaraṇinaḥ eṣopasthiteḥ |
iti prāpte, antarālakāle nityaprāptayordaśapūrṇamāsayoḥ dravyaniyamavidhi- paratve saṃbhavati alpāntāprāptāsaparatvamayuktam |
'vrīhibhiriva' ityevakāreṇa yavanirāsapratīteḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|15.
oṃ āmayaṇākaraṇe grāmyadhānyabhakṣaṇasya niṣedhaḥ ||
'tasmānnāśnīyāt āmayaṇena, navasyāśitavyam' iti niṣedhaḥ phālguṇārayaṇasyaiva, na vrīhiyavāśanasya yāḥ phālguṇāstāsāmitareṇa' iti vākyaśeṣe phala- kuṣṭhīkīrtanena viśeṣe vyavasthāpanāt |
tasmāt phālguṇāti- riktānāṃ grāmyāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ aniyatam |
iti prāpte, ajñasya dravyasāmānyeṇa karaṇāsaṃbhavena pravṛtteḥ viśeṣaika- viṣayatvena sāmānyasya viśeṣe paryavasānāt vākyaśeṣā- vaśyakatve'pi nivṛtteḥ navadhānyasāmānyāśanaviṣayakatvā- nupatterabhāvena vidhinā anākāṅkṣitasya vākyaśeṣeṇa asamarthatvāt phālguṇāryavāt : chanitvat lakṣaṇayā stāvaka- mātraṃ iti sarvagrāmyāṇāmeva bhakṣaṇaniṣedhaḥ |
saṃkarṣa.
āmayaṇeṣṭayāṃ 857 āmayaṇāpramatvaṃ
aprasūtatvasya bādhe'pi śāstrārthasya barhirmātrasya bādhabhāvāt na kasya cidgauṇam |
sūtrārthastu- tannasādhāraṇye adhiko guṇaḥ prasūtalakṣaṇaḥ guṇinni amukhyā'pi sati virodhābhāvāt niyamyate |
yathā śiṣyasya kāṃsyabhojitva- niyamaḥ |
upādhyāyasyāniyamaḥ |
yadi dvayorekasmin pātre bhojanamāpadyeta, tatra amukhyāsyāpi śiṣyasya dharmo'nugṛhyate tadvat iti |
vi--'barhirāprayaṇe kiṃ cit prasūnaṃ vā, bahutvataḥ |
prāyamyāccāgrimo, maivamalopāt kāṃsya- bhojivat ||
bhāṭṭa-- āmayaṇe 'aindrāgno dvādaśakapālaḥ |
sa vaiśvadevaścāvāpyupanidhaya ekakapālaḥ' iti trayo yāgāḥ śrutāḥ |
tatraikakapāle vaiśvadevaikakapālaprakṛtika ityu- ktam |
tena tatra prasūnamayaṃ barhiḥ |
ādyayordaśapūrṇa- māsātideśādhīnam |
tatra jaghanyakyāvāpyupanidhayarodhena mukhyayoranekyorapi prasūnamapyaniyamaḥ eva |
nahi tayoraniyamo nāma kaścit padārtho'sti, yena jaghanyaika- vṛttitvānniyamo bādhyate, barhirmātraṃ tu tadaṅgam |
ataśca kāṃsyabhojinyāyena durbalānurodhenāpi prasūnamapyagrahe na kaściddoṣaḥ |
maṇḍana-- 'amukhya'pi guṇe grāhyo yenānye'pi guṇā'nvitāḥ |
' śaṃkara-- 'barhiḥ sūnaṃ tvāgrayaṇe |

oṃ āmayaṇāpramatāyā viṣuvati niveśaḥ ||
jagatsāmni sāmābhāvāttaḥ sāma vadārthya syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ-- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate, 'yadi rayaṃtarāsā tomaḥ syādaindravāyavāgrān grahaṇṇīyāt, yadi bṛha- tsāmnā śukrāgrān, yadi jagatasāmā āmayaṇāgrān' iti |
āmayaṇāgrānityetadudāharaṇam |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kimāgayaṇā- pratāyāḥ prakṛtau niveśaḥ, uta vikṛtāviti |
kiṃ prāptam ? prakaraṇānugrahāt prakṛtāviti |
yadi jagatsāmeti jyoti- ṣṭomaḥ evocyate, yena kenacidisaṃbandhena guṇena kriyayā vā |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
jagatsāmni śrūyaṇe'pi na sāma tadādityamityavasīyate |
kutaḥ ? sāmābhāvāt |
nahi kulle'pi sāmavede jagannāma sāmāsti |
tasmā- dyatra jagatsāmpama sāma, 'sa jagatsāmnā |
sa viṣuvān |
nanu yukāgrau viṣuvānityucyate |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
sa kāmāya bhaviṣyati |
tassāditau vivṛti niveśa iti |
soma--yathā (caturthecaturthe'hani iti) vīpsāyā yathākathaṃcidanuvādatayā nayanaṃ, evaṃ jyotiṣṭome eva jagatsāmaśabdasya kathaṃcidyanaṃ ityuktānāt (dṛṣṭānta-) saṃgatiḥ |
jagat sāma etyeti bahuvrīhiḥ |
jagattyāṃ sāma asyeti vyadhikaraṇavrīhirepi saṃbhavati |
atra jagattīśabdaparyāyo jagacchandaḥ; chāndasa īkāralopo vā bodhyaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- 'yadi jagatsāmnā' ityatra jagatsāmnaḥ abhāvāt uktaṃ sāma ṛksaṃbandhāt tadākhyaṃ jagacchandābhidheyaṃ syāt iti |
evaṃ vadataḥ sūtrakārasya samānādhikaraṇasamāsa evābhipretaḥ |

ādyaḥ prakaraṇa, danyo jagatsāmatvasaṃbhavāt ||

oṃ āghāre mantrānte karmādisaṃnipāta: |

karmakatvā, ājyadhārānairantaryasya saṃbhavāt |
