āghārābhihotra
āghārābhihotra
ucyate satyamevaṃ, tathāpi ākāṅkṣāvaśāt parasparadravya- devatā'nubandhena sarvemeva vākyānāṃ dravyadevatāviśiṣṭa- karmavidhāyakatvāt dravyadevatābho nānupapannaḥ |
tena yāni vākyāni āghārābhihotrayorguṇavidhāyakatvena siddhā- nti''mimāni, tāni sarvāṇi anyonyānubaddhadravya- devatābhidhāpadāni viśiṣṭavidhāyakāni |
na caivaṃ sati āghārābhihotravākyayorāpi dravyadevatā'bhidhāpadānupapanna karmavidhāyakatvāt nānuvādakatvamiti vācyam |
yato vartamānapadeśarūpamidaṃ vākyadvayam |
na cāvaśyaṃ pañcamalakāratvena vidhitvābhyupajñakāryatvāt samasti |
na cātrānuvādanahaṃ ūrdhvādisthānīyaṃ dadhyādisthānīyaṃ vā guṇāntaramasti |
nāmnā'nudyamānaviśeṣapratipattihetutvenāpi upapatteḥ |
tena ūrdhvādivākyavihitakarmasamudāyadvayānu- vādaḥ |
evaṃ ca āghārābhihotramiśravākyābhyāmiti niśśrī- yate |
samudāyadvayānuvādaprayojanaṃ tu agni
āghārāgnihotraśabdau samudāyānuvādau na karmāntara- vidhāyakau iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vāśabdena vyāvartayan siddhāntamāha|
“agnihotravākyaṃ āghāravākyaṃ ca codanā apūrvakarma- vidhāyakameva, nānuvādaḥ |
śabdārthasya āghārayatiśabdasya juhotiśabdasya ca yo'rthaḥ, tasya prayoge bhūtvāt anuṣṭhānaṃ prāptatvāt |
āghārahomayoraḥ anyatrāptatvena avaśyaṃ vidheyatvādityarthaḥ |
nanu ūrdhvādivākyaiḥ dadhyādivākyaiśca viśiṣṭakarmavidhāyakaiḥ prāptatvāt aprāptatvamasiddhaṃ, ata āha- guṇārthena ūrdhvādidadhyādiguṇavidhānaprayojanāya āghārayati juhoti iti punaḥśrutiḥ anuvāda ityarthaḥ |
nanu saṃnihitaṃ dhātvarthaṃ parityajya pratyayaḥ kathaṃ guṇaṃ vidadhyāt tatrāha- tatsaṃnidheḥ |

'paryagnikṛtaṃ pānīyatvamutsṛjati', 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati' iti śrūyate |
idamājyaṃ kiṃ pūrvasmin prati- nidhibhūtaṃ, uta ājyadravyaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |

dravyābhāve ca pratinidhirgrāhyatvāt |

pūrvapakṣe hetvantaramāha- 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pānīyatvamutsṛ- jati', 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati' ityatra 'saṃsthā- payati' iti samāptivacanam |
samāptivacanācca ava- gamyate ārambho'pi syāditi |
tathā ca ārabhyameva karma ājyena parisamāptaṃ syāditi avagamāt ājyaṃ pratinidhiḥ syāt ityavagacchāmaḥ |
codanā vā karmotsargādanyaiḥ syādviśiṣṭatvāt |
pūrvapakṣaṃ bādhantena vyāvartyantu siddhāntamāha |
codanā eṣā syāt karmāntarasya 'ājyena śeṣaṃ pālīvataṃ saṃsthā- payati' iti |
karmotsargāt pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ utsargāt utsargeṇa parisamāptatvāt, anyaiḥ karmāntaravidhāyakaiḥ : nirva- patyādibhiḥ aviśiṣṭatvāt sahaśatvāt |
tasmāt ājyasaṃkhyā na pratinidhiḥ kintu karmāntaraṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
anijyāṃ ca vanaspateḥ prasiddhāṃ tena darśayati |
ājyena saṃsthāpanaṃ karmāntaraṃ iti siddhānte yuktya- ntaramāha |
prasiddhāṃ vanaspateḥ anijyāṃ, vanaspateḥ prasi- ddhā ijyāyāḥ abhāvaṃ, tena 'yat tvaṣṭāṃ ca vanaspatiṃ cāvāhayasi, athavaitau yakṣyasi, tadyau navamī prayājejyā, vānaspatyā daśamī' iti vākyena darśayati |
yadi pūrvaṃ karma parisamāptaṃ tato ṅasā syāt vanaspatījyā |
tatra abhāvadarśanaṃ upapadyate |

iti siddhāntaḥ |

nirālambanatvasādhanānāṃ nirālambanatve nirālambanatvameva na sidhyet, sālambanatvena anekānti- katvam |
atha vijñānalakṣaṇastanmāsayitayā pratyabhijñopa- patti:, naivaṃ, tasya sthāyitve kṣaṇikatvapratijñāvirodhāt apasiddhāntaprasaṅgācca |
atha vijñānalakṣaṇāta bhede'pi sausādṛśyāt pratyabhijñopapatti: |
lūnapunarjātakeśadādi- jātivivekavaditi cenna, tatra tadavyatirikta: pūrvopara- vyaktidarśī sādṛśyānusaṃdhātā caika: samasti, atra tu vijñānavyaktīnāṃ kṣaṇikatvena parasparānusaṃdhānaṃ ca na saṃbhava- tīti na sādṛśyanibandhanaṃ pratyabhijñānam |
kiṃca sādṛśya- mapi kṣaṇikaṃ sthāyi vā ? kṣaṇikatve jñānatulyatvāt tanni- bandhanaṃ pratyabhijñānam |
sthāyitve ca kṣaṇikatvahānirapa- siddhāntaśca |
ata: pratyabhijñānasamartha: saṃvidākhya: sthāyī cetano'bhyupagantavya: |
sa ca vibhu:; sarvatra kāryopalambhāt |
tathāhi, nānā- deśeṣu sarvatra buddhisukhādīnāmupalambhānna sarvatrātmana: saṃnidhirabhyupagantavya:; guṇinamantareṇa guṇasyāvasthānā- saṃbhavāt |
tatra gatvā saṃnidhau kalpyamāne gatikalpyanaṃ tatkāraṇakalpyanaṃ ceti gauravaṃ prasajyate, agacchato'pi saṃnidhānadarśanāt |
ākāśādau idameva vimalaṃ, yadagaccha- to'pi yugapannānādeśeṣu saṃnidhānam |
kiṃca ātmā sarva- mūrtibhi: saṃyujyate, aṇuparimāṇarahitatve sati nitya- dravyatvāt, yadityaṃ tadityaṃ yathā ākāśādi |
atha aṇuparimāṇo bhayatu ātmā, ko doṣa: ? ayameva doṣa:, aṇuparimāṇatve yugapadeva śira:pādavedanā nopa- padyate |
kiṃca ātmā aṇuparimāṇadhāro na bhavati, indriyagrāhyaguṇādhikaraṇatvāt, ghaṭādivaditi |
nanu bhavatu tarhi śarīraparimāṇa: |
tathāhi, ātmā yatropalabhyate tatparimāṇa: tatraiva sarvopalabhyamānaguṇatvāt, yadityaṃ tattathā, yathā'tarvarttitayopalabhyamānaprabhā'nuguṇa: pradīpo gṛhaparimāṇa: iti digambarā: |
tat nopapannaṃ, ātmana: sarvamūrtibhi: saha saṃyogasya sādhitatvāt, tatraivopalya- mānaguṇatvaṃ viruddhaṃ, dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikala: |
nahi gṛho- daravartinīṃ pradīpaprabhā gṛhasamānaparimāṇā, tadantarvarttitena nyūnaparimāṇatvāt |
nahi samānaparimāṇaṃ gṛhāntaraṃ gṛhānta- vaiti dṛṣṭam |
tathā sādhanavikalaśca, nahi gṛhāntarvarttinī prabhā gṛhe sarvopalabhyate |
kiṃca śarīraparimāṇatve sāva- yavatvaprasaṅga: |
yat niravayavadravyaṃ, tat aṇu vā vibhu vā dṛṣṭam |
ata ubhayaparimāṇarahitasya sāvayavatvameva |
kiṃca maśakahastideheyorātmano viṣamaparimāṇatvaprasaṅga: |
tadapi sāvayavatveaiva yujyate, na niravayavasya |
tathā ca śruti: 'anantamparaṃ' 'sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā' iti ca |
bhagavatītā ca 'nitya: sarvagata: sthāṇu: ' iti |
evaṃ ca aṇutvādyabhyupagamitatvādādya sūkṣmatvābhiprāya veditavyā: |
ato vibhurevātmā |
tathā nityaśca ātmā |
upaniṣadaśca kāryaparā api nityamamatakudante |
tasmādanilyānumānānāṃ āgamaviruddhatvāt sādhya- sādhanāni |
ata: siddhaṃ nityatvam |
tathā pratiśarīraṃ nānābhūtaśca |
tathāhi ātmabhedapratīti: sarvadisaṃmatā |
ekātmavādino'pi medapratītimīkṛtya kālpanikatva- māhu: |
ata'yaṃ meda: pāramārthika: kālpanikau veti vādināṃ vipratipatti: |
tatra pāramārthikatvameva medasya yuktaṃ, pramāṇasiddhatvāt |
tathāhi, pratyakṣānumānārthapalyā- gamai: ātmabhedo'vasīyate |
pratyakṣoṇa tāvat ahamiti bhoktṛtā ātmā parātmano bhinna: pratīyate |
parātmā cānumānenāyamiti gṛhyate, nāhamiti |
ato vilakṣaṇā- kārabuddhivodhyatayā ghaṭapaṭayoriva svātmapararātmano: meda: sphuṭatara: |
atha ya evāhamiti pratīyate, sa eva para- śarīrastho'yamiti pratīyate iti, maivaṃ, yadi paraśarīre'pi sa evātmā, tarhi kathamabhedo'pi pratyabhijñāyate |
tathā, yathā kaṭṭekartṛkatve karaṇe'pi cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭasyaiva tvagi- ndriyeṇa pratyabhijñāya 'ahamadrākṣaṃ, ahaṃ spṛśāmi' iti, tathā paraśarīrastha ātmā parānubhūtamipi pratyabhijñānīyāt, ekātmadātmano'nubhavitu: |
na ca manomedāt apratya- bhijñeti vācyam |
manaso'pi karaṇatvāt |
tathā anu- mānenāpi ātmabhedo'vagamyate |
vivādādhyāsito'ya- mātmā dravyatvātiriktarūpadhārabhedena nānā, aśā- vaṇaviśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatvāt, yadityaṃ tattathā yathā ghaṭādi |
tathā ātmā nānā bhavitumarhati, jñānasamavāyi- kāraṇaśrayatvāt, manovat |
tathā ātmā nānā, viśeṣa- guṇādhāratvāt ghaṭādivat |
nanu ekatvamapi anumānena sādhayituṃ śakyate |
vivādādhyāsitāni śarīrāṇi ekena ātmanā ātmavanti, śarīratvāt prativādiśarīravat |
tanna, sarvātmāna: sarvagatā ityasammatam |
ata: eka- syāpi ātmana: sarvaśarīreṣu vidyamānatvāt siddhasādha- nam |
atha ekenaivātmā ātmavat sādhyate, tarhi prati- vādiśarīre sarvasyātmānāṃ sadvāvāt sādhyavikalatā dṛṣṭā- ntasya |
atha ekātmatve bhogasādhanamiti sādhyate, tarhi ekameva śarīraṃ yathā svasya bhogasādhanam, tathā svasya ca bhāryādīnāṃ śarīrāṇyapi bhogasādhanānveveti punarapi sādhyavikalatā |
atha na bhogasādhanatvamātraṃ sādhaṃ kiṃtu bhogāyatanatvaṃ, ataśca na sādhyavikalateti |
tanna, kimidaṃ bhogāyatanatvaṃ nāma ? yadi bhogasādhanatvaṃ, tarhi pūrvoktameva dūṣaṇam |
atha bhoga: sukhaṃ, tadāyatanatvaṃ nāma sukhasamavāyitvamabhipretaṃ, tadā śarīreṣu sukhasama- yābhāvāt bādhitaviṣayatvamapasiddhāntaśca sapratisādhanasya hetu: |
tathāhi, vivādādhyāsitāni ekakālavartti- śarīrāṇi svasaṃsthayā ātmavanti, śarīratvāt, prati- vādiśarīravat |
na ca janmāntaraśarīreṣu anekāntyam, ekakālavarttināṃ pakṣīkṛtatvāt |
na ca saubhyādiśarīreṣu vyabhicāra:, teṣāṃ yugapadeva bahuśarīraparigrahe pramāṇā- bhāvāt, purāṇavādānāṃ cānyatvāt |
yadi teṣāmaneka- śarīrāṇi santītyabhiniveśa:, tadā asadādyekakālavarttinī śarīrāṇīti pakṣaviśeṣa eva kartavya: |
tathā arthāpa- ttyā'pi medo'vasīyate |
tathāhi, sukhadu:khavyavasthā tāvat pratīyate, eka: sukhamanubhavati yadā, tadaivāparo du:khī dṛṣṭa:, iyaṃ sukhadu:khādivyavasthā ātmabhedaṃ vinā anupa- padyamānā medaṃ kalpayati |
nanu iyaṃ vyavasthā ekātma- katve'pyupapadyate, yathā ekaśarīre 'pāde me vedanā, śirasi me sukhaṃ' iti vyavasthā, tathā śarīrāntare'pi evaṃ, tatra saṃbandhasyanusandhānamapyasti |
maivaṃ, yatraikyamarthaṃ saṃprati- pannaṃ, tatra saṃbandhasyanusandhānamapyasti |
yatra saṃbandhanusaṃdhānaṃ nāsti, tatra ekātmakatvamapi nāstyeva |
śarīrabhedaprayuktaṃ anusaṃdhānaṃ nāmabhedaprayuktakamiti cet, ātmana ekatve'pi śarīrabhede jātissarasyānusandhānadarśanāt |
tathā bālasya stanyāmilāpāderjanmāntarānubhūtaharṣahetulassaraṇanibandhana- tvācca |
etacca sarvavādisiddhamupagatameva |
anyathā aka- smādeva sarvaviṣayamamusaṃdhānaṃ kimiti nāstīti cet |
vartamānaśarīrānubhūte'pi anubhūtasya sarvasyānusandhānaniya- mābhāvāt |
ato'styanusandhānaṃ ātmabhede satye- vopapadyate na śarīrabhede |
etena manomedānusandhāna- mityapi pratyuktam |
ato'pi'rthāpattyā'pi ātmanātva- siddhi: |
tathā āgamādapi |
'dve brahmaṇī veditavye paraṃ cāparaṃ ca' 'dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣvajāte |
tayoranya: pippalaṃ svādvatti anaśnannanyo abhicākaśīti' |
'pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā' 'sarva ete'pyātmāno'bhyucaranti' 'so'śnute sarvān kāmān saha brahmaṇā' 'eko bahūnāṃ
vidadhāti kāmān ' 'nirañjana: paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti' 'mama sādharmyamāgatā: ' 'uttama: puruṣastanya: ' ityādi śruti: smṛtirapi |
tathā 'brāhmaṇo bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' 'rājā rājasūyena' 'vaiśyo vaiśyastomena' ityādimaṃ- vidhaya: adhikārimedādye ātmabhedamākṣipanti |
nanu bhavatāṃ kṛtsnasyāgamasya kāryaparatvena prāmāṇyāt na siddhārthe'tmātmabhedaprāmāṇyamupapadyate |
naivaṃ, ekātmavādināṃ bhavatāṃ siddhe'pi prāmāṇyāt ātmabhede pramāṇamevāgama: |
asmākaṃ tu kāryaparatve'pi bhedānuvādakatvādevāgamasiddho bheda: |
evaṃ nānātvagrāhakapramāṇavirodhādekatvaśrutayo'pi anyathā vyākhyeyā: |
na ca pratyakṣavirodhe āga- masyaiva balīyastvaṃ, tathā sati upaniṣadvākyānāṃ ka- cidvaiṣṇavyā varṇyaṃ śāstre kriyamāṇamasaṃgataṃ syāt |
ato nāmnāyasya balīyastvam |
ata: pratyakṣavirodhena dvaitavādā nirvvaṇīyā: |
tatra 'ekemevādvitīyaṃ' ityādyeka- tvaśrutaya: ekasmin śarīre eva svāmītyevaṃparā: |
'neha nānāsti kiṃcana' ityādi nānātvaniṣedha- śrutaya: anekaśarīragrahaṇe'pyeka ātmā, na nānā iti |
evaṃ 'eṣa neti neti' ityādayastu dehendriyādibhyo bheda- parā: |
tassādāgamādapi ātmanānātvaṃ sidhyati |
evaṃ ca sati nānā''tmavāde eva baddhamuktavyavasthopapatti: |
ekatve tu kālpanikī baddhamuktavyavastheti cet, tarhi bandhamokṣayormithyātvāt sādhu samarthita: advaitavādamirmokṣa: |
tathā viṣayagrahaṇe grāhakatvenaiva ātmana: siddhi:, na grāhyatvena, ekasya karmakartṛttvavirodhāt |
yadi viṣayagrahaṇe kartṛtvātmā na prakāśyate, tadā svaparavedyoranatiśaya: syāt |
athocyate, grāhakatvā anavabhāse'pi ātma- paravedyoratiśaya: sidhyatyeva |
tathāhi, khasamaveta- jñānajananeva svavedyasyātiśaya:, parasamavetajñānajananeva paravedyasya |
yathā yasyaiva gamanaṃ takṣaṇaṃ spandanaṃ, tasyaiva deśāntaraprāpti:, nāspandanavata: |
atha svaparasaṃbandha- jñānajananavayavasthe kathaṃmavagamyate iti cet, svīkīya- parakīyandriyārthasannikarṣādijñānahetusāmagrībhedena sukhamava- gantuṃ śakyate |
nanu grāhakasyāpi tvātmamyantarbhūtavenā- vagamaprasaṅga: |
naivaṃ, indriyādivat anavagatasyāpi sattvā''pi kāraṇatvasaṃbhavāt |
viṣayabodha evātmabodha iti ca bhrāntabhāṣitam |
nahi anyasya bodhe anyasya siddhi:, atiprasaṅgāt |
kiṃca saṃvidadhīnā ca sakala- bhāvavyavasthāsiddhi:, sā viṣayaprakāśakāle na prakāśyate, kimuta punastadāśrayatvena prakāśa: |
yattu ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmīti viṣayaprakāśakāle sarvatra niyamena tritayaṃ prakāśate ityucyate, tadapi sarvalokaviruddhaṃ, ghaṭo'yaṃ paṭo'yamiti viṣayamātrasyaiva prakāśane sarvatrikam |
yattu cit jñānavyavahāra:, sa prākaṭyādyanumitajñāna- nibandhana: prakāśa: |
jñātṛvyavahārastu mānasapratyakṣahetuka iti na viṣayabodhādātmasiddhi: |
api ca yadi ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmītivyavahārāt ātmasiddhirviṣayajñānanibandhanavat tarhi 'cākṣuṣaṃ rūpaṃ' 'āvaṇa: śabda:' ityādindriyaviśiṣṭa- vyavahārāt cakṣurādisiddhirāpi rūpādijñānāt syāt |
atha tatrāpyamānasiddhacakṣurādinibandhanaśrutvādidyava- hāra:, tarhi atrāpi jñānāntaranibandhana: iti tulyacarca: |
na caikasya karmakartṛbhāvavirodha:, rūpamedādi tadupapatte: |
cetanādirūpeṇa grāhyatvaṃ jñātṛrūpeṇa grāhakatvamiti |
atrocyate |
sarvaviṣayabodhe ātmana: ahamiti pratītirā- stheyā |
anyathā mayedaṃ viditamiti pratibhāsābhāva- prasaṅgāt |
bhavati ca viṣayavittī mayedaṃ viditamiti sarveṣāṃ sarvatra pratibhāsa: |
tadanavabhāse svaparavedyayo: atiśayo na syāt |
asti ca vailakṣaṇyaṃ svarūpata: kāryataśca |
svavedyaṃ tu svapratiyogitayā prakāśate, paravedyaṃ tu parapratiyogitayā |
yo'yaṃ svavedyasya paravedyāti- śaya:, sa: asati svabhāve nopapadyate ityarthāpatti: grāhaka- siddhī pramāṇam |
nanu atiśaya: anyathā''pi upa- padyate |
khasamavetajñānotpattireva svavedyasya paravedyāti- śaya: |
yathā yasyaiva gamanaṃ, tasyaiva deśāntaraprāptiriti |
tanna, yadi khasamavetajñānāt vedyamātrameva jñānaṃ, tadā jñātādhiṣyāt ajñātasya so'tiśayo bhavatu, na para- jñānāt svajñānasya |
yadā puna: khasamavetajñāne ātmano- 'pi pratītirista, tadā svavedyasya paravedyāt rūpavailakṣaṇyaṃ kāryavailakṣaṇyaṃ copapadyate, abhāvasya vyavahārānupapatte: |
ātmana: śarīrādibheda 895 ātmana: vibhūnāṃ
na ca vāstavajñānasamavāyamātrāntrādasādhāraṇyaṃ, vyabhicārāt |
nahi svīkayena dīpena svasyaiva prakāśo, na parasyeti niyama: |
yattu viṣayamātrameva prakāśate, vyavahāro'pi tasyaiva, ātmavyavahārastu na viṣayagrahaṇaniyata iti |
tanna, yatra ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmīti ātmavyavahāra: saṃpratipanna:, tatrāpi nātmaviṣayajñānāt ahaṃvyavahārasyopapatti: |
ātmaviṣayajñānasya śatrāviṣāyāyamānatvāt |
na cāsi- dena anyonyopapattipūrvakaṃ śakyate |
atastatnāpi viṣaya- bodhādeva ahaṃvyavahāra iti vaktavyam |
evaṃ ca sati yatra viṣayamātravyavahāra: ghaṭo'yamiti, tatrāpi viṣaya- jñānādeva kartṛtayā 'ātmā me jñāta:' 'iti, yadi paraṃ vyajiviharṣā''bhāvādātmani saṃvide vyavahāro na jāta: |
na ca jñātasya sarvasya vyavahāraniyama:, nirvikalpādī vyabhicārāt |
ato viṣayabodhādeva ātmā na jñānajño:, tadaivaṃ pratīti: syāt 'ghaṭastāvadayaṃ, jñāyate na veti na vidma:, mama vā pratibhāsate parasya vā ityapi na vidma:' iti |
na ca tathā dṛśyate |
yattu cākṣuṣaṃ rūpamityādipratītivyavahārābhyāṃ cakṣuso'pi viṣayajñānena pratītiprasaṅga iti, tadyuktaṃ, tathāvidhapratītiniyāmā- vāt cakṣurādyanumānajñānameva niścīyate |
atra tu jñānāntarameva na saṃbhavati, vyavahāro'pi niyata: ityuktam |
na ca mānasapratyakṣeṇa ātmaviṣayajñānaṃ bhavati, ekasyaiva kartṛkarmabhāvavirodhāt |
na ca rūpabhedāt kartṛkarmabhāvopapatti:, niraṃśatvāt grāhakaika- rūpatvādātmana: |
dravyādirūpatvaṃ tu nātmana eva |
nanu kriyājanyaphalabhāgitvaṃ hi karmatvaṃ, yathā gamanajanyaphalabhāgino grāmasya, atrāpi saṃvedanakriyā- janyaphalaṃ bhāsanaṃ vyavahāro vā, tadubhayamapi ātmani abhyupagatameva, ato na kartṛtvam |
na ca caikasya karmatva- bhāva: kacidapi dṛṣṭa: |
tassādātmaviṣayamātmakarmakameva kimapi jñānaṃ śaśaviṣāṇatulyameva |
kiṃca ghaṭamahaṃ jānā- mīti vartamānapratītivyavahārau dṛśyate, tatra bhavatā jñānasya kṣaṇikatvena svānumānakāle atītatvāt asādhisamiti bhūtapratītivyavahāraveva syātāṃ na vartamānapratītivyavahārau |
kiṃca anumānādapi ātmano grāhakatayā siddhi: |
'ghaṭa- mahaṃ vedmi' ityātmano grāhakatayā bhānaṃ sarveṣāṃ saṃmata- meva |
tadidaṃ grāhakatayā bhānaṃ viṣayavittīdhīnaṃ, bhāna- tvāt, vittivedyabhānavat |
vitteśca viṣayavittīdhīnatvaṃ sādhitameva |
api ca ātmasādhikā saṃvit svāśraya- vyatiriktakarmikā, sakarmakakriyātvāt, pākādivat |
ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmītyātmano vyavahāra: ghaṭajñānanibandhana:, tadanantaramupajāyamānatvāt, ghaṭavyavahāravat, ātma- viṣayajñānānantaramupajāyamānatvāt |
tadanantaramupajāya- mānatvamiddhamiti cenna, ātmaviṣayajñānasyaiva śaśa- viṣāṇatulyatvāt asiddhi: anyāsiddhirvā vaktuṃ na śakyate |
kiṃca vivādādhyāsitātmasvarūpasiddhi: viṣa- yānubhavanibandhanā, ātmasvarūpasiddhitvāt jāgrata: ātmasvarūpavat, yathā suptikāle ātmasvarūpasiddhi- rnāsti, prabodhadaśāyāṃ viṣayānanubhavadarśanāt ātmasvarūpa- siddhinirmīyate tadityartha: |
ata: siddham 'buddhī- ndriyādibhyo bhinna ātmā vibhudhaiva: |
nānā- bhūta: pratikṣetramekavidheṣu bhāsate' 'iti |
pravi. pṛ. 84-97. kartṛlopavyāsastu virupyate niṣkriyātvāt ātmana: |
sarvagatatvācca niṣkriyatvam |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 173. sākṣātkāreṇa pratibhāsamānatvāt ātmana: anumānādiṣyāpi pratyakṣatva |

) nāpahavāya, ( kiṃtu ) paratvatipatteye |
kimiti tarhi apahavaḥ ? |
sākṣāt hetutvādyanādarātparaṇa |

' na vayaṃ ' iti na sākṣāt hetatayā idamupamyastaṃ iti prakaṭitam |

) nanu ca ' ahaṃ gacchāmi ' iti na hetvarthapradarśanārthatā śakyate parihartum |
atra hi ahaṃpratyayo'pi vyabhicāryeva upalabhyate asalanātmaka- tvādātmanaḥ |

kimiti nirāśāhaikeva gamyate ? ( uttaraṃ - ) kimatrāśaṅkanīyam ( nāstyevāśaṅkanīyam |

) gauṇaḥ upapadyate iti cet, parihṛtaṃ tathaiva |

’ iti siddhatvātsvārthasya |

) atrocyate |
ayamasabhiprāyaḥ :, jñeyatve hyatmanaḥ jñānajñātṛṇī na vyati- rikte śakyete vaktum |
na ca
tayaiva saṃvidupanyāsā |
tasmāt pratipakṣopanyāsa evāyam |
kathaṃ tenaiva tat bādhyate |
nahi yat yasyaiva bādhyaṃ, tat tasyaiva bādhakaṃ bhavitumarhati |
tasmāt samyaguttaram |
' yathā kaściccakṣuṣmān ' iti anenāpi nidarśanena kartṛkaraṇāntarameva eṣa sthirīkṛtaḥ |

ataḥ asyātmā yadyapi kartṛntaraṃ nāsti ) ukte ca ' yathā'vagamyante arthāḥ tathā bhavanti |
na tathā, yathā nāvagamyante ' iti |

vāggrahaṇaṃ ca kara- ṇāṃtarabhāvanidarśanārtham |
' ātmajyotaḥ samprāditi hovāca ' ityayamarthaḥ pūrvottarapakṣabhaṅgyā pradarśitaḥ |
evaṃ ca ' agryo na hi gṛhyate ' iti brāhmaṇamupapannam |
nanu cātra agrāhyatvopapanyāsā |
( uttare - ) nanu na śrutaṃ bhavatā ' ātmajyotaḥ : samprāṭ ' iti, idamapi kiṃ na śrutaṃ dvayoḥ : tadanurodhena ( svayaṃjyotiṣvānurodhena ) asya agrahaṇaśrutiḥ : āpekṣikī, na punaḥ ātmagrahaṇaṃ anyathā ( parapuruṣābhiprāyeṇa ) vyākhyāyate iti |
kā yuktiḥ ? svayaṃjyotirgrahaṇe guṇavādasyāsaṃbhavāt, agrāhyatve ca āpekṣikatvā upapatteḥ |
ātmā jñātavyo mantavyaḥ iti nāvirodhāt |
evaṃ ca svayaṃjyotiṣvamupapadyate iti |
nanu caivaṃ sati kathaṃ parasmai pratipādayituṃ śakyate ? parapratya- yārthe cāyamārambhaḥ : śāstrakārāṇāṃ śrutīnāṃ ca |
svasaṃvi- deva abhyupāyatāṃ pratipadyate |
yata ātmanā saṃvedyate na pareṇati |
sarvapuruṣeṣu ca parāsaṃvedyā saṃvitsiti siddhā |
parasaṃviātiṣedhamukhena copadeśānāṃ upadeśatā, tadidaṃ ' neti neti ' ityupyastam |
nanu ca sukhādyo'pi svasaṃvedyā eva, te'pi pareṇa naiva parasyāḥ saṃvedyante |
kathaṃ tebhyo'nyatayā parasmai upadiṣṭa ātmā bhavati |
tatra bhāṣyakāreṇa liṅgavagamyatayā pareṇāvagamyante evetyuktam |
tadayuktamiva, ātmano'pi prasaṅgāt |
tatrāpi ceṣā'numānaṃ svayamupanyasyati |
ataḥ pratipakṣopaghātī kathaṃ vidvadbhiḥ likhyate ? tadidamapyupasthitaguruśrautrayam |
ceṣṭā hi kāraṇa- doṣanirākaraṇatayā upanyastā |
sukhādyastu bhūmajñanetra- vilasādigamyāḥ |

bhāṣya-- ādhānaprakaraṇe 'yaḥ somena yakṣyamāṇo'- gnīnādadhīta natu pṛcchet nakṣatraṃ' iti śrutam |
na ca tena somasya ādhānānantaryaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyaṃ, ānantarya- syāśravaṇāt vākyabhedaprasaṅgācca |
ato vihitakālanādara- mātraṃ ādhānodeśena vidhīyate |
'somena yakṣyamāṇaḥ ?' iti tu anuvādaḥ |
tena 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyām
ādhānasya iṣṭipūrvatva

ādhāne 'utpattividhimālocya sāmnāṃ vedā- ntarīyatā |
sāṅgapradhānasambandhādupāyaṃśutvaṃ tu gamyate |

vi. 6|1|5. ādhāne dakṣiṇānāṃ aparimitatvaṃ pūrvoktāt ekādaśahāntasaṃkhyāyāḥ sakāśāt saṃkhyā'ntaram |
bhā. 6|1|122. ādhāne dakṣiṇānāṃ aparimitatvaṃ sahasrā- dhikatvam |
aniyamo'viśeṣāt |
bhāṣya-- aparimita (aparimitaṃ deyaṃ ityatra ) kalpāntara iti sampāditam |
athedānīmidaṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ sahasrādūnaṃ aparimitaṃ, uta sahasrādhikamiti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? aniyamo'viśeṣāt |
na kaścidiha bahule viśeṣa āśrīyate sahasrādūnamadhikaṃ veti |
anāśrīyamāṇe yathākāmaṃ syāt, yathākṛtaṃ sādhu |
tasmādaniyamaḥ |
adhikaṃ vā syād, bahurthatvāditaraiḥ saṃnidhā- nāt |
bhāṣya-- veti pakṣavyāvṛttiḥ |
naitadasti adhika- mūnaṃ vā sahasrāditi |
kiṃ tarhi ? adhikameveti |
kutaḥ ? bahurthatvāt aparimitaśabdasya |
bahuṣu hi imaṃ śabdaṃ upacaranti ityetaduktam |
bahutvaṃ cāpekṣikaṃ, kiṃ cidapekṣya tato'dhikaṃ bahu ityucyate |
asalyāmapekṣāyāṃ aparipūṇametat |
yathā putraḥ kiṃ cidapekṣya bhavati, nānyathā |
tatra prakṛtaṃ saṃnihitaṃ cāpekṣya nirṇayaḥ; sahasraṃ ca saṃnihitam |
tasmāt tato'dhikaṃ aparimitamiti |
arthavādañca tadvat |
bhāṣya-- kathamevaṃ ? tatra 'utkṛṣṭaṃ vai aparimitaṃ' iti tadūnantāṃ sahasrasya darśayati |
śā-- 'āpekṣiko hi bahurthaḥ sahasrāpekṣayā bhavet |
tasyānantaranirdeśāt sahasrādhikastataḥ |
' soma-- pūrvokte viśeṣavicārāt saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- 'arvāgāpi bahutvaṃ
ādhāne pavamāneṣṭividhā
ādhāne pavamāneṣṭayaḥ
tvena noditānāṃ vivakṣitam |
na caikasāḥ prayogo, bahusaṃyuktaḥ prayogo bhavati |
tassāt sahaprayogo vijñāyate |
due-- 'samānaharvīṣi bhavanti' ityanuvādaḥ |
'brahma- varcasakāmasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi saha niṣpadyāṇi' iti tatra nirvāpe saha codite vacanāt tantraṃ bhavati |
tassāt tadapekṣayā anuvādo bhavati |
soma--nitye prayoge samānatantratā, kāmye tu prayoga- bhedaḥ |
aveṣṭī prayogadravyasya vairūpye'pi pavamāneṣṭividhu na vairūpyaṃ ityuktānāta saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- 'pavamāneṣṭividhāṃ tantraṃ medo'thavā, 'grimaḥ |
sādhyadeśādyamedā, 'tha kāmye medoktisto'ntimaḥ |
' bhaṭṭa-- anekapradhānakāḥ pavamāneṣṭayaḥ ' saṃvatsare nirvāpeta, dvādaśāhe caturahe vā, aho nirupyāṇi' itya- nena tatkālaviśiṣṭaikaprayogavidhānāt, 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇa- māsyā yajeta' ityādidat ekaprayogeṇaiva kartavyā itya- vivādam |
ata eva 'aho nirupyāṇi' ityatra ahan: sadyaḥ ādhānesaṃnikṛṣṭāni ityarthāṅgīkāre saṃvatsarādi- kālabādhamātrāṅgīkāre'pi saṃvatsaravākye kālaviśeṣāvaśyaka- tvena tatra ekaprayogavidherāvaśyakatvāt |
tasyaiva ca ādhānesaṃnikarṣavidhānena sadyaḥpakṣe'pi ekaprayogatā- siddhiḥ |
ata eva 'saha nirupyāṇi', ityanuvādo'pi saṃgacchate |
tadevaṃ nityaprayoge sahatvavidhāne'pi saṃyoga- pṛthaktvanyāyena (4|3|15-7) 'yo brahmavarcasakāmaḥ syāt tasya sarvāṇi saha nirupyāṇi', ityanena phalārthe sahatvaṃ dadhyādivat vidhīyate |
tadevaṃ sthite punaḥ : 'yaḥ kāmayeta uttarottaraṃ vasīyān śreyān syāmiti, tasyāme pavamānāya nirupya pāvakaśucibhyāṃ uttare haviṣī samāna- barhīṣi nirvāpeta' iti śrutam |
tatra laghya pavamāna- prayogottarakālatvāviśiṣṭapāvakaśucisamānatantraikaprayogatve phalārthe vidhānāt na trayāṇāmekaprayogatā |
na ca nitya- prayoge trayāṇāmapi sahatvavidhānāt atra laghya pradhāna- mātrakrama eva dadhyādivat phalārthe vidhīyatā iti vācyam |
tathātve uttarayoreva samānaharvīṣtvānuvādā- nupapatteḥ |
na caivaṃ prayogabhede kartṛbhedāt laghyukta- samānakartṛkatvānupapattiḥ, varaṇabharaṇādibhedena ṛtvigbhediṣṭha- kartṛtvamede tadadhiṣṭhānekamātreṇa yajamānarūpakatraikyena vā tadupapatteḥ |
vastutastu ādhāneṣṭividhā pavamāneṣṭimadhye eva dānavidhānāt tatraiva prasaṅgena kāryasiddheḥ na pavamāneṣṭeṣu pṛthagvaraṇabharaṇe |
atastatra kālikaprayoga- bhede'pi kartṛttvaikyāt lyabupapattirityalam |
maṇḍana-- 'pavamāneṣṭitantratā |
na |
śaṃkara-- 'na seṣṭiṣu guṇāt phale' |
sā tantratā |
ādhāne pavamāneṣṭayaḥ na pavamāneṣṭi- saṃskṛte'pi, kintu kevalādhānasaṃskṛte eva |
vāsāgniḥ prakṛtiḥ |
prajājavat syāt |
bhārgya-- santi pavamāneṣṭayaḥ ' agre pavamānāya ' ityevamādyāḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛte agnau pavamāneṣṭayaḥ kartavyāḥ, uta neti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? tāsāṃ khalu pavamāneṣṭīnāṃ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛtaḥ agniḥ prakṛtitaḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? codakasāmarthyāt prajājavat |
yathā āśu prayājā bhavanti codakena, evaṃ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛtā agnayo'pi bhaveyuḥ |
vā-- 'tasyāṃ tu syāt prajājavat' (10|1| 4|6) ityetadadhikaraṇanyāyena pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛtāgni- sādhyatvaṃ tāsāmiti nāstīti vicāraḥ |

'yadeva tṛtīyaṃ jyotistadeva tenāpyate' ityāhavanīyaṃ prakṛtya śrutyantarāt |
iti prāpte, tṛtīyapatoḥ padasya auttaravedi- kābhiraparatvāt 'sa hi tasya' ityekavacanena sahitābhidhaya- paratvāyogena sa gārhapatyaḥ tāhavanīyasya yonirityeva tadarthakatayā ṛtvijāmapi tayorlokaṃta eva praklaptiḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|3.

idamamānanti 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta, grīṣme rājyanyaḥ, śaradi vaiśyaḥ' iti |
tatra saṃdihyate kiṃ brāhma- ṇādiśravaṇaṃ nimittārthe, brāhmaṇadasyaiva ādhānāḥ, vasantādiṣvādhīrninti, uta brāhmaṇādīnāmādhānaṃ vidhīyate iti |
pūrvādhikaraṇe prāsaṅgikamavedheḥ prayogamedaṃ nirūpya idānīṃ prastuta eva guṇanivandhanaḥ karmabhedaḥ prati- pādyate |
atrādyaṃ pūrvapakṣiko'miṃsandhiḥ |
sarvopapada- śravaṇe sati upapadārthasaṃkrānto vidhiḥ dhātvarthānuvāda- pekṣate iti siddham |
tadapi 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnāda- dhīta' iti vasantādyupapadārthasambandhitvāt ādhānānu- vādamapekṣate |
na cādhānamaprāptaṃ, agnihotrādibhi- revākṣipataḥ prāptatvāt |
tathāhi, āhavanīyasādhyāḥ khalu agnihotrādayaḥ 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti śruteḥ; 'āhitāgnirāhavanīyaḥ' ityevadavaśāt āhavanīyaśca ādhānasādhyaḥ ityākṣepāt asyeva ādhānaprāptiḥ |
athavā 'ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte' ityetasādeva ana- nyākṣitaśakteḥ vidhāyakāt ādhānasya prāptatvāt tadanu- vādena vasantādikālavidhānāya nimittārthe brāhmaṇadi- śravaṇamiti |
na cāyaṃ vartamānapadeśasya vidhiḥ |
'ya evaṃ sapanaṃ bhrātṛvyamavati sahate, ya evaṃ vidvānagnimā- dhatte' ityevadasaṃnbandhāt vidhivisiddheḥ |
taduktaṃ 'sāmarthyātkimādhānaṃ sāmānyavacanena vā |
tasmād varṇaviśeṣaṇāṃ nimittārthaṃ punaḥśrutiḥ |
' iti |
(vā. pṛ. 588) |
nanvādhānaviśiṣṭe brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇa- viśiṣṭaṃ vā ādhānamaṃ nimittaṃ ? ubhayathā'pi ca viśi- ṣṭānuvāde vākyabhedaḥ |
ucyate |
aprāptavastvidhau prāptātvāt brāhmaṇādyanoranuvādaḥ |
tatrāpi viśeṣaṇaparyāta, kārakasya ca kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt, brāhmaṇasyaiva nimitta- tvācca vākyabhedaḥ |
na ca nimittakālyorhorapi udedaya- tvena kathamasmin vākye samāveśaḥ |
iti vācyam |
kālasya kriyā'nvayitvāt nimittasya ca kartavyatvāt vaila- kṣaṇyena samāveśopapatteḥ |
tena yathā'yupapatravyatirekeṇa ādhānasambandhena brāhmaṇādyanuvādādarthavādatvāt brāhmaṇādi- nimittake ādhāne vasantakalāvidhānamiti |
evaṃ prāpte abhidhīyate |
bhavedevaṃ, yadi yathāśrutasyādhānasya ākṣe- pata: prāptirbhavet |
atra hi 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta' ityātmanepadāt kartṛgāmiphalamādhānaṃ pratīyate |
phalaṃ ca ādhānasya āhavanīyaḥ |
tena anuvādapakṣe evāyaṃ vākyārthaḥ, 'kartṛgātāhavanīyaphalabhājanaṃ brāhmaṇena vasante kartavyam' |
na ca agnihotrādibhiritebhireva ākṣepā- devaṃvidhamādhānaṃ labhyate, yadapyeta |
āhavanīyo hi tairākṣipyate, na tu ādhānānuprabandham |
ekena āhitasya anyaiḥ krayaṇādinā'pi upādānasaṃbhavāt |
na ca anuvāda- gataviśeṣadarśanāt tathābhūtasyaivākṣepa iti vācyam |
saṃdehe sati anuvādadarśanātpi nirṇayo bhavati |
yathā 'airaṃ kṛtvādeyam' ityatra irāpadasya kasmin sthāne niveśaḥ iti saṃdehe 'na girā girā' iti niṣedhānuvādadarśa- nāt irāpadasya girāpadasthānaniveśo nirṇītaḥ |
iha tu 'āhavanīye juhoti' iti viniyogabalāt āhava- nīyamantareṇa ṛtuvidhyasaṃbhavāt bhavatu āhavanīyopādānā- kṣepaḥ |
sa ca svataḥ prāpyabhāvāt vasantādiviśiṣṭādhāna- meva |
nanu mā bhūt ṛtuśrāvyatāsthityanuvādaḥ |
'ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte' iti pratyakṣameva vacanena vidhāyaka- masti āgneyapadayuktam |
tatra kartṛgāmiphalasyaivādhā- nasya prāptatvāt tadanuvādena vasantādivākyeṣu brāhmaṇādinimittaṃ vasantādiphalamātraṃ vidhāsyate |
maivam, syādevaṃ yadi 'ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte' iti vidharbhavet |
kiṃ tarhi ? ādhānāṅgatopasarjanadisaṃbhāra- vidhyekavākyatayā vartamānapadeśarūpaḥ |
kṛtsna evāyamartha- vādaḥ |
evaṃ hi śrūyate 'sa evaṃ sapanaṃ bhrātṛvyamavati

sahate |
ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte apa upasṛjati' iti |
kiṃca ādhatīti asaṃdigdhaḥ pratyakṣo'tra vidhiḥ śrūyate |
tathā sati agnihotrādiśruteḥ ākṣepaḥ, vartamānapadeśasya vidhitvakalpanāṃ vā na saṃbhavati |
taduktaṃ 'pratyakṣavidhi- sadbhāve lakṣyate nānumānikaḥ |
prāpakatvamato nārtha- vartamānapadeśayoḥ |
' iti |
(vā. pṛ. 589) ataḥ sarvathā prāpyabhāvāt vasantādivākyeṣu brāhmaṇādīnāṃ nimittārthe śravaṇaṃ, kiṃtu kartṛkālanekuṇasaṃśraddhāni bhinnānyeva ādhānāni vidhīyante |
nanu apaśudhā dhikaraṇe eva ādhānakṣepo 'ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte' iti vidhiṃ varṇayiṣyate |
atra kathamanyathā vicāraḥ ? iti |
ucyate |
tatra hi pradhānabhūtakarmaṇi kamiśruteḥ varṇa- catuṣṭayasādhāraṇatvāt |
tadvalena śudrādhikāre sati tadu- papatyarthe kamiśrutimeva varṇacatuṣṭayasambandhenaiva ādhānasyā- kṣepo bhaviṣyati |
'agnimādhatte' ityasya varṇacatuṣṭayasādhā- raṇānādhānavācakatvaṃ vasantādivākyasyaiva kāla- viśeṣavidhānāt śudrādhikṛtakālīnamevādhānamiti śudra- syāpi āhitāgneradhikārapūrvapakṣe, siddhāntitaṃ kamiśrute- varṇaparatve'pi avirodhāt na etadadhikaraṇasiddhavasantā- divākyānāṃ viśiṣṭādhānakṣepeṇa śudrādhikāraḥ saṃbhavati |
tena kamiśruteḥ varṇacatuṣṭayādhikāratvena samadhikaśudrā- dhikārasaṃsiddherā nirāsārthaṃ tadadhikaraṇam |
tasiddhaṃ caitada- dhikaraṇasiddhameva sarvaṃ sāritamityapi punaruktam |
prayo- janam - pūrvapakṣe āhitasyāpi agre krayaṇādilakṣaṇasya karmāṅgatvam |
siddhānte tu ādhānottaratveva karmāṅgatvam |
sūtraṃ tu - ādhāne'pi pūrvavadeva pāvanavacanāni na nimi- tārthāni ādhānasya asarvaśeṣatvāt āhavanīyavat karma- śeṣatvābhāvena ākṣepābhāvādityarthaḥ |
dvitīyavarṇake tu sarvaśeṣatvāditi |
tatraiṣā vyākhyā, abupasarjanadisarva- saṃbhāraśeṣatvādityarthaḥ |

'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta' 'grīṣme rājanyaḥ' 'śaradi vaiśyaḥ' iti śrutiḥ : ādhāne brāhmaṇādīnāṃ nimittatvamāha, na tu ādhānaprāptikā śrutiriyaṃ iti usūtre pūrvapakṣe siddhāntamāha |
ādhāne viṣaye vasantādi- vākyaṃ brāhmaṇadivasantādiviśiṣṭādhānaprāpakaṃ, na tu prāptā- dhāne nimittasaṃyogena kālaviśeṣadyotakam |
ādhānasya asarvaśeṣa-vān sarvakarmaśeṣatvābhāvāt sarvakarmaṇvatayā ādhānavidheḥ aśravaṇāt |
tasmāt brāhmaṇādīnāṃ ādhānasya prāpakāṇi śrutyādīni iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhavadevaṃ tu sarva- asarva ityanyathā vyākhyātam |
tatra sarvaśeṣatvāt sarva- saṃbhāraśeṣatvāt iti varṇakāntareṇa vyākhyātam |

agniḥ prāta- rādityaṃ gacchati iti sūryamantraḥ eva vaktavyaḥ iti stutiḥ |

ārambhaṇīyā prakṛtyārambhe iva vikṛtyārambhe'pi pṛthak kartavyā iti siddhānte hetvantaraparaṃ sūtram |

ke. ārambhaṇīyā sarvaprayogasādhāraṇatvāt puruṣārtha- tvādvā sakṛdeva darśapūrṇamāsārambhe kartavyā |
na tu prati- darśapūrṇamāsa
yakṣye' ityevaṃvidhamahāsaṃkalpaviṣayakapravṛttereva vastuto dīkṣaṇīyāviṣayakecchājanyatayā dīkṣaṇīyoddeśyatattvena tatsaṃkalpatvāt pūrvameva dīkṣaṇīyā''khyatvena sā kāryā ityapyāsta, tadicchāyā: 'sāṅgo jyotiṣṭomo me jāyatāṃ' ityākārakatvena sāṅgatvena rūpeṇa dīkṣaṇīyāviṣayatve'pi dīkṣaṇīyātvena tadviṣayatvābhāvāt |
ato dvārarūpārtha- lopāt na jyotiṣṭomārambhe, na vā dīkṣaṇīyā''rambhe, sā kāryā iti siddham |
vistareṇa ca etadasmābhi: navame eva ( 9|1|11 ) nirūpitam |

' 4. ārambhaṇīyāyā: darśapūrṇamāsavikṛtiṣu sauryādiṣu punaranuṣṭhānam |
ārambhaṇīyā vikṛtau na syāt prakṛtikālamadhya- tvāt, kutā punastadartham |
( atra bhāpustake sūtrāt prāk avataraṇatvena 'atrā- śaṅkate' iti mudritam |
kalakattāpustake vitarkarīye'pi ca idamastyeva, parantu pūrvasūtrabhāṣye mudritam |
pūrvasūtre ca niśīṣṭo imābhyārthaṃ: agnyādhānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ ityuktam |
taduttaraṃ ca ārambhaṇīyāvicāra: |
evaṃ sati 'atrā- śaṅkate' iti padadvayaṃ pūrvatra uttaratra ca sarvathā asaṃ- gatameva |
asmiṃstu tat padadvayaṃ tyaktameva |
) bhāṣya-- vaikṛteṣu karmasu darśapūrṇamāsādhikārambha- ṇīyā kartavyā, uta neti vicāre na kartavyā ityucyate |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ? prakṛtikālamadhyatvāt |

tanmadhye vaikṛtāni karmāṇi patanti |

syādvā, kālasyāśeṣabhūtatvāt |

bhāṣya-- vibhakta: prakṛtivikṛtyorārambha: |
yadā prakṛterārambha:, tadā vikṛtiranupannaiva |
sā hi kāmena nimittena vā codyate |
atastasyā: prakṛtyārambhe nārambha: |
ārambhabhedācca tannimittā ārambhaṇīyāyā: bheda: syāt |
tasmāt syāt vikṛtiṣu ārambhaṇīyā |
soma-- pūrvavat ihāpi prasaṅga: ityusthita: saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu- ārambhaṇīyā vikṛtau na syāt prakṛteryāvajjīva prayogatayā vikṛtīnāṃ tatkālamadhyapātena prakṛtyarthe kṛtāyā eva tasyā: vikṛtiṣu prasaṅgasambhavāt iti |
vi-- 'ārambhaṇīyā sauryādau nota syā, tra prayogavat |
, katyarthā na prayogārthā ārambhame tato bhavet |
' bhāṭṭa-- nāvamikādhikaraṇoktarītyā ārambhaṇī- yāyā: darśapūrṇamāsārambhajñatvāt vikṛtāvapi ati- deśena tadārambhajñatvopapatte: kartavyaiva ārambhaṇīyā |
na ca tasyā: sakṛt kṛtāyā eva prakṛtau sarvaprayogopakāra- katvāt anyadarśapūrṇamāsaprayogaṃ yāvat etajjanyopakārā- vasthānapratīte: tanmadhyakriyamāṇavikṛtiṣu upakārakatvo- papatte: prasaṅgasiddhiśaṅkā, asyā: darśapūrṇamāsārambha- bhūtāyā: dvitīyādiprayogānajñatvāt |
vistareṇa cāya- martho navame eva nirūpita: |
sarvayogājñatvaṃ vadatāṃ tantra- ratnakārādīnāṃ ca mataṃ nirākṛtam |
ata: anvārambha- ṇīyājanyasya upakārasya uktavicārambhe kṛte eva nāśāt anyadarśapūrṇamāsaprayoge yāvat avasthāne prayojanābhāvāt
tattadvikṛtyārambhajñatayā'pi anvārambhaṇīyā pṛthageva kāryā |
tantraratnakārādīnāṃ tu tasyā: sakṛt kṛtāyā eva sarvaprayogārthatvaṃ icchatāṃ vikṛtau prasaṅgapatti: anivāryaiva |
maṇḍana-- 'ārambhaṇīyā vikṛtau' syāt |
śaṃkara-- 'ārambhaṇīyā vikṛtau' |
ārambhaṇīyāyā: rājasūyagatānanumatyādīṣṭau bādha: |
pradhānācyanyasaṃyuktāt sarvairambhanivartetā- naṅgatvāt |
bhāṣya-- asti rājasūya: 'rājasūyena svārājya- kāmo yajeta' iti |
tatra iṣṭi-paśu-soma-darśapūrṇahomā: pradhānabhūtā: |
aiṣṭikeṣu anumatyādiṣu saṃśaya: kiṃ ārambhaṇīyā kartavyā, neti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? kartavyā |
'viṣe: kāraṇāntare'tideśāt sarvakarma syāt' ( 10| 1|12 ) iti |
evaṃ prāpte brūma: |
pradhānatvena apara- pradhānasaṃyuktān nivartitumarhati |
kuta: ? sarvairambha- yaina tatra jyotiṣṭoma: samāmnāyate 'agniṣṭomaṃ prathama- māharati' iti |
sa prakṛtānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ekaikasya tantreṇa samāmnāto bhavitumarhati |
ekaikasya hi atra pradhānasya tantreṇa sādhāraṇaṃ prakaraṇam |
tena anu- matyādīnāṃ ārambhārthe siddhe, na ārambhaṇīyā bhavitu- marhati |
dup-- 'sarvairambhayaina tatra jyotiṣṭoma: samāmnā- yate' ityuktaṃ ( bhāṣye ) |
kathaṃ ? jyotiṣṭoma: śrutyā phalena saṃdhyate |
na cobhayārthatā yuktā vinā vacanena |
anumānādyapi kāryāpattipramāṇaṃ na vidyate |
tasmāt ayuktaṃ pryāmānābhidhānam |
arthalopa eva vaktavya: |
nanu ṛtvigvaraṇaṃ sarvapradhānārthaṃ, tatra pradhānādīdīnāṃ ārambhaṇīyā bhaviṣyati |
ucyate |

yathā yūpavattvarhiṣi prokṣaṇasya ( nivṛtti: ) |

bhāvāt |
tasmāt dvāralopādeva bādha iti vārttikakāreṇa siddhāntitaṃ, tadeva granthakāreṇāpi ( śā. ) uktamiti dhyeyam |

' sā ārambhaṇīyā |
bhāṭṭa-- yatra rājasūyādau iṣṭipusarūpāṇi pradhānānveya anyapradhānasaṃyuktāni, tatra satyapi teṣāṃ prādhānye 'tatta- diṣṭyā yakṣye' ityādisaṃkalpasya 'tattadiṣṭimai jāyatāṃ' ityākārakatvenāntareṇāpi 'rājasūye me jāyatāṃ' ityā- kārakarājasūyatvaprakārakecchājanyatve'pi utpattisaṃbha- vena tattadiṣṭivyāvacchedyoddeśyatākapravṛttiviṣayatvābhāvāt na tata: pūrvaṃ tāvadārambhaṇīyā |
na vā 'rājasūyena yakṣye' iti mahāsaṃkalpatvāt pūrvaṃ, tasyāpi rājasūyatvāva- cchinnoddeśyatākapravṛttiviṣayatvena tattadiṣṭivyāvacchedyo- ddeśyatākapravṛttiviṣayatvābhāvāt |
nahi rājasūyatvaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsaniṣṭhāprakṛtitārūpitavikṛtitvā''vacchedakaṃ, tasya somayāge'pi sattvena atiprasaktvāt |
ata eva yatra cāturmāsyādau āgrayaṇādau vā nātiprasaktaṃ cāturmāsya- tvādi, tatra pratiyāgaṃ bhinnātideśakalpane satyapi, tasya uddeśyatā''vacchedakatve na kā cit kṣati: |
vastutastu prakṛtāvapi darśapūrṇamāsatvaṃ noddeśyatā''vacchedaka api tu āgneyādimeva, kālekyācca tantreṇa karaṇam |
'darśa- pūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yakṣye' ityasyāpi ca 'āgneyādibhiryakṣye' ityevārtha: |
tataśca vikṛtāvapi cāturmāsyādau tattadyāga- tvameva uddeśyatā''vacchedakaṃ, kālekyācca tantreṇa karaṇam |
'cāturmāsyairyakṣye' ityasya ca 'tattadyāgairyakṣye' itye- vārtha: iti na kaścit virodha: |
atastatra bhatratyeva tadārambhe anvārambhaṇīyā |
prakṛte tu satyapi tatta- diṣṭyāde: uddeśyatā''vacchedakatve tattatsomayāderapi uddeśyatā''vacchedakatvāt nānvārambhaṇīyā |
prakṛtau hi
'darśapūrṇamāsāvārambhyamāṇaḥ' ityanena darśapūrṇamāsā- syoḥ viśeṣaṇavidherjñāt apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇavelāyāṃ prakṛtāpūrvaniṣṭhakāryatānirūpitakāraṇatā'vacchedakatvavicchinne sati nirūpitakāraṇatā'navacchedakatvavicchinnaṃ uddeśyatā- viśeṣaṇaṃ vivakṣaṇīyaṃ, ataśca rājasūye tādṛśohyeta- tā'bhāvāt nānvārambhaṇīyā|
ata eva prakṛtau 'agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau ca me jāyantām' ityākārakecchā'pi nodeyatāghaṭikā|
anyathā agnihotrīyaprathamaprayogī- yādyapadārthesthāpi tādṛśohyetatā'prabhṛtiviṣayatvāt tatrāpi anvārambhaṇīyā''patteḥ|
ataḥ tādṛśohyottaraṃ 'darśa- pūrṇamāsau jāyetāṃ' ityākārakecchā jāyate, saiva uddeśyatāghaṭikā iti dhyeyam|

'anvārambhaṇīyeṣṭyā yakṣye' iti saṃkalpasya sāṅgo darśapūrṇamāsau me jāyetām' ityākārakecchājanyapravṛttyā- ''pi utpattisaṃbhavena anvārambhaṇīyātvā''vacchinneoddeśya- tākapravṛttiviṣayatvābhāvāt|
ata eva vaimṛdhe cātu- rmāsyādyaṅgabhūtavaiśvānarapārjanyādhikārapadau pavāmāneṣṭa- ṣpi ca nānvārambhaṇīyā|
anvārambhaṇīyāṃ tu tṛtī- yoktapavamāneṣṭinyāyenāpi nānvārambhaṇīyā|
evaṃ vaimṛdhe- 'pi na vaimṛdhaḥ|

' svaṃ ārambhaṇīyā|

atra hi darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ na tattadvyaktitvena pravṛtti prati uddeśyatā, yena tad-vyaktitvavacchinnoddeśyaka- pravṛttidharmāsamānakālīnataduddeśyakapravṛttiviṣayatvāt dvitīyaprayogīyādyapadārthatvenāpi sā syāt |
darśapūrṇa- māsau iti śravaṇāttu darśapūrṇamāsameva uddeśyatā'vacche- dakam |
āvaśyakaṃ ca ubhayatrāpi pravṛttipratiuddeśya- tā'vacchedakavibhaktyā, itarathā sāmānyato ‘vihitakriyā ge jāyatāṃ’ ityākārakauddeśyatayāḥ : gaṅgāsnānapravṛttāvapi darśapūrṇamāsoddeśyakapravṛttitvāt tatrāpi ārambhaṇīyā- ''patteḥ |
ato darśapūrṇamāsāvacchinnoddeśyakatāpravṛtti- dhaṃsāsamānakālīnatadavacchedakapravṛttiviṣayatvenaiva prathamapadārthasya uddeśyatā |
atra sāmānyākārakecchāyāṃ gaṅgāsnānānuṣṭhānottaraṃ ādyadarśapūrṇamāsaprayoge'pi anvā- rambhaṇīyā na syāt, ataḥ : prathamāvacchedakavivakṣā |
darśapūrṇamāsakāṇḍe'pi uktatvicchecchyā gaṅgāsnānakaraṇe tadāpatteḥ : dvitīyāvacchedakavivakṣā |
vastutastu ‘darśapūrṇa- māsau me jāyetāṃ’ ityākārakecchayā gaṅgāsnānakaraṇe'pi tadāpattivāraṇārthaṃ yasmin padārthe saṃkalpatvādirūpe kṛte darśapūrṇamāsau ārabdhau iti vyavahāraḥ : tatpadārthapravṛttereva uddeśyatā'vacchedakatve praveśa āvaśyakatve, tat eva uktakhaṇḍe'pi vāraṇasiddheḥ, tattadvyaktitvādeḥ uddeśyatā- 'vacchedakatvāraṇārthameva avacchedakavivakṣā |
ata eva tadāpadyaiva uktalakṣaṇeva ārambhatvāt na dvitīyādi- prayoge anvārambhaṇīyā |
nanu evaṃ ‘sāṅgena jyotiṣṭomena yakṣye’ ityevaṃvidha- saṃkalpaviṣayapravṛtteḥ : dīkṣaṇīyātvāvacchinnoddeśyakapravṛtte tataḥ pūrve anvārambhaṇīyā''pattiḥ |
yadi tu uddeśyatāyāḥ tatra ‘sāṅgo jyotiṣṭomo jāyatāṃ’ ityevaṃ- mākārakecchāviṣayaviśiṣṭatvena viśiṣṭadharmāvacchinna- tvāt noktapravṛttitvaṃ ityāśaṅkyeta, tataḥ : ‘dīkṣaṇīyā yakṣye’ ityevaṃvidhāvāntarasaṃkalpatvāt pūrve anvārambhaṇīyā- karaṇapattiḥ, tasya nirūpravṛttiviṣayatvāt, avāntara- saṃkalpaviṣayapravṛtteḥ : ‘dīkṣaṇīyā me jāyatāṃ’ ityevamākā- rakecchājanyatvena dīkṣaṇīyātvāvacchinnoddeśyakatvāt |
evaṃ rājasūyagateṣṭipaśubandhavādiṣvapi anvārambhaṇīyā''pattiḥ, iti cenna |
‘dīkṣaṇīyā jāyatāṃ’ ityākārakecchā'nu- pattāvapi ‘sāṅgo jyotiṣṭomo jāyatāṃ’ ityākāraka- sāṅkavajasravaprakārakatvena eva ‘dīkṣaṇīyā yakṣye’ ityevaṃvidhasaṃkalpaviṣayapravṛtteḥ saṃbhavata tādṛśasaṃkalpa- rūpādhyavasāyasya dīkṣaṇīyātvāvacchinnoddeśyatākapravṛtti- viṣayatvābhāvena dvāralopādeva dīkṣaṇīyā''sī da rājasūya- gateṣṭipaśubandhādau ca anvārambhaṇīyā''bhāvasya daśame (10|1|2|4) vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
evaṃ ‘somo me jāyatāṃ’ ityākārakecchaiva ca somādyarthameva vaiśvā- nareṣṭyādau pravṛttisaṃbhavāt ‘vaiśvānareṣṭyā yakṣye’ iti saṃkalpasyāpi vaiśvānareṣṭyātvāvacchinnoddeśyatākapravṛttipa-

ata: siddhaṃ anvārambhaṇīyāyā: uktavidhārambhātvāt vikṛtau ūha: |
dvitīyādiprayoge ca anaṅgatvamiti |
yattu mūle prathamaprayogārambhe kriyamāṇāma anvārambha- ṇīyā sarvaprayogāṇāmupakaroti |

ata: prathamaprayogārambhe kṛtaiva sarvamupakārikā ityuktam |

yadyapi prathamaṃ liṅadayo na vyatirekaṃ niyogaṃ pratipādayitumīśate, avahantyādiṣviva śabdakathamānādhikāraniyogādanuvādakatvāt, tathāpi adhikāraniyogaṃ prati eṣāṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgīnāṃ avāntarapūrvāṇāṃ ajanayatāṃ ajñatā upapadyate iti paścādadhikārāvapūrvābhāvenopādeya āśravaṇī- yāvāntarapūrvāṇi liṅā'bhidheyānupeyate |
tadetat dīkṣaṇīyādyunnimādhikaraṇe vyupāditam |
nanveva- māśritya avāntarapūrvābhyupagamo yathā, tathā tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ |
yāni ca tāni avāntarapūrvāṇi śabde- nā'bhūtāni, (tāni) adhikārarūpaiḥ prati upanīyante |

na ca teṣāṃ svarūpaparityāgena ajñā''vibhāvalakṣaṇa yuktā |
na ca svarūpārthatvenānumānaṃ, svarūpasyaiva ananyagamyasiddhitvāt |
śabdakathagamyasiddhikaṃ sarvamapyetat |
avaghātādīnāṃ tu pramāṇā- ntarātsevasiddhināṃ vinā'pi prokṣaṇaṃ kharūpasiddheḥ; svarūpa- pārthatve ayuktaṃ niyamaniyogasyānuṣṭhānam |
tadevaṃ svaya- mallatvāt laghvanuṣṭhāneṣu prayājādiṣu nādhikārakalpanā'- vakāśaḥ |
tenaiva prakāreṇa pradhānaviṣayeṣu utpattiniyogeṣu karaṇavāntarābhāvo veditavyaḥ |
yo hi tamavāntaravyāpāraṃ nābhyupagacchati, tasya kāraṇabhedo na syāt darśapūrṇamāsā- diṣu |
tathā āmeyādidharmā upaśupājādiṣu bhaveyuḥ, paramāpūrvaprayuktatvāt tatpratiṣṭhānabhāvāviśeṣāt |
avā- ntaravyāpāramede tu yuktā vyavasthā, anyathā āmeyasya karaṇatā, anyathā upaśupājādīnāmapi |

tathā pārṣaṇahomayorepi |
ata eva vikṛtiṣu vādhaḥ |

niradhikārāṇāmapi kāryatvā- viśeṣopādiniṣṭhātopāyatvācca yuktaiva kathamityākāṅkṣā |
nanvevaṃ aṅgīkṛtamavāntaraprakaraṇam |
kartavyasya kathamidhyā- kāṅkṣā prakaraṇamiti mīmāṃsakaprasiddhiḥ |
nāvāntarapraka- raṇaṃ nāma pramāṇamasti, prameyabhāve pramāṇa- tvānupapatteḥ |
yāvadeva tānyavāntarapūrvāṇi nāva- gamyante, tāvadeva sarvasya ārādupakārakaṃ padārthe- jātasyāviśeṣeṇa pradhānavidhiragṛhītatvāt |
paścāt sarveṣāmadhikārānupraveśāviśeṣānnā'nyonyaṃ tādarthyamiti iti nāvāntaraprakaraṇaviniyojasaṃbhavaḥ |
yāni tu vākyā- dimisteṣu avāntarapūrvāṇi niveśitāni, tatra prati- ṣṭhitāni na paramāpūrve saṃkramaṇamanti |
nanvevaṃ prayājādiṣu saumikavidhivantaprasaṅgaḥ |
nāyaṃ doṣaḥ |
yadi niradhi- kārāṇāmapi sādhikārāṇāmiva svārasikā''kāṅkṣā bhavet, bhavedevam |
anuṣṭheyatvācca svābhāvikī ititarkyatathā''- kāṅkṣā |
kathaṃ punarakāryatā anuṣṭheyatā ca ? nūnaṃ bhavān aśrutapūrvaḥ |
sapramādaḥ |
vivikaṃ hi tatraiva guruṇā |
yadeva hi puruṣeṇa mamedaṃ kāryamiti nirapekṣamevāvagamyate, tadanuṣṭheyam |
yattu tasiddhayarthe prāgasiddhaṃ sat vini- yujyate, tat kāryam |
paramāpūrve ca nirapekṣaṃ kāryamava- gamyate |
kāryatvamādi phalavati |
na phalāvamateḥ |
kāryateti yathā kṣuṇṇam |
ataḥ siddhaḥ anuṣṭheyakārya- vivekaḥ |
yadeva cānuṣṭheyaṃ tatraiva kathamidhyākāṅkṣā, na kāryamātre |
avahīnastarhi prayājādīnāmeva dīkṣaṇīyā''- diṣu ākāṅkṣā''patvena atideśaḥ |
na samyagavagataṃ matamasmākaṃ bhavatā |
arthaṃ hi no rāddhāntaḥ |
svāra- sikī ititarkyatathā''kāṅkṣā niradhikārāṇāṃ nāsti |
kāraṇāntarasambhavā tu nāpahanūyate |
tatra dīkṣaṇīyā''diṣu prayājādirdinana ititarkyatathā''kāṅkṣā kalpyate |
kharasato'pi ākāṅkṣāśūnyasya kāraṇāntararopanipāta- nivandhanā ākāṅkṣā |
yathā paṭo bhavatīti nirā- kāṅkṣāpi padadvayasya rakapaṭeccāraṇāt rakaṃ prati ākāṅkṣā, anyathā rakaṃḥ paṭo bhavatītyanyaprasaṅgaḥ |
evaṃ prayājādiṣu na kiṃcidākāṅkṣāsthāpane kāraṇāntara- mastīti na saumikadharmātideśaḥ |
siddha dīkṣaṇīyā''- diṣu aicchikavidhivantalābhaḥ |
ye tu adhikṛtādhikārāsyupa- gamena sādhikārātāṃ aṅganiyogānāmāhuḥ; teṣāṃ prayājādiṣu rātrisatranyāyenārthavādikaphalakāmaḥ evādhikārī prāpnoti iti nādhikṛtādhikārasaṃbhavaḥ |
syānamataṃ, ititarkyatathā''- kāṅkṣā pradhānavidhenaṃ paripūryate iti |
mā paripūri, prayojanaṃ tu paripūrṇaṃ, na pramāṇam |
arthavādapadāni pramāṇāṃśopanipātīni, teṣāṃ parokṣā vṛtirmā bhūditi tanpratipādakaphalakāmaḥ evādhikārī yuktaḥ |
sādhikāra- vidhisaṃnidhimātreṇa tu niradhikārāṇāṃ pratīyateḥ tādarthya adhikārākāṅkṣā nāstītyarthavādapadāni arthavādamātraparva- sāyīnyeva |
tathā payovrataṃ brāhmaṇasyetyādiṣu bhojanāya pravṛttasya dravyārjananiyamāvat svavākye evādhikāriṇo labdhatvācca pradhānapravṛttasya adhikārakalpanā śakyate kalpayituṃ, atha svātantryaṃ payovratādīnāmāpadyate |
tathā nā'nyataṃ vadediti prakaraṇadhīte'pi niṣidhyamānakriyākartṛ- radhikārāvagamānna prakaraṇāṇupraveśasaṃbhavaḥ |
tathā bhinnaṃ juhotīti nimittasyādhikāraviśeṣatvāt vinā nimitta- kalpanāt adhikāraviśeṣaṇatvāt na homasya darśapūrṇa- māsāṅgatvalāmaḥ |
na vā idamapi sādhanaṃ bhinnaśabdasya yaugi- katvāt prakṛtigāmitve sati nimittato'pyadhikāre''dhi- kṛtasyādhikāraḥ |
iti, prakaraṇe bhinnasya (syā) vini- yogāt |
taddhi prakaraṇasaṃnihitaṃ, yattatra viniyuktam |
na ca bhinnasya viniyogo'sti |
api vā adhikārākā- ṅkṣāyāṃ adhikāre kalpayitumupakānte kimiti arthena saṃnidhānena adhikāraḥ kalpyate, varaṃ bhavatvanuṣaṅgaḥ sākṣā- cchrutasya adhikārapadasya, pradhānavākye tu śrute adhikārapade pradhānane saha saṃnve sati saṃnihitānāṃ aśutādhikārāṇāṃ sādhikārapadamadhyena anvitānāṃ adhikārākāṅkṣaiva nāstīti anuṣaṅganirākaraṇe mulyuktiḥ |

avāntara- vidyo hi tadā savidhayaṇāṃ upāyabhūtaṃ prakalpayanti |

adhikāravidhinā tu tāvat tādarthyamātragrahaṇe tasya tadanvitasya anyathā'
dhikārasaṃbandha iti tadanupraveśaḥ |
paścāttu tasya vākyena punardvirātasaṃbandhaḥ iti nānupraveśaṃ kiṃ cin |
tadevaṃ ārā- dupakārakeṣu prathamaṃ tādarthyena adhikāraniyogaṃ prati anvi- teṣu nādhikāraniyoga vidhinā anuṣṭheyabhūtena karaṇopakāre klṛpte, taṃ prāṃta nādhikāraniyogena janakatvakalpanām |
na ca kṣaṇikabhāve teṣāṃ parasparaṃ svarūpeṇa asaṃbhavatāṃ saṃbhūyopakārajanakatāmāpadyate iti aśāntarapūrvāṇi svīkriyante |
evamāśrayiṣu vinā'pi apūrveṇa dravyadevatā- saṃskāramukhena karaṇopakārajanakasiddhiriti nāpūrvasyāśravaṇe kiṃ cana pramāṇam |
kiṃca dṛṣṭamālāyāṃ na tava dṛṣṭam |
darśitaṃ hi tameva tadartham |
tatryai na sākṣāt dravyadevatopakāro yāgaḥ, kiṃtu svāṅgabhūta mantratantrāṃśamukhena |
na ca yāge'dhikārā- nanupraviṣṭe tayostatra viniyogopapattiḥ |
na cāpūrvamanta- reṇa yāgasya adhikārānupraveśaḥ, iti avadyaśrāvaṇīyama- vāntāpūrvādyam |
teṣāṃ ca adṛṣṭatā na prayojanam |
'saurye hyanayā na dravyadevatāsaṃskāra eva prayojakaḥ |
tatrāpi dravya- devanāsaṃskārādaurevamapattireva prayojikā, yāge dravyasya sākṣādvāgārāditi mantavyam |
dravyasya tu śrutivini- yogaḥ |
na ka cit dravyasya dvāraṃ śrutiḥ samarthayati |
na tu aprākaraṇiko'pi dravyasya viniyogaḥ, sākṣāt karaṇopakārajanakatvābhāvāt |
tasya liṅgena samā- khyayā sthānena bhāvārtha eva janakatayā saṃbandhaḥ |
guṇa- devatayośca vākyena viniyogaḥ, nānābhyāpatvāt kāraṇānām |
aṅgasādhanatadupapādane tadavacchedakatayā astyeva tayorupayoga iti na kārakatvā viniyogo virū- dhyate |
yā tu saṃkhyā uttamakramasamavāyāthā ekādaśa prayājān yajatīti (sā) utsannānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vidhānā- saṃbhavāt kāmāśritā vidhīyate |
yadyapi ca uddeśyagataṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vākyabhedabhayena vivakṣāṃ nārhatīti prayājādīnāṃ sāhityaṃ na vivakṣitaṃ, tathāpi tasya pṛthaktvaniveśitvāt na pratyekaṃmisaṃcaḥ, kiṃtu samudāyasyaiva |
na cābhyāsaṃ vinā tasya pratipattiḥ ityarthāt abhyāsādhyayaṇam |
prākṛtakramānugrahāt labdhādhikāravidhau ca paripūraṇam |
yaḥ punarutpadyamānakarmasamavetaḥ, nāsau vidheyaḥ |
sa hi vidhīyamānāni karmāṇi avacchinatti, na ca tathā vidhe- yatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
bahuṣu vihiteṣu sa prayogeṇa parilabhyate eveti na pṛthaggriheyatvamavalambate |
avidheyabhūtāpi tau bhāvāvarthā abhinadan na viśro upakarotīti sa nāmnyau |
yastu bhinnaprātipadikāmidheyaḥ, so'ruṇimādivanna na karmaṇi kāraṇatayā vidhīyate |

viniyuktasya paścādekapradānaṃ anavacchinnasya na saṃbhavatītyasti tadavacchedakabhūtasaṃkhyā- 'pekṣā, saṃkhyāyāśca pratītagrāhakānvayanirāhāya āśrayā- pekṣeta tadavasthāsaṃnidhinā vidhiḥ; kalpayati |

upatyadhikāraviniyogaprayogavidhayaḥ pratijñāpyate |

utpattimākṣipati |

karoti- sāmānyādhikaraṇyaṃ ca ākhyāte dṛśyate 'yajeta- yāgena kuryāt' 'pacati- pākaṃ karoti' 'gacchati- gamanaṃ karoti' iti |
ataśca karotisāmānyādhikaraṇyāt prayatnasya ākhyātavācyatvam |
na ca 'ratho gacchati' iti prayogānupapattiḥ, rathe yatnābhāvāditi vācyam |

yanmate- 'pi anyopādānānukūlaṃ vyāpārasāmānyaṃ bhāvanā, tanmate- 'pi gamanātiriktavyāpārānāpatteḥ 'ratho gacchati' iti prayogasya aupacārikatvameveti |

sa eva khyātāyārthaḥ |
'kuṭhāreṇa chinatti' ityākhyātāśravaṇe hi bhavatyetādṛśī matiḥ : 'kuṭhāreṇa tathā vyāpyate, yasmin vyāpāre kṛte kuṭhārāt chedanaṃ bhavati' iti |
evaṃ 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityasyāyamarthaḥ : 'yāgena tathā vyāpyeta, yasmin vyāpāre kṛte yāgāt svargo bhavati' iti |
sa ca vyāpāraḥ kaḥ kuta udyamana- nipātanādiḥ, ka vicca agnyanvādhānādiḥ |
brāhmaṇatarpa- ṇāntaḥ kāryabhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa paścādavagamyate, anyopādānānukūlatvena sāmānyatastvākhyātadeva |
'ratho grāmaṃ gacchati' ityatrākhyātena grāmaprāptyanukūle vyāpāra eva pratīyate, 'rathasthā gamanena vyāpyate, yasmin vyāpāre kṛte gamanāt grāmaprāptirbhavati' iti pratīteḥ |
na tvatra gamanamātramākhyātārthaḥ, tasya dhātunā uktatvāt |
tatra 'ko'sau vyāpāraḥ ?' ityapekṣāyāṃ pūrvo- sarāvāntaradeśavibhajanasaṃyojanarūpaḥ iti paścādavagamyate, 'pūrveṇa pradeśena vibhajya, uttareṇa saṃyujya ratho grāmaṃ gacchati' iti prayogāt, 'ubhayatha nipāta kuṭhāreṇa chinatti' iti |
( cetanakartṛkakriyāvāciṣapi yatte ityādiṣu paramatye eva lakṣaṇaprasaktiḥ, nāsannamate ityāha-) evaṃ 'devadattaḥ prayatnate' ityatrāpi 'devadattastathā vyāpriyate, yathā prayatnau bhavati' iti prayatnānukūle vyāpāra evākhyātāyārthaḥ, na tu prayatnaḥ, tasya dhātunā uktatvāt |
vyāpāraviśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ ca icchā''diḥ paścāda- vagamyate ubhayamananipātanatvāt |
tathā ca sarvatra anugata- tvāt anyopādānānukūlavyāpārasāmānyameva ākhyātārthaḥ, na tu prayatnamātraṃ, 'ratho gacchati' 'devadattaḥ prayatnate' ityādiṣu tadabhāvāt |
( upāditā hi avayavabhedena prayojyaprayojaka- bheda maṅgīkṛtya bhāvanāpratītiḥ : vārtikakṛdbhiḥ bhāvārthā- dhikaraṇe |
vastutastu yathaiva 'bhavati' ityatra bhāvanāpratītyupapādanaṃ vārtikakāraiḥ atiśayārthaṃ, tathaiva ihāpi 'ratho gacchati' ityādiṣu tadupapādanamatiśayārtha- meva |
nahi 'ratho gamanaṃ karoti' 'puruṣo yatnaṃ karoti' 'ghaṭo bhavanaṃ karoti' iti kasyāpi anu- bhavo'sti |
ataḥ : anyopādānānukūlajñānādareṇa vyāpārasāmānyameva sarvatra ākhyātārthaḥ ityetha granthatātparyam |
indodāharaṇeṣu yathāsthito gamanavyāpāraḥ, puruṣāśrito yatnavyāpāraḥ, ghaṭāśrito bhavanavyāpāraḥ, iti vinaiva lakṣaṇaṃ bodhopapattiḥ |
) na cātra aupacārikatvaṃ vaktuṃ yuktaṃ, mukhye saṃbhavati tasyānyāyatatvāt |
karotyartho'pi anyopādānānukūle vyāpāra eva, na prayatnamātram |

darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ havi- ṣpūmantrasya mukhye'rthe āhnāne viniyogaḥ, na tu avaghāte |
tathā''hnānamapīti cet |
bhāṣyaṃ- sto darśapūrṇamāsau |
tatredaṃ samāmnāyate ‘haviṣkṛdehīti triravaghnātyāhayati’ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ eṣa mantraḥ hanti prati upadiśyate, uta hantiḥ asya kālaṃ lakṣayati iti |
kathaṃ hanti prati upadiśyate, kathaṃ vā kālaṃ lakṣayet ? yadi evaṃ saṃbandhaḥ kriyeta ‘haviṣkṛdehi ityavaghnan’ iti, tato hanti prati upa- diśyate |
atha ‘avaghnan āhayati’ iti, tataḥ asya kālaṃ lakṣayati |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? ‘tathā āhnāna- mapi’ |
yathā aindrī gāyatryādi prati upadiśyate, evameva mantro hanti prati upadiśyate |
evaṃ śrutiḥ anugṛhītā bhavati, itarathā lakṣaṇā syāt |
hantikālasya mantrasya ca saṃbandho bhavet, na hanteḥ mantrasya |
evaṃ ca sati āhayati ityayaṃ anuvādaḥ |
āhnānaṃ karoti |
yo hi ‘ehi’ iti brūte, sa āhayati |
tatra kena cit guṇena mantro hanti pratyāyayiṣyati |
tasmāt nāhāne viniyojyaḥ |
vā-- evaṃ tavāt mukhyaṃ kāryaṃ mantrāṇāṃ iti sāpavādamavasthitam |
ataḥ paraṃ etat vicāryate ka utsargasya viṣayaḥ, kaḥ apavādasyeti |
tatra ‘haviṣkṛdehi’ iti vā haviḥ karoti yajamānasya patnī, tadāhnānaprakāśanāsamartho mantraḥ |
sa kiṃ tatraiva viniyujyeta avaghnansaṃyogasya kālatvena avirodhāt, athavā vacanāt anyathā'thai pūrvatarapratītāvāhnānameveti |
yadi ‘haviṣkṛdehi’ ityanena ‘avaghnan āhayati’ iti vidhīyate, tataḥ avaghātājñjayam |
atha ‘avaghnan’ ityetana ‘āhayati’ ityevaṃ saṃbadhya rūpadeva prāptaṃ āhnānakāle mantraṃ anūdya ‘triḥ’ iti vidhīyate, tataḥ ‘avaghnan’ ityasya svakālalakṣaṇā'rthatvāt na ayathā- 'rthe vacanaṃ iti yathā'thaiḥ eva mantraḥ |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? avaghnanśrutyanugrahāt āhayatetha mantrarūpādeva prāpta- tvāt avaghnanteva haviṣkaraṇe kartṛtvaṃ kathaṃcit asti. ityayathā'rthatvam |
guṇayogāt pratyāyanaṃ ca |
na, kālavidhiśroditatvāt |
bhāṣyaṃ- naitadasti hanti prati upadiśyate iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? kālalakṣaṇā syāt |
kutaḥ ? ‘trirāhayati’ iti trimantra vidhīyate |
yadi asminneva vākye mantro vidhīyeta, anekaguṇavidhānāt vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
tasmāt naivaṃ abhisaṃbandhaḥ ‘evaṃ avaghnan’ iti |
kathaṃ tarhi ? ‘avaghnan āhayati’ iti |
nanu asmin pakṣe mantro vidhīyate kālaḥ, tatra sa eva doṣo bhavet |
neti brūmaḥ |
avaghnankāle eva arthena haviṣkṛt āhnāyatyā, tatra ayameva saṃbandhaḥ anūyate |
kevalā tu trirāvṛttiḥ vidhīyate |
yattu kālalakṣaṇā'rthaḥ śabdaḥ iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ |
laukikī hi lakṣaṇā |
mantro'pi ca rūpādeva āhnāne prāptaḥ, so'pi anūyate eva |
coditaśca vākyāntareṇa avaghātaḥ śakoti kālaṃ lakṣayitum |
tasmāt āhnāne viniyojyaḥ iti |

na ca 'patyehavi- ṣkṛt upatiṣṭhati, sā abhidadhyāvahanti ' iti ava- ghātasya patnīkartṛkatvāvagatyā avaghātāthai tadāhnānasya arthaprāptatvāt na vidheyatvamiti vācyam |
anāhatāyāḥ svayamāgatāyā api avahantṛtvasaṃbhavena āhnānasya nityaprāptyabhāvena vidhisaṃbhavāt |
iti cet maivam |
'ehi' iti mantravarṇadeva āhnānasya nityāptisaṃbhavāt |
yattuktaṃ nyāyasudhāyāṃ mantravarṇataḥ prāptyabhyupagame āhnānaprāptau tatra mantraviniyogaḥ, mantravarṇācca āhnāna- prāptiḥ ityanyonyāśrayaḥ syāt |
kiṃca nityaprāptasyāpi āhnānasya 'uru prathasveti puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti puroḍāśāntyānyā'nupapattyā prāptasyāpi prathanasa ādhva- ryavasamākhyābalena adhvaryukartṛkatvasiddhaye 'yajamānameva tat prathayati' ityarthavādopapattaye ca vidheyatvam ihāpi adhvaryukartṛkatvāprāptyai 'vācameva tadāhayati ' ityarthavādopapattaye ca vidheyatvamāvaśyakam |
tasmāt trirābhyāsaviśiṣṭāhnānavidhiravadhārya iti |
( na kāla- vidhiḥ 0 6 iti sūtranayasudhāyāḥ arthato'nuvādādyam ) tatra |
'ehi' itipadayuktasya mantrasya nityadā- mnātasya nityaṃ ṛtūpakārakatvasya vaktavyatayā tasya ca mantrasya dṛṣṭārthatvābhāya mantrasāmarthyaparyālocanalabhyā- hānatvaiva dvāratvaucityena ca dṛṣṭadvārā kṛtau mantravini- yogabaladeva dvārabhūtasyāhnānasya tatra mantrānvayasya ca siddhayā anyonyāśrayānavakāśaḥ, mantrasya adhvaryakāṇḍe samāmnānabalādeva āhnānasya adhvaryukartṛkatvasiddhau tadarthe āhnānavidhivaiyarthyācca |
'uru prathasva ' iti mantrasya tu ādhvaryakāṇḍe samāmnānamānāt prathanasya nādhvaryukartṛka- tvasiddhiḥ |
adhvaryvacāritamantreṇa anyasyāpi tadarthasmṛtau satyāṃ anyenāpi prathanānuṣṭhānasaṃbhavāt |
prakṛte ca 'ehi' iti śabdaprayogatveva āhnātṛtayā ehītipadayuktamantrasya ādhvaryabale āhnānasyāpi ādhvaryatvamavarjanīyaṃ iti vaiṣamyam |
arthavādaśca tribhyāsamātrāvidhāvapi kathaṃcidu- papādayituṃ śakyate iti tadarthamapi viśiṣṭavidhirauva- dṛṣṭasya āhnānavidhānasya anaṅgīkāryatvāt iti (pṛ. 213) |
na ca mukhye avaghnan iti pade siddhāntino lakṣaṇā, pūrvapakṣiśastvantya jaghanye āhyatipade iti vaiṣamyaṃ śakyam |
avaghātasya 'lakṣaṇaheloḥ kriyāyāḥ' iti kriyāntaralakṣakakriyākartṛvihitaśatrupratyayena kriyā'ntara- lakṣaṇā'rthatvāvagamena anyopasarjanatayā svārthasamarpake avaghnan iti pade eva prathamaśrute'pi lakṣaṇāyā nyāyya- tvāt |
sūtrārthastu- āhnānaṃ āhnānamantro'pi, tathā aindrīvat ayathārthaḥ syāt iti |

dadhyādīnāṃ tu vaikalpikatvāt ekaikasyaiva daśame pakṣe homājñatvam|

kutaḥ ? 'prāpte karmaṇyekāthaṃ- vidhiḥ pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ |
tvatpakṣe'nekasaṃbhavavidhi- ścātra prasajyate ||
' 'dadhihomasaṃbaṃdhaṃ homaphalasaṃbaṃdhaṃ ca vidadhat vākyaṃ bhidyate |
tena avaśyaṃ viśiṣṭavidhirabhyu- pagantavyaḥ |
tataśca siddhaṃ karmāntaram |
yathaiva cārthāt aniyatānekadravyakatve prāpte kevaladadhiniyamāt vaika- lpikadravyakatve kalpite, taṇḍulādividhivyāpteḥ vaika- lpikadravyakatve kalpite, taṇḍulādividhivyāpteḥ kevala- dadhiniyamakaraṇāt |
nahi asau etasmāt vākyātte kathaṃ cidapi prāptaḥ |
tena homāt phale bhavati karmāntara- tvam |
ataḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ parigṛhyate |
'karmaśabdaguṇe'pyatra karma bhūyo vidhīyate |
phalaṃ hi śrutametasmin karmatvasya yujyate ||
' samasta- meva bhāvāthīdhikaraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
tatra hi etadavasthita, ākhyātācchabdāḥ phalapadena saṃbadhyante, na dravyaguṇaśabdāḥ iti |
tasmāt phalasya karmayogitvāt phalaśrutau
satyāṃ karma vidhīyate, na karmaṇi guṇaḥ |
kathaṃ ? 'prāptatvād guṇo naiva vidhānaṃ punararhati |
aprāpta- vidhipakṣe'pi bhaved vyartho phalaśrutiḥ ||
' tatra nāma aguṇe karmaśabde sati guṇe vidhīyate, yatra sa guṇe na bhavati, tacca arthāntaraṃ na śrūyate |
na ceha dravyamapi tadasti, dadhno vākyāntareṇaiva prāptatvāt, phalasya ca abhyadhikasya upādānāt |
ata āha phalamiha śrūyate, tacca karmaṇe nyāyyaṃ iti |
tatra kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hi karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ iti - praśnasya dvidhā pratibhāsaḥ ( vākyabhedena, ekavākyatayā ceti |
tatra vākyabheda- pakṣamanupaśyati -) ekastāvat neti brūmaḥ, nahi etat dṛṣṭenānena sidhyati ityādiḥ, nirākaraṇaparatvena siddhāntacchāyā'nusārāt 'kiṃ' ityetāvāneva praśnaḥ, 'kiṃ' iti etat nyāyyaṃ ? ityarthaḥ |
itara āha dṛṣṭaṃ hi karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ ( kṛṣvāditeo brīhyādi ) iti |
tasyottaraṃ neti brūmaḥ iti |
'yadi' ityādi tāvat svayameva āśaṅkaya nirākaroti yāvat tasmāt naivaṃ- jātīyakeṣu etat bhavati iti ( ityantaṃ bhāṣyam |
imaṃ vākyabhedapakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā ekavākyatāpakṣaṃ upanya- syati -) tatra tu ( uttaratra ) kathaṃ tarhi homāt nyāyyaṃ phalaṃ ityevaṃ ekāntikaḥ siddhāntavādinaḥ praśnaḥ |
sa ca ātmīyavacanopasaṃhārādanantaraṃ duḥśliṣṭaḥ pratibhāti ityevaṃ anyayojanā yuktā |
( atra pakṣe bhāṣyaṃ yojayati - ) tacca karmaṇo nyāyyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣavādinā abhihite siddhāntavādī dadhipadānarthakyabhayena bhāvāthī- dhikaraṇanyāyāsaṃbhavāt śabdasya asāmarthyaṃ manyamānaḥ pṛcchati kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hi karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ kṛṣvāditeḥ iti, anena nyāyena sāmānyatodṛṣṭena homāt phalaṃ manyase iti |
yadyapi ca codanālakṣaṇadharmābhyupagamāt anumānādīnāṃ īdṛśebhyaśca asāmarthyaṃ sthāpitaṃ, tathāpi vedārthanirṇaye teṣāṃ kāraṇatvāniṣedhāt tadarthanirṇayārthaṃ anumānopanyāsaḥ |
paraḥ punaḥ bhāvāthīdhikaraṇavāsitāntaḥ- karaṇaḥ ākṣipannāha, mā me adhyāropamevaṃ dāḥ, śabde sati na hi anumānaṃ bravīmi |
na ca etena sāmānyato- dṛṣṭena asadamimataṃ sidhyati, asiddha-anaikāntika-
-viruddhadidoṣaduṣṭatvādanumānasya |
kathaṃ ? yadi tāvat 'homaḥ phalavān phalavattvā dṛśyamānatvāt' ityucyate tataḥ pratijñātāyarthadeśatvāt asiddhatvam |
atha 'kṛṣvā- dīnāṃ phalavattvā dṛśyamānatvāt' iti, tato'pi apakṣadharma- tvam |
atha vinaiva pakṣadharmatvāt yatcchāyāmātreṇa kalpyeta, tacca dravyeṣu aviśiṣṭam |
atha sādṛśyadvāreṇa upamayā kalpyeta tacca sādṛśyaṃ phalavṛddhiḥ kṛṣvādibhiḥ saha homasya kriyātmanā vidyate, na dravyasya akriyātmakatvāt |
iti tatra dravyasyāpi asyeva kiṃcit sādṛśyaṃ iti manasi kṛtvā yadi pratyāsannāvāntara- sādṛśyapekṣayā tannirākriyate, tataḥ śakyaṃ pratyāsannatarā- pekṣayā homasyāpi nirākartuṃ iti manyamāna āha homo'pi asadṛśaḥ, sādhanasvarūpaphalabhedāt kṛpe |
atha kiṃcit sādṛśyaṃ gṛhyate, tat dravyasyāpi sat anityaṃ dravyatvat kārye ityādidharmabhedāt asi iti pūrvapribhāyavivaraṇam |
atha dravyādanyat sadṛśataramasti iti āpekṣikatvāt sādṛśyasya susaharo apekṣite viprakṛṣṭaṃ viśadameva bhavati |
tena kriyātve kṛṣihomavartini apekṣite viprakṛṣṭatvāt sadanityādiyuktaṃ dravyaṃ asadṛśameva ityucyate |
tathā sati kriyātve'pi dadhyārthabhojanagamanayāvāntara- sādṛśyapekṣā kṛṣohomayoḥ |
viprakṛṣṭatvāt asādṛśyameva iti akāraṇaṃ syāt |
āha ca 'nāsmin paramasādṛśyaṃ dṛśyate kṛṣihomayoḥ |
kiṃcitsādṛśyadṛṣṭyu dravye'- pyastītyaniścayaḥ ||
' na caitat siddhaṃ iti upamānena sādharmyamātramānena vā sarvadharmaprāptiḥ anumānoktanyāyya- vyāpakanirapekṣā apyuktā, sarvapadārthanāmatvaprasaṅgāt |

sa ca prayatnabhede iti prayatnahetubheda eva sākṣātkārodaye heturiti kathaṃ tama- ntareṇa tatsaṃbhavaḥ ? nahi vahnimantareṇa tṛṣakṣepaṇaphūtkāra- mātrādeva odanaṃ sidhyati |
yadi manyate svataḥ eva cikīrṣāprayatnau api bhagavatīśvare iti ? atha kimetau nityau anityau vā ? nityau cet kṛtamīśvarasya jñānena cikīrṣāprayatnotpādā'nupayogā, tayornityatayā svopādo- payogānapekṣatvāt |
na ca prayatnavat jñānamapi sākṣāt kāryopādānāṅgam |
prayatnabhedena khalu ayamadhiṣṭhityu- pādānādi, na tu samaye jñānasya kaścidupayogaścikīrṣāyā vā, niṣpāditakriye karmaṇi aviśeṣādhādyinaḥ sādhanasya sādhanavyātipātāt iti dattajalāñjalīśvarasya sarva- jñatā |
athānityo, tatastayorutpattikā raṇaṃ vaktavyam |
nanu nityajñānamevotpattimupakāraṇamasti |
tataḥ kimapareṇa kāraṇena ? aho bata pramādo yadayaṃ ' ātmanaḥ saṃyoga- viśeṣapasamavāyikāraṇau icchāprayatnī tamanatareṇa jñāna- mātrādeva bhavataḥ ' ityapi vaktumavasitaḥ |
tathā sati ayamataṇḍalamapi maṇḍaṃ sādhayedeva |
' sanyevā'sya muktātmanobhiḥ saṃyogāḥ |
tena tashāyaḥ tatra cikīrṣā- prayatnadvayaṃ yugapat prasṛte tathākāryojananāya ' iti cet ? nanu manāṃsi tasaṃyogāśca kimanviṣṭhitāni cikīrṣāprayatnau pradhuvate adhiṣṭhitāni vā ? yadyanadhiṣṭhitāni, tatastatraiva vyabhicāraḥ |
adhiṣṭhānaṃ tu prayatnamantareṇāyuktameva |
'prayatnāntareṇa cikīrṣā'ntarajanmā tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ, na cānava- sthānaṃ, anāditvāt cikīrṣāprayatnapravāhasya ' iti cet ? yathā amyutannarsaṃjñīhepaḥ īśvaraḥ kṣetrajñeṣu pratibandhacchate dharmādharmanicayeṣu jagati ca paramāṇavvyāmāpāce nirdhyāpāraḥ |
kiyantamapi kālaṃ sthitvā cikīrṣati prayatate vā, tadā tasya cikīrṣāprayatnaurjanitayonai sthitaṃ cikīrṣā'ntaraṃ vā prayatna'ntaraṃ vā samasthitau kuto manasāṃ tasaṃyogānāṃ vā adhiṣṭhānaṃ ? ityanadhiṣṭhityo manasta- saṃyogebhyo na prayatnacikīrṣe upadheyatām |
upadyamāne vā kathaṃ kāryatvaṃ acetanopādānatvaṃ vā na hetuṃ vyabhicārataḥ |
na ca savitṛprakāśavadīśvarasya jñāna- mātreṇānnātra prayatnamātraṃ tattaccāvamedopadhānāt tadiyaṃ bhavatīti sāṃpratam |
parasparāśrayadoṣaprasaṅgāt |
tattaccā- vopadhāne tattadviṣayatve ca tattadupadhānam |
upadyīmānā- dhiṣṭhāne tadupadhānasya kāryasya anupādāt, tasya ca adhi- ṣṭhānādupayeteriti |
jñānānityatvapakṣe ca dūṣaṇamupaparihāt pravedayiṣyate |
so'yamīdṛśo viśeṣo vicārasahaḥ kathaṃ pakṣadharmatāvalapi sādhyadharmiṇi upasaṃhiyate ? nahi svayamapyupadyamānaṃ anyasyopapādanāyālama |
kā tarhi sāmānyasya ānumānikasya asati viśeṣe gatiḥ ? kimavaśyamavitavyamasya gatyā ? nanu pramāṇasiddhamupāda- nīyaṃ, yasya anumā upapadyate |
yannāma anupadyamānaṃ, astu

tasya paramaṇuppattireva |
nanu pramāṇasiddhamanupapannamiti vipratiṣiddham |
evaṃ tarhi pramāṇasiddhapratighātaḥ |
evāstu avipratiṣedhāya, na punaranupapannopapattiḥ |
katamat tarhi sādhanasyedaṃ dūṣaṇam |
na dūṣaṇaṃ sādhanasya |
tasya nāma vādinaḥ yaḥ sahasahāyaniḥsahāyanimittatvādi viśeṣaparihārāya gaganakusumāyamāne kṣityādivartini buddhimatpūrvakatvasāmānya- sāmānyaṃ sādhanārhaṃ sādhanaṃ prayojayati |
na ca saṃbhavati tādṛśo viśeṣo, yamādhāya kṣityādau buddhimatpūrvakatvasāmānyaṃ vyatiṣṭheta |
na caitraṃ sarvānumānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ |
saṃbhavadviśeṣa- viṣayatvāt iteṣāmanumānānām |
nahi na saṃbhavati parvatatanmavatrtiviśiṣṭaviśeṣaḥ : anubhūtasvarūpasya vā taijasaścaruravayavo rūpopalambhasādhanam |
kāraṇānāṃ ca citrarūpasaṃsthānasāmarthyānāṃ tatratatropalambhe |
tasmāt yathā kaściccitrāstacchi acchedyamākāśaṃ prati vyāpārayan puruṣo nigṛhyate, na punarasirākācaṃ vā, tadvat kāryatvama- cetanopādānatvaṃ vā tarkasahāyaṃ labdhaparipākādṛṣṭavat- kṣetrajñaparamāṇvādi saṃyogakāraṇāmātravibhyamīśvare sarve iti |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 212-219.
īśvaravādaḥ : |
' sarvajñatāvādāryaḥ ' iti vindau vidhivivekagranthe 22 kārikāyāṃ draṣṭavyaḥ |
tatra naiyā- yikābhimateśvarasya nirāsaḥ sarvajñatānirāsadvārā sādhitaḥ |
ke.
īśvarasiddhau anumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ iti naiyāyikāḥ |
veda eveśvarasiddhau pramāṇaṃ nānyat iti maṇiḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 42-43.
īśvarānumānikatvanirāsaḥ |
idānīṃ īśvarasya ānumānikatvaṃ nirākriyate |
ke cidevamanumānaṃ vadanti, vivādādhyāsitaṃ sakartṛkaṃ kāryatvāt, yatkāryaṃ tat sakartṛkaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, tathedamaṃ tasmāt |
atra saṃdigdha- kartṛkaṃ bhūrāhākurādikaṃ pakṣaḥ, prasiddhakartṛko ghaṭādiḥ sapakṣaḥ, asiddhakartṛkamākāśādi vipakṣaḥ |
na ca kāryatva- masiddhamiti vācyaṃ, sāvayavatvena kāryatvasya siddhatvāt |
nanu viruddho hetuḥ, yatkāryaṃ taccharīrakartṛkaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, yathā ghaṭādikaṃ vigrahavatkulālādikartṛkaṃ, evaṃ ca kāryatvaṃ śarīri- kartṛkatvameva sādhayati, bhavatāṃ cāśarīrakartṛkaṃ sipā- dhayiṣitam |
aśarīrakartṛkatvaviparītaṃ śarīrikartṛkaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ vipakṣaḥ, tatra kāryatvasya pakṣavipakṣayoreva varta- mānatvāt viruddhatvam |
naivaṃ, yadi aśarīrakartṛkatvameva sādhyaṃ, tadā viruddhatvam |
asmākaṃ tu saśarīrakartṛkatvā- śarīrakartṛkatvaviśeṣaṃ parityajya sakartṛkatvamātrameva sādhyaṃ, itarathā agrimatve sādhye kiṃ pratyakṣamimattvaṃ, uta apratya- kṣāgrimatvamiti vikalpe, pratyakṣamimatve sādhyavikalpa- taiveti sakalamānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ |
ataḥ pratyakṣapratyakṣa- viśeṣaparihāreṇa amisattāmātrameva sādhyamiti vaktavyaṃ, tathā'pi |
athāsākamapi dharmādharmadvāreṇa kṣetrajña- syaiva kartṛtvāt sakartṛkatvamastyeveti siddhasādhanā |
naivaṃ, kṣetrajñasya dharmādharmādhiṣṭheyajñānasaṃbhavāt kartṛtvameva na saṃbhavatīti tallakṣaṇo dharmādisākṣātkaraṇanipuṇaḥ ( kartā adhikaraṇasiddhāntanyāyāparaparyāyatayā ) pakṣadharmatayā vicitrajagannirmāṇacaturaḥ kartā siddho bhavati |
nanu vilakṣaṇasyāpi kartṛtvaṃ nopapadyate, tasyāpi dharmādharma- sākṣātkāraśakteḥ |
tadadhiṣṭhitaśca cetanatvāt kṣetrajñavat |
na ca tasya pratyakṣasya dharmādharmaviṣayatvaṃ, pratyakṣatvāt saṃpratipannapratyakṣavat |
na ca tasya bāhyendriyāṇi dharmādharma- gocarāṇi indriyatvāt, asmadādīndriyavat |
āntaramapi manaḥ karaṇaṃ bahiraiva svatantraṃ na bhavati antaḥkaraṇatvāt, asmadādyantaḥkaraṇavat |
na ca tasyecchājñānayorapi nityatvaṃ icchājñānatvāt asmadādīcchājñānavat |
na ca tasya vigrahasyāpi nityatvaṃ bhautikatvāt, asmadādi- vigrahavat |
na tasya abhautiko divyo vigrahaḥ saṃbhavati vigrahatvāt, asmadādigrahavat |
prayojanarahitatvāt na ca tasya kartṛtvam |
jagatsyutpādakamimaṃ na tasya saṃbhavati cetanatvāt, kṣetrajñavat |
ityādibhirhetuśataiḥ jagannirmāṇasāmarthyaṃ iti |
nanu tadadathaśrutanyāyaśāstrāṇāṃ chāndasānāṃ vedāpauruṣeyatvaśraddhāvijṛmbhitam |
tathāhi, tadetat sarvaṃ anumānajātaṃ vilakṣaṇameva paramaṅgīkṛtya ucyate, anaṅgīkṛtya vā ? aṅgīkṛtya cet dharma- grāhakapramāṇavirodhaḥ sarveṣām |
anaṅgīkṛtya cet, āśrayā- siddhiḥ |
atha prasaṅgāpādanamukhenoktānāṃ hetūnāmavakāśaḥ,
īśvarānumānikatā |
naivaṃ, prasaṅgāpādanamapi anumānameva, kiṃtu anumānasyaiva uktiprakārabhedamātram |
atastadaṅgīkāre tadgrāhaka- pramāṇavirodhaḥ, anaṅgīkāre cāśrayāsiddhiriti tadavastha- meva pūrvoktaṃ dūṣaṇam |
kiṃca anvayādyaviprabhṛti ādyaguṇakaṃ acetanaṃ kāryaṃ cetanādhiṣṭhitamevetyucyate iti nirvi- vādam |
drāṇoktittu paramāṇukriyātaḥ |
sā ca adṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogāt bhavati, adṛṣṭaṃ ca cetanādhiṣṭhita- meva sat kāryakaram |
tathāhi, vimatipatitamevaṃ cetanādhi- ṣṭhitaṃ kāryakaraṃ acetanatvāt, yadyadacetanaṃ tattat cetanādhiṣṭhitaṃ kāryakaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā vāsyādi, tathā cedaṃ tasmāttathā |
adhiṣṭheyasvarūpaśaktikāryavān adhiṣṭhātā bhavatīti kṣetrajñadavyo nityecchājñānādimān adhiṣṭhātā pakṣadharmatāvalat siddho bhavati, parvatagatājñātāmiviśeṣa- vat |
ato na jñānopasthasya śarīrandriyāpekṣā |
na ca jñānasya kṣetrajñajñānavat anilatvaprasaṅgaḥ, pārthivāṇu- rūpādikamanityaṃ dyamititi ā paramāṇuṣu na rūpādyanityatva- prasaṅgaḥ |
na ca kṣetrajñagatatvena vilakṣaṇasya saṃncavābhāvaḥ, vilakṣaṇasaṃyuktaparamāṇusaṃyuktakṣetrajñasamavetatvāt |
adṛṣṭasya saṃyuktasaṃyogisamavāyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavatyeva |
ataḥ kṣetrajña- vilakṣaṇo'dhiṣṭhātā siddhaḥ |
evaṃ vā anumānaṃ, vivā- dādhyāsitaṃ upādānopakaraṇasaṃpadānaprayojanābhijñabuddhima- kartṛkaṃ, kāryatvāt ghaṭādivaditi |
ataḥ siddhaḥ anumāne- naiva kṣetrajñavilakṣaṇo bhagavānīśvaraḥ iti cet |
atrocyate |
nānumānikyamīśvarasya saṃbhavati, anumānasya kartṛmātra- gocaratvāt |
tena na vilakṣaṇasiddhiḥ |
yaduktaṃ kṣityā- dikaṃ sakartṛkaṃ, kāryatvāt ghaṭādivaditi, tat siddhasādhanaṃ kṣetrajñasyāpi dharmādharmādareṇa kartṛtvavyāpyadharmāt |
taduktaṃ ' karmabhiḥ sarvasiddhānāṃ tasiddheḥ siddhasādhanam ' iti |
atha buddhimatkartṛmātraṃ sādhyamiti cet, buddhimattva- mapi kṣetrajñasya vidyate iti punarpi siddhasādhanameva |
atha na buddhimatkartṛkatāmātraṃ sādhyaṃ, kiṃtu upādānopakaraṇādi- svarūpaśaktikāryabuddhimattṛ, tarhi sādhyavikalatvaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
sarvotpattimataḥ adṛṣṭāpi upakaraṇatvāt |
ghaṭasyāpi tat upakaraṇaṃ, paramāṇvādimupādānam |
na ca kulālasya tadviṣayaṃ jñānamastīti sādhyavikalatvameva |
kiṃca kimatra sādhyatvenaiveṣṭitaṃ kiṃ asadādikartṛkatvaṃ, uta vilakṣaṇa- kartṛkatvaṃ ? yadi asadādikartṛkatvaṃ, tarhi siddhasādhanamapa- siddhāntaśca |
atha vilakṣaṇakartṛkatvaṃ, tarhi sādhyavikala dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
athobhayānugatakartṛkatvamātraṃ sādhyamiti cet, ubhayābhāvāt |
atha kartṛtvasāmānye'pi pakṣadharmatayā vilakṣaṇasiddhiḥ; naivaṃ, itaretarāśrayaprasaṅgāt, ubhayānugata- sāmānyavat asiddhiriti |
nanu sarvatrādṛṣṭalakṣaṇānu- mānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ |
tathāhi kādācikaṃ kāryamiti karma- sādhane dravyaguṇādityatiriktameva karma siṣādhayiṣitam |
tatrāpi kiṃ dravyādi kāryaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ vā iti vikalpe, dravyādau siddhasādhanaṃ, vilakṣaṇe sādhyavikalatā, ubhayānu- gatakāraṇamātre sādhye anyonyāśrayatvamiti samānatvāt |
naivaṃ, tatra vilakṣaṇadharmākṣepaḥ pakṣadharmatayā yuktaḥ, kāraṇa- jātīyasvabhāvānatikrameṇa vilakṣaṇadharmābhāvāt |
atra tu kartṛjātīyasvabhāvātilaṅghanena viśeṣo'pi bhavatām |
tathāhi, saṃpratipannaḥ kartā kulāladiḥ saśarīraḥ : puṇya- pāpādhīnaḥ anityecchājñānādiḥ |
bhavadabhilaṣitastu aśarīraḥ : puṇyapāpādirahito nityecchājñānādiḥśceti |
na vilakṣaṇasya kriyāśaktyādisādhyaṃ pakṣadharmatayā sarva- jñatvasarvaśaktimattveśvaravādikartṛjātīyavilakṣaṇaguṇāmā- kṣepa iti ghaṭate |
kiṃca kāryatvāt ityamasiddho hetuḥ, kṣityādināmupatyasiddheḥ |
taduktaṃ ' idānīmiva sarvatra dṛṣṭāntābhikyamiṣyate ' |
iti |
atha sāvayavatvāt kāryatvaṃ sādhyate iti, tatra, nahi sāvayavatvaṃ prayojakaṃ kāryatvasya |
sāvayavatvābhāve'pi buddhayādau kāryadarśanāt |
ataḥ prāgabhāvavattvameva prayojakaṃ kāryatvasya |
atha tadeva heturbhavatu, tarhi asiddho hetuḥ, kṣityādīnāṃ prāgabhāva- vattvāsiddheḥ |
nanu sāvayavatvaṃ prāgabhāvavattvaṃ ca ubhayaṃ prayojakaṃ bhavatu, ataḥ sāvayavatvena kāryatvaṃ prasādhyate, sadhaikedeśadhṛtepi sādhakatvābhyupagamāt |
naivaṃ, śakya- kriye hi sāvayavatvena kāryatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ghaṭādau, aśakya- kriye hi sāvayavatvena viśeṣahetunā kāryatve pratipiṇḍe sāvayavatvasāmānyāddhetunā kāryatvaṃ na śakyate sādhayituṃ, bādhitaviṣayatvāt |
yathā mūrtatvaṃ anityatvena ghaṭādau vyāptamapi aśakyanāśeṣu paramāṇuṣvanityatvaṃ na sādhayituṃ
īśvarānumānikatā |
śaknoti |
kiṃca viruddhaścāyaṃ hetuḥ |
tathāhi, yatra kāryatvaṃ sakartṛkatvena viśeṣahetunā vyāptaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ghaṭādau, tatra sarvatra vigrahavatkartṛkatvena vyāptaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kulāladau, ataḥ sakartṛkatvaṃ sādhayat kāryatvaṃ, vigrahavattvaviśiṣṭameva sādhayati |
nanu aśarīriṇe'pi kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ svaśarīrapreraṇāyām |
naivaṃ, tathāpi śarīrasthasyaiva preraṇāyāṃ kartṛtvaṃ, prameyapi svaśarīrameva |
prayatnanimittaṃ hi preraṇaṃ, tacca aśarīriṇo na saṃbhavati, muktānyātmani asaṃbhavāt |
atha pūrva- śarīraparibhogenaiva śarīrāntaragrahāt aśarīrasya śarīra- parigrahe kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, nahi yugapaccharīradvayaparigrahaḥ saṃbhavati |
naivaṃ, tatrāpi sūkṣmaśarīrasya saṃbhavāt, pūrvaśarīraparityāge sarvatra śarīriṇaḥ eva kartṛtvam |
na ca etāvatā sakalānumānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ, sapakṣadṛṣṭasya avyabhicāritva eva dharmasya parigrahāt, yathā dhūmasyā- gni vyāptau |
uṣṇatvādyadakaprakāśāvavyāptivyabhicāram- viśiṣya agre'gmyatvaṃ aṅgīkriyate |
aparvatatvamapi vyāptamiti cenna parvate'pi ca cittu pratyakṣadarśanāt |
anumitisiddhadeśyatiriktedeśatvamapi avyabhicārāt upādhiriti cet, vyāptigrahaṇadaśāyāṃ akasmādeva ananumitisiddhadeśya saraṇābhāvāt |
ataḥ sakartṛkatvaṃ sādhyamānaṃ śarīrakartṛkatvameva, śarīrakartṛkatve sarve vipakṣaḥ, ataḥ pakṣavipakṣayoreva kāryatvasya hetorvartamānatvāt viruddhārthasādhakatvādvā viruddho hetuḥ |
kiṃca |
aśarīra- kartṛkatvaṃ sādhyamarhalena īpsitaṃ, tatra kāryatvaṃ saśarīrakartṛkatvavyāptamiti tadeva sādhyamiva dharmaviśeṣaviparītasādhano hetuḥ, tathā dharmaviśeṣa- viparītasādhanaśca |
aśakyakriyasya hi bhūbhūdharāderdharmibhaṃ, kāryatvaṃ ca śakyakriyatvena ghaṭādinā vyāptimite tadapi sādhayati |
tathā kāryatvaṃ kṣetrajñakartṛkatvena vyāptamiti tadapi sādhayati |
tathā kāryatvaṃ adṛṣṭavatkartṛkatvena vyāptamiti tadapi sādhayati |
tathā anityecchājñānādimatkartṛkatvena vyāptamiti tadapi sādhayati |
atha aśeṣaviśeṣaparihāreṇa sakartṛkatvasāmānyāt sādhyaṃ, tarhi sāmānyamātrakartṛkatvābhāvāt sādhyavikalataiva |
pakṣadharmatayā viśeṣākṣepo kartṛjātīya- svabhāvānuguṇameva kṣetrajñādi viśeṣameva ākṣipatī, na viparītasvabhāvaṃ, yathā abhimattve sādhye pakṣadharmatayā uṣtvādāhakatvādidharmayuktasya abhimaviśeṣasya ākṣepaḥ, na viparītasya aṇutvādādiyuktasya |
kiṃca anaikāntika- ścāyaṃ hetuḥ |
cetanakartṛkatve hi sādhyatvenābhimataṃ, tatra bhūbhūrādikaṃ pakṣaḥ, cetanakartṛkatvaṃ ghaṭādiḥ sapakṣaḥ, cetana- kartṛkavyatiriktaḥ sarvo vipakṣaḥ, tatra kāryatvaṃ pakṣatraye'pi vartate, bhūbhūrādau sālābhāñchadau ca, ataḥ anaikānti- katvamaparihāryam |
kiṃca anvayavyatirekaścāyaṃ hetuḥ |
tathāhi, kimidaṃ kāryatvamabhipretaṃ bhūbhūrādeḥ, kiṃ bhūbhūrādyavayavina eva abhūbhāvamavalakṣaṇakāryatvaṃ, āhosvit avinā- śinyeva avayavini krameṇa katipayavayavotpattilakṣaṇam |
abhūbhāvamavalakṣaṇasya kāryatvasya asāmiranyanupagamāt asiddho hetuḥ |
krameṇa katipayavayavotpattilakṣaṇe kāryatve anvayavyatirekatvaṃ, evaṃvidhasya kāryatvasya bhūbhū- rādiṣu asaṃbhavāt anyābhāvācca, pakṣe eva varta- mānatvāt, sapakṣasadbhāvena kevalavyatirekatvābhāvācca |
kiṃca kālāyāpadiṣṭo hetuḥ |
tathāhi, anupalabdhyā tāvat kṣityādīnāṃ akartṛkatvameva niścīyate, ataḥ anu- palabdhibādhitaṃ idamanumānam |
yathā śaśamastakaṃ viṣāṇa- vat catuṣpāmastaktvāt, gomastakavat ityanumānamanupa- labhyā bādhyate |
atha jagatkartṛranumānasiddhatvāt aśarīratvācca asadādyupalabhyayogyatā nāstīti yogyā- nupalabbhāvāccānumānabādhaḥ |
evaṃ tarhi śaśaviṣāṇa- syāpi anumānasiddhatvāt paramāṇuvat ayogyānupalabhyaḥ iti na tatrāpi anumānabādhaḥ |
yadi viṣaṇajātīyasya rūpavattvamahattvādidarśanāt tatra pratyakṣayogyatā, atrāpi tarhi kartṛjātīyasya vigrahavattvena pratyakṣayogyatā asa- dādyupalabhyayogyatāt upalabhyeta, na copalabhyate |
ataḥ anulabdhivirodho durvirahaḥ |
kiṃca anumāna- viruddhamidaṃ anumānam |
tathāhi, kṣityādikaṃ akartṛkaṃ śarīrajanyatvāt, ākāśavat |
akartṛlaprayukteyaṃ vyāpti- riti cet, ubhayopi prayojakatve virodhābhāvāt |
tathā vivādādhyāsitaṃ kṣetrajñakartṛkaṃ, cetanakartṛkatvāt ghaṭādi- vat |
tathā kṣityādikaṃ aśarīrakartṛkaṃ na bhavati,

' bhāṭṭa-- daivānmānuṣādā'parādhādeva ukthyetkṛṣyeṣu ṣoḍaśitotramutkṛṣyate, na veti cintāyāṃ, ' samayā- dhyuṣite sūrye ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotramupākaroti ' iti vacana- vihitasamayādhyuṣitakāle'prāmāṇyātvādutkarṣaḥ |
na ca ' taṃ parāṅmukhatvebhyo gṛhṇāti ṣoḍaśinam ' iti vacanena ukthyaparabhāvasya vihitatvāt stotrasya ca ' grahaṃ vā gṛhītvā ' iti vacanena grahaṇottarakālatvāt tadanurodhena samayādhyuṣitakālaḥ, ' taṃ parāñcaṃ ' ityanena ṣoḍaśi- yāgābhyāsasyaiva ukthyaparabhāvavidhānena grahaṇasya stotra- pūrvakālatve'pi bādhakābhāvāt |
ata eva tatra gṛhṇāti- nirdhapatitatvāt yajamāna eva |
astu vā grahaṇaparaḥ; tathāpi taittarīyaśākhāyāṃ ṣoḍaśinaḥ savanatraye'pi āgnānāt savanantaraviyaṃ ' taṃ parāñcaṃ ' iti vākyam |
astu vā etadapi sarvaviṣayaṃ, tathāpi ' grahaṃ vā ' ityasya sāmānyaviṣayatvāt ukthyottaragrahaṇe'pi samayādhyuṣite stotrakaraṇe na kaścidvirodhaḥ |
yadi tu sāmānyaviśeṣarūpatvāt yathā'vasthitaśāstraviṣayatvena daivāparādhe apravṛtteḥ sarvārthānāṃ tulyabalatvamucyeta, tathāpi ukthyaparabhāvasya kramatvena upādeyatvāt pūrvādhi- karaṇanyāyena bādhopapatteḥ samayādhyuṣitakālānugrahe nyāya eva |
na ca kālasya aṅgāṅgatvena pradhānakramamapekṣyā daurbalyaṃ, ubhayorapi aṅgāṅgatvāt |
na ca grahaṇasya ava- dānavat pradānopakramatvāt, tadiha ekapadārthatvāt |
iti prāpte, grahaṇasya ṣoḍaśigābhyāsakalpakatvena anta- raṅgatvāt tatkramasya prābalyam |

ata eva prakṛtau 'pṛṣṭheḥ stuvate' iti vākyena pṛṣṭhagrahavidhivi- pakṣe'pi kaṇvarathaṃtarasya na sarvapṛṣṭheṣu niveśaḥ |
kiṃtu 'bṛhatpṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' iti vākya- dvaye dvayoreva sāmnoḥ, pṛṣṭhapaṭhasāmānādhikaraṇyasya anyathā- vaiyarthyapatteḥ tatparihārārthaṃ pṛṣṭhapadasāmānādhikaraṇya- nirdiṣṭānāṃ kaṇvarathaṃtarādīnāmapi tatkāryārthapravattīte- māhendrastotre eva niveśaḥ |
nahi 'bṛhatpṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityādau stotrānuvādena sāmavidhiḥ sāmaviśiṣṭastotra- vidhirvā saṃbhavati, vāmadevyādisāmābhirvā bṛhadrathaṃtarayorapi pāṭhādeva prāpteḥ |
stotrasya tatsādhyastotrābhipramāṇa- ntareṇaiva prāpteḥ |
ato'sya vaiyarthyaparihārārthaṃ kaṇvarathaṃ- tarādīnāṃ svakāryakāritvamityuktaṃ citrā'dhikaraṇakaustume |
evamatrāpi vairūpādīnāṃ bahuvrīhinirdeśavaiyarthyaparihārārthameva māhendrastotre niveśaḥ |

bhā. 10|2|12|39-40. oṃ udavasanīyaḥ satradharmā syāt tadaṅgatvān tatra dānaṃ dharmamātraṃ syāt |
'satrādudavasāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena jyotiṣṭomena sahasra- dakṣiṇena yajeta' iti udavasanīyaḥ soma uktaḥ |
sa satradharmā satrasya dharma eva dharmā yathāsau satradharmā syāt tadaṅgatvān satrāṅgatvān |
tasmāt tatra udavasanīya satrāṅge yat dānaṃ sahasradakṣiṇāyāḥ, tat dharmamātraṃ syāt na parikriyārtham |

na tvatatprakṛtitvāt vibhaktacoditatvācca |
dukhandaḥ pūrvapakṣaṃ vyāvartayati |

ata- tprakṛtitvāt udavasanīyasya satraprakṛtitvābhāvāt |
vibhaktacoditatvācca, satrāt vibhaktatvena udavasanīyasya coditatvāt |
satramutsṛjya udavasanīyaḥ kartavyaḥ |

utpūrvasya avapūrvarasya prahāṇaṃ ityarthaḥ tat kṛtvā |
tasmāt vibhaktacoditatvāt udavasanīyo na satrāṅgaṃ, na ca tat tatprakṛtitaṃ tasmāda dānaṃ parikriyārtham |

ke. udavasanīyaḥ satrabhirikekarayena kāryaḥ |

udavasanīyanyāyaḥ
oṃ udavasanīyanyāyaḥ |
udavasanīyasya satrā- naṅgatvān dakṣiṇādānaṃ ṛtvikaparikriyārthyam |
udavasanīyaḥ satradharmā syāt tadaṅgatvān, tatra dānaṃ dharmamātraṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- asti udavasanīyaḥ 'satrādudavasāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena jyotiṣṭomena sahasradakṣiṇena yajeta' iti |
tatra eṣo'rthaḥ saṃśāyakaḥ : dakṣiṇādānaṃ dharmamātraṃ, uta parikriyārthamiti |
tathā idamaparaṃ dvaitaṃ kiṃ satrāṅgamūdava- sanīyaḥ, neti |
yadi satrāṅgaṃ dharmamātraṃ dānam |
atha na satrāṅgaṃ, parikriyārthamiti ; kiṃ prāptam ? satrāṅgamiti |
kutaḥ ? satraprakaraṇāt |
satraṃ parisamāpya kartavyamiti śrūyate |
satraprakaraṇāt satraṃ lakṣayitvā iti gamyate |
udavasanīyasya satrasya vidhīyate iti |
satrasya ca phalārthatvāt nodavasanīyārthatā gamyate |
na ca satrodava- sānakāle udavasanīyaḥ |
lakṣaṇā hi tathā syāt |
ana- ṛtve ca phalaṃ kalpayitavyam |
tasmāt ānantyāt eka- vākyatāsaṃbandhācca satrāṅgamūdavasanīyaḥ |
satraṃ yathoktaṃ parisamāpya na saṃtoṣṭavyam |
na tāvat kṛtvā kṛtitā mantavyā |
idamaparaṃ tasyāhaṃ kartavyamudavasanīyaḥ |
ityevaṃ abhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate |
yathā 'abhi citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta' 'vājapeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' iti |
tasmāt satrāṅgam |
evaṃ cet sāṅgasya satrasya svaṃ kartṛkatvāt dharmamātraṃ tatra dānam |
satradharmā udavasanīyaḥ iti |
dup-- 'na ca satrodavasānakāle udavasanīyaḥ, lakṣaṇā hi tathā syāt' iti ( bhāṣyasya ) ko''bhi- prāyaḥ |
uttaraṃ-- na ( tāvat ) satraṃ asmin vākye vidhīyate ( vihitatvāt ) |
na satraṃ ka cit ( anyatra aṅgatvena vidhīyate ), na satre ( api ) kiṃcit ( vidhīyate ) iti satraṃ ( pariśeṣāt ) parārthe ( uda- vasanīyakālasrdha ) ucyeta ( siddhānte ) |
tata eṣā lakṣaṇā ityabhiprāyaḥ |
( tathāca lakṣaṇā- parihārāya satrāṅgatvena udavasanīyo vidhīyate ) |
'vājapeyeneṣṭvā' ( iti ) 'satrādudavasāya' ( iti ca ) tulyaṃ matvā pūrvapakṣaṃ karoti |
uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ : ( abhi- dhīyate ) naitayostulyatā kriyayoḥ : ( vājapeyasatrakriyayoḥ |
) vājapeyeneṣṭvā iti nirvanaṃ ( anuṣṭhāya ) pūrvakriyā anyat kriyā'ntaram vidhīyate tadaṅgatayā |
lakṣaṇayā tu tyāgo gamyate, na tu śa-śabdena |
etat iṣṭvāśabdena ucyate ( samāpanam ) |
kriyāviśeṣā hi ( kriyāyāḥ avasthā- viśeṣāḥ ) : ārambhānuṣṭhānaparisamāptayaḥ : ( na tu tathā tyāgaḥ ) |
tasmāt na tyāgaḥ śabdenocyate |
( iha tu ) utpūrvaḥ avasthatiḥ śrutyaiva tyāgaṃ bravīti ( satra- ) karmaṇaḥ |
yadanyat vidhīyate ( pṛṣṭhaśamanīyaṃ ), tasyā- jñatā nāsti, pūrvaṃ karmaṇaḥ parisamāptatvāt |
yadi udava- sāyaśabdaḥ anugrahat ( tat ) kathamaṅgaṃ ( syāt ) |
atha aṅgaṃ, udavasāyaśabdo vādyeta |
na tvatatprakṛtitvāt vibhaktacoditatvācca |
bhāṣyam-- tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati |
naitadevaṃ, dharmamātramatra dānamiti |
kiṃ tarhi ? parikriyārthamiti |
