bhāṭṭa-- krame'pi yadi udgātrapacchedo jaghanyaḥ, tadā tannimittapunaḥprayoge sarvasvameva deyaṃ, na tu dvādaśaśataṃ paranimittapātāt, pūrvaṃ tasyaiva pūrvaprayoge deyatvena prasaktatvāt, 'tatra tadadyāt' ityanena yat pūrvaprayoge paranimittapātāt pūrvaṃ deyatvena prasaktaṃ tasyaiva dakṣiṇā- tvena vidhānāt, dvādaśaśatasya pūrvanimittatvena bādhitatvena deyatvā aprasakteḥ |
ataśca yadyapi sarvasvamapi adākṣiṇyena dakṣiṇatvena vā pūrvaprayoge vastuto bādhitameva, tathāpi paranimittapātāt pūrvaṃ bādhanābhāvāt deyatvena prasaktau na kā cit kṣatiḥ |
yadā tu pratihartṛpacchedo jaghanyaḥ, tadā tasminneva prayoge sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ, na tu pūrvāpacchedanimittakaḥ punaḥ- prayogaḥ kāryaḥ |
na ca sarvasvadāne adākṣiṇyatvena virodhāt tadāpaccheda'pi punaḥprayogavādhe pramāṇābhāvaḥ, adākṣiṇyapunaḥprayogayoḥ samuccitayoreva naimittika- tvena ekābhāve itarasyānupapatteḥ |
ataśca yathā patnyāḥ imaśrunāmabhāvāt keśanāmapi na vapanaṃ, sāhi- tasya vivakṣitatvāt, tathaiva adākṣiṇyasyābhāve punaḥ- prayogasyāpyabhāvaḥ |
yadyapi ca dakṣiṇatvasya punaḥ- prayogakṛtatvā vidhānasya āvaśyakatvādeva pūrvaprayoge adākṣiṇyasya arthaprāptatvāt 'adakṣiṇaṃ taṃ' ityasya anuvādatvamucyate, tathāpi pākṣikānuvādabhidheya adākṣiṇyalope punaḥprayogalopaḥ iti draṣṭavyam |
vastutastu 'somamapabhajya' itivat pākṣikānuvādatve'pi punaḥ- prayogalope pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
na ca tasya saṃśṛdravyamātro- palakṣaṇatvāt na pākṣikānuvādatvamiti vācyam |
saṃśṛdravyanāśo'pi pūrvaprayogāṅgabhūtakarmānatve viśvajitaḥ āvaśyakatvena pākṣikānuvādatvānivāraṇāt |
vastutastu nāyamaṇuvādaḥ, 'tatra tadadyāt' ityanena pūrvaprayoge dātavyadakṣiṇāyāḥ punaḥprayogaṅgatva vidhāne'pi pūrva- prayogaṅgatvabhūtakartṛtvārthe tasminnapi tasyā āvaśyakatvena adākṣiṇyaprāpyabhāvāt |
na ca evaṃ punaḥprayogasya jyotiṣṭomatvādeva dvādaśaśatādirūpadakṣiṇāprāpyupapatteḥ 'tatra tadadyāt' ityasya vaiyarthyamiti vācyam |
tasya pūrvaprayoge ekaviṃśatyādipakṣakaraṇena punaḥprayoge dvādaśa- śatāderapi prāpyatvāt tannivṛtyarthatvena sārthakyāt, udgātrajaghanyatve sarvasvadasāprāpyatvācca |
na caivaṃ keśaśmaśruvapanasya punaḥprayogabādhaḥ, tatra dvaṃdvena sāhi- tyasya upādeyakeśaśmaśrutvata uktatvāt sāhityāva- cchinnasya kriyāṅgatvena pratyekaṃ tadaṅgatvābhāvāt |

bhāṭṭa-- gavāmayanagataṃte mahāvrate 'dikṣu dundubhayo nadanti' iti prakṛtya 'patnaya upagāyanti' iti śrutam |
atra patnaya ityarthe chāndasam |
prakṛtau codatrādibhirgāne kriyamāṇe 'ṛtvija upagāyanti' ityanena ṛtvikartṛkamupagāyātmakaṃ gānaṃ vihitam |
tadiha kiṃ patnayaḥ prākṛtopagānānuvādena vidhīyamānā ṛtvijāṃ nivartikā uta aprākṛtopagānasaṃnnidhatvāt anivartikā iti cintāyāṃ, prakṛtau upagānasya vihitatvāt ihāti- deśena prāpte tadanuvādena vidhīyamānāḥ patnayo ṛtvijāṃ nivartikāḥ |
na ca gānasyodeśyatve taddeśe'nyasya upa- cayasya avivakṣāśaṅkā, upasargāṇāṃ parasparānvayavyutpatyā viśiṣṭoddeśopapatteḥ |
na ca tathāpi 'dikṣu dundubhayo nadanti' iti pratyakṣopadeśādarthāntaraparivarta- mānasya patnīkartṛkopacayasyopapatteḥ |
tādṛśopacaye ca 'kāṇḍavīṇābhirupagāyanti' ityanena sādhanavidhānāt gānaśabdasya śārīrameva gītau prasiddhena dundubhināda- parāmarśakatvānupapatteḥ |
prātagānānuvādena upasargārthasyopa- cayasya patnīnāṃ ca parasparaviśyāsaṃbhavena anekavidhāne vākyabhedācca |
ataśca prākṛtopagānakriyāyāṃ kartṛtvena vidhīyamānāḥ patnayo ṛtvijāṃ nivartikāḥ |
na ca prakṛtau śārīragītyātmakagānasya upacayaḥ |
śārīragītyātmaka evaiti kathaṃ tatra kāṇḍavīṇādividhānamiti vācyam |
śārīra- gīteḥ śārīre evopacayaḥ ityatra pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva prakṛtau sādhanatvavidhānābhāvāt upacayasya śārīra- tve'pi iha kāṇḍavīṇādividhānāt aśārīratve'pi na kṣatiḥ |
astu vā ihāpi tasya śārīratvaṃ, kāṇḍavīṇā-

santi ca jaimineḥ evaṃ prakārāṇyapi anatyantāsa- bhūtāni sūtrāṇi |
vyavahitātideśāśca ' pānanyāpya tadat ' ( 3|4|12|12 ) ityādi āśritāḥ |
tasmāt sūtramātraṃ vyākhyāsyam |
tatra kaiścit śrīṇyadhikaraṇāni kalpitāni , apare- ścatvāri |
prathamaṃ tāvadidaṃ cintyate |
yadetat pūrvādhikaraṇe darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ vidhīyamānatvena upavītamudāhṛtaṃ , tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ tat darśapūrṇamāsayoreva avatiṣṭhate , athavā sarvakarmārthamiti |
ye tu adhikaraṇatrayaṃ samarthayante , teṣāmevaṃ saṃdehaḥ kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoreva vidhiḥ , atha sarvakarmārthatvaṃ anuvādāśrutiḥ |
kiṃ prāptam ? sarvadharmaḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? |
' karmāntare'nuvādo'sya siddha- vad yaḥ pratīyate |
so'nyathānupapatyaitau liṅgatvāt prakriyāyāṃ jayet ||
' mṛtāmihotre hi pitṛdevatye śrūyate ' prācīnāvītī dohayet |
yajñopavītī hi devebhyo dohayati ' iti |
tadyadi sarvārthamupavītaṃ , tato'yaṃ pindhye agnihotrasatraṃ nityayajñopavītānuvādo'vakalpate |
na cāyaṃ darśapūrṇamāsasyaivānuvādaḥ; viprakṛṣṭatvāt hetuvanni- gadārthavādānarthakyācca |
yadi hi tasminneva karmaṇi anyāvasthāyaṃ dharmo bhavati , tataśca tadavasthaparijihīrṣayā hetuvannigado'vakalpate |
na tu ṛtvantarasya parihartavyaṃ atyantaviprakarṣeṇaiva aprasaktatvāt |
na ca devebhya iti bahuvacanaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoravakalpate , vaikalpikendramahendretyeka- devatyatvāt sānāyyasya |
agnihotre tu sāyaṃprātardevatā- locanena upapannaṃ bahuvacanam |
tasmādagnihotropavītānuvādā- nyathānupapatteḥ sarvadharmatvamiti |
na vā , prakaraṇatasya darśanam |
vā— na vā sarvadharmaḥ |
kutaḥ ? |
prakaraṇāt darśa- pūrṇamāsārthatvapratīteḥ |
atha yaduktaṃ liṅgadarśanāditi |
parihataṃ tat |
tathaiva etaddarśanaṃ darśapūrṇamāsasyeti |
saṃnikṛṣṭānuvādasaṃbhave na viprakṛṣṭānuvādo'pi āśri- yate |
yathāprāptyapekṣo hi sa bhavati |
bahuvacanaṃ ca avivakṣitam |
athavā prakṛtikṛtidevatā slocane- nopapadyate |
tataścāyamartho bhavati , yasmāt devayukta- karmāttaramartho'yaṃ , ataḥ pindhye'gnihotre na kartavya iti |
śā— so'yaṃ liṅgaprakaraṇavirodhavirodhavicāraḥ |
soma— prakaraṇādupasthānanivītasya itya- yukte , upabhyānasyaiva prakaraṇe niveśābhāvāt iti pratyava- sthānāt ākṣepasaṃgatiḥ |
' yajñopavītī hi devebhyo dohayati ' ityatrāpi yajñopavītaśabdena vāsovinyāsa- viśeṣa evābhidhīyate , ityatrāyaṃ vicāraḥ pravartitaḥ |
nacatanmuktasūtrakatrivṛdabrahmagranthakasūtrāmidhāne asya vicārasyānupapatteḥ |
iti dhyeyam |
vi— sarvārthamuta darśārthamupapadyata ityadaḥ |
, sarvārthamagnihotre syādupavītītiliṅgataḥ ||
, darśārthye
upavītādhikaraṇaṃ |
upavītādhikaraṇaṃ
prakaraṇālliṅge syāt siddhiranyathā |
dohaṃ mṛtāmihotreya stolumetadanūditam ||
' tasmāt darśapūrṇamāsāṅgupavītam |
bhāṭṭa— tadidamupavītaṃ sarvakarmārthaṃ , mṛtāmihotre ' prācīnāvītī dohayet , yajñopavītī hi devebhyo doha- yati ' iti jīvadevatāyāṃ yajñopavītānuvādaliṅgasya prāpyabhāvena sarvārthatāgamakamatvāt , viprakṛṣṭatvena darśapūrṇa- māsasyānuvādānupapatteśca , vaikalpikendramahendradevatya- dārśikadohane devatāhṛtvābhāvena tadanudānupapatteśca |
sarvārthatve tu kartṛsaṃskārasyopavītasya bahudevatyāgnihotra- prayogāṅgatvena tadohane'pi prāptaḥ : anuvādopapattiḥ |
iti prāpte , saṃnikṛṣṭasaṃbhave viprakṛṣṭānuvādasyāpi nyāyya- tvāt prakṛtivikalpaprabhrāyeṇa ca sānāyye'pi devatā- bahutvasattvāt anuvādopapatteḥ prakaraṇāt darśapūrṇamāsāṅ- mevopavītam |
vastutastu , vakṣyamāṇavacanānusāratu agni- hotre'pi yajñopavītasattvena tatratyasyaivārthamamuvādaḥ |
śaṃkara— ' upavītaṃ tu darśaṅgam |
upavītādhikaraṇam |
nividhikaraṇam |
upa- vītaṃ darśapūrṇamāsāṅgam ||
saṃdigdhe tu vyavāyād vākyabhedaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam— ( taittirīyake 2|5 ) darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ saptamāṣṭamotrāṃnuvākayoḥ sāmidhenyaḥ uktāḥ |
navame nividaḥ |
daśame kāmyāḥ sāmidhenīkalpā idamakāmasya etāvatīranubrūyāt idaṃkāmasya etāvatīḥ |
ekādaśe ca yajñopavītamāmnātam |
' upapadyate devalakṣameva tatkṛ- te ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sāmidhenīreva anubrūyāt : upapadyate , uta prakaraṇe savaneva padārthān anutiṣṭhatā upapadyata iti |
kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? upavītaṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ prakaraṇe samāmnātaṃ , atha nivṛtte vā tāsāṃ prakaraṇe iti na jñāyate |
nanu darśapūrṇamāsayoreva prakaraṇamidam |
para- prakaraṇe sāmidhenyaḥ śrūyante |
satyaṃ paraprakaraṇe śrūyante , tathāpi tāsāmavāntaraprakaraṇamaparam |
bhavati hi ' sāmi- dhenīranubrūyāt ' iti viśeṣākāṅkṣa vacanam |
yena tatsannidhau abhīdhīyamānaṃ tattveti jñāyate |
kathaṃ punarnivṛttaṃ tāsāṃ prakaraṇamityāśaṅkyate |
nividadāni tāsāṃ prakaraṇaṃ vyavadadhatīti |
yadyevaṃ , kathamanvuvate prakaraṇamitā- śaṅkā |
parastāt nividāṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ eva kāmyā vidhīyamānāḥ śrūyante , yadanmanantaraṃ yajñopavītamāmnātaṃ , tena aniṣṭacataṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ prakaraṇamiti bhavati matiḥ |
ataḥ prakaraṇe nividaḥ samupanapitā na vyavadadhati , yathā dvādyopasattvā ahīnadharmau jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe iti |
tena bhavati saṃdehaḥ |
asmin saṃdehe kiṃ tāvatprāptam ? sāmidhenīprakaraṇamaniṣṭaṃ , tatropavītaṃ samāmnāta miti |
kutaḥ ? |
kāmyānāṃ sāmidhenīkalpānāṃ ānantaryavacanāt |
hṛdayamanuparivartamānāsu sāmidhenīṣu upavītāmnātaṃ |
kartṛtvāsovinyāsamātraṃ guṇo bhavati upavītaṃ nāma |
kiṃ kurvatā tat kartavyamiti bhavati tatra padārthī- kāṅkṣā |
tatra buddhau saṃnihitena aviprakṛṣṭena , sāmidhenī- vākyena ekavākyatāmupagamya sāmidhenīṣu upavītaṃ upapadyate ityeṣa śabdo vidadhātīti gamyate |
evaṃ prāpte , brūmaḥ |
tasmin saṃdehe yastvoktaḥ , sa nirṇayaḥ |
asmin saṃdehe vākyabhedaḥ iti nirṇaya iti |
kutaḥ ? vyavayāt |
iha samāmnāya sānubandhasya sāmidhenīvākyasya , asya ca ' upapadyate ' iti vacanasya nividāṃ vidhāya- kena sāmidhenībhiḥ asaṃbandhena granthena vyavadhānaṃ bhavati |
yasya ca paryavasite'pi vacane tatsaṃbandhameva arthāntaraṃ prakramante , na tatrānanuvṛttaṃ prakaraṇam |
āgacchati hi tatsaṃbaddhābhidhāne hṛdayam |
yatra tu paryavasite vacane tadasaṃbaṃdhameva arthāntaraṃ prakramante , na tatra buddhau pūrvaḥ padārthaḥ saṃnidhīyate |
na ca buddhau asannihitena eka- vākyatā bhavati |
dvābhyāṃ padārthābhyāṃ vākyārthaḥ saṃjanyate , nānyatareṇa |
saṃnidhau samāmnāyasya etadeva prayojanaṃ kathamubhābhyāṃ padārthābhyāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ buddhimupādāye- yuriti |
anantarābuddhena saha vākyārthaḥ śakyate kartum |
asaṃbaddhavyavadhāne ca na anantarābuddhau bhavati |
tasmāt vyavahitena saha naikavākyatā bhavatīti |
athānyena prakāreṇa dhyānādinā pūrvapadārthamavagamya vākyārtha saṃjanayet , avaidikaḥ sa puruṣabuddhipūrvako vākyārtho bhavet— yathā anyasyānuvādāt ākhyātapadaṃ gṛhītvā , anyasmācca nāmapadaṃ yo vākyārthaḥ saṃjanyate |
tādṛśaṃ
upavītādhikaraṇaṃ
tat bhavet, yatrānyena dhānādinā pūrvapadārthamavagamya vākyārthe saṃjanayet |
tasmānnasaṃjñārthavyavadhānaikavākyatā bhavatīti niśrīyate |
tasmāt na sāmidhenībhiraikavākyatā upavītasyeti |
nanu sāmidhenīkalpāṃ anantarayuktānāṃ saṃnidhau upavītāmnāyate, tena sāmidhenībhiḥ saṃbhanyate iti |
neti brūmaḥ |
ativṛttameva hi sāmidhenīnāṃ praka- raṇaṃ, niviṣṭyadairdhadhanānāt |
vākyena hi sāmidhenīkalpāḥ kāmyāḥ saṃbandhamupagacchanti, na prakaraṇamanuvartate |
na ca punaḥ kalpavacanena sāmidhenyaḥ prakṛtā bhavanti |
nahi tatra tāsāṃ vacanaṃ kartavyaṃ iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? saṃkhyābhiḥ saṃbandhayitavyā iti |
tadapi vākyena, na prakaraṇena |
tatra aprakṛtāsāmidhenīṣu yasyaikavākyatā guṇasya sāmidhenīrnāsti, na tasya tābhiḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
tasmāt kṛtsne prakaraṇe yadanujñeyaṃ, tat yaṣopavīteneti siddham |
vā — siddhe karmaṇāṃ karmasamavāye adhunā avāntara- prakaraṇamahāprakaraṇayoḥ katarat viniyojakaṃ iti upavīta- mudāhṛtam |
tatra sāmidhenyanuvākavibhāgapradarthanaṃ sāmidhenī- prakaraṇasadasadbhāvavivekārtham |
'nanu darśapūrṇamāsayo- reva prakaraṇaṃ' iti (bhāṣyaṃ) mahāprakaraṇayattvāt naiva avāntaraprakaraṇāni āvibhavanti |
athavā abhismindhanaprakāśanadvāreṇa dṛṣṭasaṃskārārthatvāt na tāsāṃ prakaraṇamiti manyate |
naitadevam 'kathaṃbhāvo hi bhāvānāṃ yāvadākhyātāmiṣyate |
na tasya pratibandho'sti mahāprakaraṇādibhiḥ |
nānyaprakaraṇāpattiḥ saṃskāro vā vihanti tam |
' yathaiva aṅgavākyāni paripūrṇa- svārthāḥ santi darśapūrṇamāsavākyena ekavākyatāṃ yānti, na ca ātmatvaṃ jahati, evaṃ aṅgabhāvanāḥ svāṅgaparipūrṇaḥ paramabhāvanāyāṃ saṃbadhyante, na taddīnatvena tāsāṃ svadharma- nivṛttiḥ |
saṃskāro'pi ca apūrvārthatvāt tassiddhyupāyaṃ apekṣamāṇaḥ prakaraṇamibhavati |
dṛṣṭaye'pi niyamādṛṣṭasi- ddhayarthaṃ kathaṃbhāvāpekṣo'ntaḥ prakaraṇasadbhāvaḥ |
'dṛṣṭe'pi ca phale naiva sā'pekṣā na pravartate |
dṛṣṭe'pi tu kenāpi sopāyena nivartyate |
' tasmāt evaṃvidhānamapi ajñānāṃ avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ bhavitavyam |
ataśca yadyapi dṛṣṭārthā ākāṅkṣā dṛṣṭenaiva pūryate, 'abhismindhana-
prakāśanaṃ bhāvayet' kena ? sāmidhenyanuvacanena, katham ? vivakṣāprathanābhighātādikamopajanitavarṇagrahaṇasamarthakaraṇa- śrotrasaṃskārānugṛhītena iti, (vivakṣāpradanādikrameṇa upajanito yo varṇagrahaṇasamarthakaraṇarūpaḥ śrotrasaṃskāraḥ, tadanugṛhītenetyarthaḥ) |
tathāpi 'niyamādṛṣṭaṃ kathaṃ setsyati' iti anuvartate ekākāṅkṣā |
sā ca śāstra- coditena adṛṣṭenaiva upāyena pūryate |
tasmāt asti sāmidhenyanuvacanasya upavītādigrahaṇasamarthaṃ avāntara- prakaraṇam |
evaṃ tarhi tasya saṃnikarṣeṇa baliyastvāt tadaṅgatvenaiva bhavitavyaṃ, iti kuto mahāprakaraṇavini- yogaśaṅkā ? ucyate |
satyaṃ etadevaṃ syāt, yadi tasya niviṣṭyadavadhānena prakaraṇavicchedāśaṅkā na syāt |
evaṃ tarhi vicchinne tasmin jitaṃ mahāprakaraṇa- neti |
naitadevam |
kutaḥ ? kāmyasāmidhenīkalpasyakīrta- nena avicchedasaṃdehāt avispaṣṭaṃ mahāprakaraṇam |
(etāvatā saṃdehabhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātam |
atha 'kiṃ tāvadyānta ityādibhāṣyaṃ' vyācaṣṭe-) kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? 'abhitaḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ kīrtanāt prakriyā sthitā |
paraprakaraṇe pāṭho nividāṃathavā''gatā |
' yathā darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe pūyādyanumantrāṇi asaṃbaddhā- nyapi na purastāt prakaraṇaṃ vicchindanti, tathā nividā- nyapi na vicchindantiḥ prakaraṇam |
athavā avāntaraprakaraṇena nividāṃapi sāmidhenyanuvacanāṅgatvān naiva asaṃbaddhapada- vyavāyaḥ ityupapannaṃ upavītamapi tadaṅgemeva iti |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
'vicchinnā sāmidhenīnāṃ nividbhiḥ prakriyā yataḥ |
nahi kāryataḥ punaḥ kalpaiḥ saṃdhātuṃ sā hi śakyate |
' tāvat hi prakaraṇamanuvartate, yāvat viniyogāhaṃ paśyati |
asaṃyuktaṃ ca prakaraṇena viniyujyate |
tadiha nividādinā tatra liṅgena sāmidhenībhirityutthāni abhismindhane viniyujyante 'deveddo mantridaḥ' iti |
tatra yadi agniḥ sāmidhenyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ taddvāreṇa tānyapi aṅgāni bhaveyuḥ |
atha anagnau satyapi aṅgatā kalpyate, tataḥ sāmidhenīnāmapi nividā- ṅgatvaṃ kalpayet |
tena nivittu tāvat prakaraṇaṃ nānuvṛttam |
kāmyāstu kalpyāḥ śrutyaiva puruṣārthatvena
upavītādhikaraṇaṃ
avagatāḥ, iti naiva sāmidhenyanuvacanena gṛhyate |
yadi punaḥ nividaḥ aṅgaṃ bhaveyuḥ, tataḥ godohananyāyena āśrayagrahaṇādāpi tāvat kāmyeṣu prakaraṇānuvṛttiḥ syāt, athāpi kāmyānāmaṅgaṃ bhavet, tathāpi pūyādyanumantravat prakaraṇābādhaṃ nividāṃ kathaṃcit anusaṃdhānena adhyavasyema, na tu anyataradasti iti asati avāntaraprakaraṇe mahā- prakaraṇena sarvārthatā |
nanu yadi vicchinne prakaraṇe kāmyāḥ kalpāḥ śrūyante, tataḥ ekaviṃśatyā pratiṣṭhāṃ bhāvayet, kimāśritayā ? iti prakaraṇena āśraye anu- nīyamāne sākāṅkṣatvāt aparipūrṇatā prāpnoti |
atha vākyena āśrayaṃ upanīyate, tataḥ prāpte karmaṇi saṃbandha- dvayakaraṇāt vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
tatra yadi vākyabhedo'bhyupa- gamyeta, kathaṃcit vā parihiyeta, tato revatīvāravantīya- saubharādiṣvapi evameva vākyena prakṛtāśrayadānāt siddhāntahāniḥ |
aya āśrayalābhāt kathaṃcit anuvartate prakaraṇaṃ, tataḥ upavītamapi tathaiva prāpnoti iti sarvathā saṃkaṭametat |
ucyate |
'guṇāt kāmo na yukto'tra vicchinnaprakriyā syāt |
anekavidhaividheḥ śakyo nāpūrvāt karmaṇo vinā |
' naivātra ekaviṃśatyāderguṇāt phalam |
kiṃ tarhi ? revatīvāravantīyavākyavadeva anenāpi viśiṣṭaṃ karma vidhīyate |
tataśca bhāṣyārthādhikaraṇa- nyāyena dhātvarthāṃ phalam |
ataḥ 'ekaviṃśatyādi- viśiṣṭena anuvacanena pratiṣṭhādi sādhayet' |
kathamiti ? anubrūyāt iti śabdasāmānyāt, saṃkhyāprayāsatveca 'sāmidhenyanuvacanavat' iti gamyate |
tataśca saṃkhyye- yānāṃ ṛcāṃ anyeṣāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ prāptiḥ |
yadyapi cātra karmāntaratvāmantaratvayoḥ phalaṃ nāsti, tathāpi vākyaṃ evamavakalpate iti itthaṃ varṇitam |
na tu evaṃ sati etānyanuvacanāni darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmugṛhīta- tvāt pṛthageva prayoktavyāni |
na tāvat etena asatpakṣo nivartyate, sarvathā upavītasya sarvārthatvasiddheḥ |
na ca svatantraḥ prayogaḥ |
kutaḥ ? 'paścād yaśyocya- māno'yamamuśadaḥ prayujyate |
na tasyānyaprayukta- tvāt svātantrye sati labhyate |
' yo hi nigadaḥ prāk sāmidhenībhyaḥ prayujyate, sa nivittvadeva na sāmi- dhenyam |
tadanantaratvena ca udyamānāsu anubrūyāt iti vidhiḥ, na svatantrāṇām |
tat yadi pṛthak prayogaḥ syāt, tataḥ sāmidhenyaṅgamātratvāt itareṇa nigadena vinā anuvacanavat vihanyeta |
kiṃca 'sāmidhenītva- madhyāsāṃ na syādaprisamindhanatvāt |
na cāprayoga- madhyasthaḥ śakyo vahniḥ : samindhitum |
' 'ekaviṃśatyā- dimistāvat avaśyaṃ sāmidhenyaḥ saṃkhyātavyāḥ |
tāśca agrisamindhanaṃ prakāśayantyaḥ sāmidhenya ityucyante |
sa cāmiḥ paramayuktaḥ tābhiḥ prakāśayitavyaḥ |
tena 'arthā- bhidhānakarma ca' ityasya prakṛtidanupraveśāt prākṛtasya sāmidhenīkāryasya agrisamindhanaprakāśanasya etenaiva prasaṅgataḥ prāptaḥ arthāta prayogamadhyapatitasāmidhenādhīnatvam |
nanu evamapi eṣāmeva kāmyānāṃ kalpānāṃ sarveṣāṃ anyasya vā upavītamaṅgaṃ syāt |
naitadevam |
kutaḥ ? 'prākṛtena kathaṃbhāve tadīye pūrite sati |
paścāt saṃnidhinā- 'ṅgaṃ syāt sa ca prakaraṇāvaraḥ |
' sarvāstveva vikṛtiṣu yat prākṛtāṅgamadhye na paṭhitaṃ, tat aklaptopakāratvāt prākṛtairanāṅkṣīkṛte prakaraṇe paścādāgacchat saṃnidhi- viṣayo bhavati |
sa ca avirodhe viniyujyate, virodhe tu videnādivat prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |
tasmāt kṛtsnadarśa- pūrṇamāsārthaṃ upavītaṃ iti siddham |
śā — 'anuvṛttau tadaṅgatvaṃ vicchinne darśa- śeṣatā |
kiṃ prāpnubhayatrāpi kīrtanādanuvartate |
purastādupavītasya parastāccāpi kīrtanam |
vidyate sāmidhenīnāmataḥ prakaraṇastitā |
' athavā 'nivi- dāmapi tādarthyaṃ tatkathaṃbhāvasaṃgateḥ |
na cādvaityava- dhīyante pradhānāni kathaṃ cana |
kāmyebhyaścā- śrayatvena tāsāmanuvartate |

taddiṣṭahomadhividhiḥ dvaidhaṃvidhaḥ ityatra saṃkhyāmātravidhiḥ iti pakṣe ca lāghavagauravakṛtaviśeṣābhāvāt dvaidhaṃvidhaḥ ityasya saṃkhyāviśiṣṭāvadānavidhāyakatve'pi svātantryeṇa avadānavidhau adṛṣṭārthatvāpatyā dṛṣṭārthatayā pradānopakrama- tathaiva avadānasya vidheyatayā pañcamoktapradānāntānu- samayasya upapannatvāt; caturavattavākyasya avattaviśiṣṭa- homavidhāyakatve catuḥsaṃkhyāyāḥ vidhnasvīkāreṇa haviṣo caturavadānāprasaktatayā etadvikaraṇapratipādyasya haviṣo nityaṃ dviravadānasya siddheśca pakṣadvayamapi vārtikakārasya saṃmatam|
sūtrārthastu- puroḍāśotpatterhomārthatvāt pradhānasya puroḍāśasya caturavadānaṃ, homasaṃyogena hotavyasya caturava- dānapratīteḥ|
ājyaṃ tu puroḍāśena atulyatvādhikaṃ iti nopastaraṇābhighāraṇābhyāṃ saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ, taducyateḥ saṃskārārtha- tayā guṇabhūtatvāt|

āptiḥ saṃkhyāsamānatvāt |
śatakṛṣṇalacarau ājyena upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe na kartavye iti siddhānte ‘catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati catura- vatsyāpya’ ityātivacanaṃ sādhakatayā upanyastam |
caturavat caturbhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ sidhyati iti tadarthaḥ |
punaśca upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe kartavye iti pūrvapakṣamupanyasya ātivacanasya gatimāha pūrvapakṣī |
ātiḥ prāptiḥ siddhiḥ |
ātivacanaṃ saṃkhyāsamānatvāt saṃkhyayā samāna- tvāt tulyatvāt upapadyate |
avadāne catuḥsaṃkhyā kṛṣṇale- ṣvapi catuḥsaṃkhyā iti ubhayatra saṃkhyayā samānatvam |
catuḥsaṃkhyāsaṃtutireṣā |
tena nopastaraṇāmidhāraṇayo- rnivṛttiḥ |
satostvāptivacanaṃ vyartham |
tuśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣiṇā ātivacanasya catuḥsaṃkhyāstuti- paratvaṃ yaduktaṃ tat vyāvarttayati siddhāntī |
satoḥ vidya- mānayoḥ upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ stutyarthamātivacanaṃ vyarthe syāt |
nahi vidyamānasya kaścit saṃstayo'sti |
yadi avidyamānamāpadyati iti ātiḥ ityucyate tato guṇa- vān iti stutirbhavet |
tasmāt satoḥ upastaraṇāmidhāra- ṇayoḥ āsivacanaṃ vyartham |
tasmāt kartavye |
vikalpasteṣvekāvadānatvāt |
śatakṛṣṇale carau ‘catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati catura- vatsyāpya’ iti ātivacanāt liṅgāt upastaraṇā- midhāraṇayornivṛttiḥ yathā gamyate, tathā ekāvadānatvāt ‘catvāri kṛṣṇalāni ekamavadānaṃ’ iti ekāvadānavacanāt liṅgāt upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ anivṛttirgamyate |
caturbhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ ekaṃ mukhyamavadānaṃ caturavatsyāpya tu upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ kartavyatā iti |
evaṃ ca sati liṅgadvayavirodhaḥ prātaḥ, tasmāt upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ vikalpaḥ syāt na tu ekānte nivṛttiḥ |
ityāha pūrvapakṣī |
tuśabdaḥ vailakṣaṇyarthaḥ vikalpastu kadā cit syāt iti |
sarvavikāre tvabhyāsārthaṃkaṃ haviṣo hītarasya syāt |
pūrvasūtre vikalpaṃ doṣamabhidhāya punaḥ pūrvapakṣī svapakṣaṃ sādhayati |
tuśabdaḥ vikalpanirāsārthaḥ |
‘catvāri kṛṣṇalānyekamavadānaṃ’ ityukte sakṛdevāvadāne sarvavikāre sarvasya caturavattasya vikāre sati, caturavatta sthāne caturbhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ sakṛdevāvadāne sati, hi yasmāt ita- rasya haviṣaḥ punaśrutibhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ dvitīyāvadānasya yo'- bhyāsaḥ : ‘catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati samṛddhayai’ iti, tathyānarthakyaṃ syāt |
sarvavikāre dvitīyāvadāna- syaiva abhāvāt |
tasmāt na sarvavikāraḥ |
evaṃ ca abhyāsāt caturbhiśścaturbhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ dviravadānaṃ upastaraṇaṃ vāmidhāraṇaṃ ceti caturavattasiddhiḥ |
apivā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ syāditarasyānyāyyatvāt |
śatakṛṣṇalacarau upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe kartavye na vā iti vicāre pravartamāne ‘catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati’ iti abhyāsaḥ dvitīyamavadānamapekṣya bhaviṣyati iti ukta- matanirāsārthaḥ |
apivāśabdaḥ |
abhyāsastu sviṣṭakṛtaḥ sviṣṭa- kṛdarthaḥ syāt |
itarasya dvitīyāvadānārthatvasya anyāyya- tvāt |
abhyāsaṃ vinā'pi avadānadharmeṇa dvitīyāvadāna- syāpi siddhatvāt |
tasmāt upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe kartavye iti pūrvapakṣa eva |
athavā astu ubhayorapi ekasūtratvam |
tatra cāyamarthaḥ - tuśabdena vikalpaṃ nirasya pūrvapakṣī svapakṣaṃ sādhayati |
sarvavikāre sarvasya prākṛtasya dviravadānasya śatakṛṣṇalecaturāvadāne vikāre sati ‘catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati’ iti abhyāsasya ānarthakyaṃ syāt sarvavikārapakṣe dvitīyāvadānābhāvāt |
ānarthakyameva sādhayati, hi yasmāt sarvavikārapakṣe abhyāsaḥ itarasya dvitīyāvadānarūpasya haviṣaḥ kṛte syāt, apivā kiṃvā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ kṛte syāt |
paraṃtu tadubhayamapyayuktam |
itarasya asya pakṣadvayasya anyāyyatvāt |
sarvavikārapakṣe tāvat dvitīyāvadānābhāvāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ prakaraṇābhāvāt |
tasmāt sarvavikārapakṣaḥ ayukta eva |
tataśca abhyāsaḥ kṛṣṇalacatuṣṭayasya dvitīyāvadānatvārtha eva |
kṛṣṇalādyekena avadānadvayaṃ upastaraṇāmidhāraṇārthaṃ ca dvayaṃ iti catura- vattasaṃpattiḥ |
‘catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati caturavattasyāpya’

ityātivacanaṃ tu saṃkhyāsamānatvārthe svīkāryam |

akarma vā saṃsagārthe nivṛttatvāt tasmādāti- samarthatvam |

śatakṛṣṇale carau pracaraṇa- kāle upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ akarma na karma |
te na kartavye |
saṃsagārthanivṛttatvāt |
suvi puroḍāśādyava- yavānāṃ saṃsargaḥ śliṣṭatā mā bhūt iti upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe kriyate |
kṛṣṇalānāṃ tu tādṛśaḥ saṃsarga eva na saṃbhavati |
iti saṃsargasya arthasya nivṛttatvāt abhāvāt upastara- ṇādi na kartavyam |
evaṃ ca ‘catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇala- nyavacati caturavattasyāpya’ iti ātiḥ - ātivacanasya samarthatvaṃ samyagarthatvaṃ sidhyati |
